variants.extended_description_de:
Ein ruhigerer Ort zum Denken, Sprechen und konzentrierten Arbeiten.

Lassen Sie den Trubel des Großraumbüros hinter sich. Die Sileopod V5-L bietet Platz für bis zu 4 Personen (kleine Meetings, Brainstorming & hybride Team-Calls) und schafft eine geschlossene akustische Rückzugszone in Büros, Flughäfen, Cafés und hybriden Arbeitswelten.

Italienisches Design für den Arbeitsalltag
Entwickelt mit dem Mailänder Designteam Morpha vereint Sileopod minimalistisches italienisches Design mit durchdachter Akustiktechnik. Die Oberfläche in Moosgrün (RAL 6005) fügt sich harmonisch in moderne Räume ein.

Weniger Ablenkung. Mehr Privatsphäre.
Bis zu 32 dB Sprachpegelreduzierung (ISO 23351-1, Akustikklasse A) sorgen dafür, dass vertrauliche Gespräche in der Kabine bleiben und das Umfeld ruhig bleibt.

Frische Luft & schneller Aufbau
Leise Lüfter erneuern die Innenluft alle 60 Sekunden, gesteuert über Präsenzsensoren für Licht und Belüftung. Dank modularer Steck- und Magnetelemente gelingt die Montage ab ca. 35 Minuten.

Konstruktion der Serie V5
Die V5-Serie vereint einen Rahmen aus Stahl und 6063-Aluminium mit präzise gefertigten Stahl-Außenpaneelen und einer magnetisch schließenden Tür. Im Inneren sorgen 12 mm Akustikpaneele und Teppichboden für angenehme Raumakustik, während Verbundsicherheitsglas (4 + 0,76 + 4 mm) für Offenheit sorgt. Der sechslagige Wandaufbau kombiniert schallabsorbierende, dämpfende und isolierende Schichten. Über den Drehregler lassen sich Lüftung, dimmbares 4000-K-Licht sowie Telefon-, Arbeits- und Entspannungsmodi ganz ohne App steuern.

• Außenfarbe: Moosgrün (RAL 6005)
• Außenmaße (B × T × H): 2200 × 1380 × 2285 mm
• Innenmaße Boden (B × T): 2050 × 1280 mm
• Gewicht: 590 kg
• Kapazität: bis zu 4 Personen (kleine Meetings, Brainstorming & hybride Team-Calls)
variants.extended_description_fr:
Un espace plus calme pour réfléchir, échanger et avancer efficacement.

Éloignez-vous du bruit ambiant. La Sileopod V5-L offre un refuge acoustique conçu pour jusqu'à 4 personnes (petites réunions, brainstorming et appels d'équipe), idéal pour les bureaux ouverts, aéroports, espaces publics et environnements hybrides.

Design italien pensé pour le travail
Conçue avec le studio milanais Morpha, Sileopod allie esthétique italienne minimaliste et ingénierie acoustique. La finition extérieure Vert (RAL 6005) affirme une présence élégante dans tout aménagement.

Moins de bruit. Plus de confidentialité.
Réduction du niveau de parole jusqu'à 32 dB (tests ISO 23351-1, performance acoustique Classe A) pour des appels confidentiels sans déranger l'entourage.

Air renouvelé & montage modulaire
La ventilation silencieuse renouvelle l'air toutes les 60 secondes, avec détection de présence pour l'éclairage et la ventilation. L'assemblage modulaire s'effectue à partir de 35 minutes.

Conception de la série V5
La série V5 associe une structure en acier et aluminium 6063 à des panneaux extérieurs en acier thermolaqué et une porte à fermeture magnétique. À l'intérieur, des panneaux acoustiques de 12 mm et une moquette adoucissent l'ambiance, tandis que le verre feuilleté (4 + 0,76 + 4 mm) préserve la connexion visuelle. Sa paroi à six couches combine absorption, amortissement et isolation phonique. Une commande rotative intuitive règle la ventilation, l'éclairage 4000 K variable et les modes appel, travail ou détente sans application.

En résumé
• Modèle : V5-L
• Finition extérieure : Vert (RAL 6005)
• Dimensions extérieures (L × P × H) : 2200 × 1380 × 2285 mm
• Dimensions intérieures au sol (L × P) : 2050 × 1280 mm
• Poids : 590 kg
• Capacité : jusqu'à 4 personnes (petites réunions, brainstorming et appels d'équipe)
variants.extended_description_es:
Un lugar más tranquilo para pensar, hablar y trabajar con foco.

Aléjese del ruido ambiental. Sileopod V5-L ofrece un refugio acústico cerrado pensado para hasta 4 personas (reuniones pequeñas, lluvia de ideas y llamadas híbridas) en oficinas abiertas, aeropuertos, espacios públicos y entornos híbridos.

Diseño italiano para la jornada laboral
Desarrollada junto al equipo milanés Morpha, Sileopod combina estética italiana minimalista e ingeniería acústica. El acabado exterior Verde (RAL 6005) aporta elegancia a cualquier espacio.

Menos distracciones. Más privacidad.
Reducción del nivel de voz de hasta 32 dB (ensayos ISO 23351-1, rendimiento acústico Clase A) para mantener la privacidad de cada conversación.

Aire fresco y montaje rápido
Ventiladores silenciosos renuevan el aire interior cada 60 segundos, con iluminación y ventilación activadas por presencia. Su sistema modular permite el montaje desde 35 minutos.

Construcción de la serie V5
La serie V5 combina una estructura de acero y aluminio 6063 con paneles exteriores de acero pintado y puerta de cierre magnético. En el interior, los paneles acústicos de 12 mm y la moqueta suavizan el espacio, mientras que el vidrio laminado (4 + 0,76 + 4 mm) mantiene la conexión visual. Su pared de seis capas integra materiales fonoabsorbentes, amortiguadores y aislantes. Un mando giratorio permite controlar ventilación, iluminación regulable de 4000 K y modos de llamada, trabajo o descanso sin necesidad de aplicación.

De un vistazo

• Acabado exterior: Verde (RAL 6005)
• Dimensiones exteriores (An × Pr × Al): 2200 × 1380 × 2285 mm
• Dimensiones interiores de suelo (An × Pr): 2050 × 1280 mm
• Peso: 590 kg
• Capacidad: hasta 4 personas (reuniones pequeñas, lluvia de ideas y llamadas híbridas)
variants.extended_description_it:
Uno spazio più silenzioso per pensare, parlare e lavorare al meglio.

Allontanati dal brusio dell'open space. Sileopod V5-L offre uno spazio acustico chiuso pensato per fino a 4 persone (piccole riunioni, brainstorming e call di squadra), ideale per uffici, aeroporti, aree pubbliche e ambienti ibridi.

Design italiano per il lavoro quotidiano
Sviluppata con il team milanese Morpha, Sileopod unisce stile italiano minimalista e ingegneria acustica. La finitura esterna Verde (RAL 6005) valorizza con equilibrio ogni ambiente.

Meno distrazioni. Più privacy.
Riduzione del livello vocale fino a 32 dB (test ISO 23351-1, classe acustica A) per conversazioni riservate senza disturbare chi lavora vicino.

Aria sempre fresca e montaggio rapido
Ventole silenziose rinnovano l'aria ogni 60 secondi con accensione automatica di luce e ventilazione tramite sensore di presenza. La struttura modulare consente il montaggio a partire da 35 minuti.

Struttura della serie V5
La serie V5 combina un telaio in acciaio e alluminio 6063 con pannelli esterni in acciaio verniciato e porta a chiusura magnetica. All'interno, pannelli acustici da 12 mm e moquette attenuano il riverbero, mentre il vetro stratificato (4 + 0,76 + 4 mm) mantiene il contatto visivo con l'ambiente. La parete a sei strati unisce materiali fonoassorbenti, smorzanti e isolanti. Un comando rotativo gestisce ventilazione, luce dimmerabile 4000 K e scenari chiamata, lavoro o relax senza bisogno di app.

In sintesi
• Modello: V5-L
• Finitura esterna: Verde (RAL 6005)
• Dimensioni esterne (L × P × A): 2200 × 1380 × 2285 mm
• Dimensioni interne pavimento (L × P): 2050 × 1280 mm
• Peso: 590 kg
• Capacità: fino a 4 persone (piccole riunioni, brainstorming e call di squadra)
variants.extended_description_por:
Um espaço mais silencioso para pensar, falar e trabalhar com concentração.

Afaste-se do ruído dos espaços abertos. A Sileopod V5-L cria um refúgio acústico fechado para até 4 pessoas (pequenas reuniões, brainstorming e videochamadas em equipa), ideal para escritórios, aeroportos, espaços públicos e ambientes híbridos.

Design italiano para o dia de trabalho
Desenvolvida com a equipa de design milanesa Morpha, a Sileopod combina linhas minimalistas italianas com engenharia acústica. O acabamento exterior Verde (RAL 6005) integra-se perfeitamente em interiores modernos.

Menos distrações. Mais privacidade.
Redução do nível de voz até 32 dB (testes ISO 23351-1, desempenho acústico Classe A) para chamadas confidenciais sem perturbar quem trabalha por perto.

Ar fresco e montagem modular
Ventiladores silenciosos renovam o ar interior a cada 60 segundos, com iluminação e ventilação ativadas por sensor de presença. A construção modular permite montagem a partir de 35 minutos.

Construção da série V5
A série V5 combina uma estrutura em aço e alumínio 6063 com painéis exteriores em aço lacado e porta de fecho magnético. No interior, painéis acústicos de 12 mm e alcatifa suavizam o ambiente, enquanto o vidro laminado (4 + 0,76 + 4 mm) mantém a ligação visual. A parede de seis camadas combina materiais fonoabsorventes, amortecedores e isolantes. Um comando rotativo controla a ventilação, iluminação regulável de 4000 K e modos de chamada, trabalho ou relaxamento sem necessidade de aplicação.

• Acabamento exterior: Verde (RAL 6005)
• Dimensões exteriores (L × P × A): 2200 × 1380 × 2285 mm
• Dimensões interiores do piso (L × P): 2050 × 1280 mm
• Peso: 590 kg
• Capacidade: até 4 pessoas (pequenas reuniões, brainstorming e videochamadas em equipa)

In everyday terms, the design helps reduce how much speech carries beyond the booth, so conversations are less distracting to the people working nearby.

Fresh air for a more comfortable workspace
The Sileopod ventilation concept renews the air inside the booth every 60 seconds. Low-noise fans are designed to keep fresh air moving without becoming a distraction, while presence-activated lighting and ventilation make the space convenient to use.

Modular design. Faster setup.
Clip-together components and magnetic panels simplify installation, with assembly in as little as 35 minutes according to the manufacturer. This modular approach makes it easier to introduce a dedicated quiet space into an existing workplace.

Built for everyday use
The V5 combines a steel and 6063 aluminium frame with precisely made steel exterior panels and a magnetic-closing door. Inside, acoustic panels and carpet help soften the space, while laminated glass keeps the booth visually connected to its surroundings. Its six-layer wall design combines sound-absorbing, damping and insulating materials.

Comfort at your fingertips
The V5 control concept brings fan speed, dimmable 4000 K lighting and phone, work or relax scenes together in a simple rotary control. Desk-height control is available with a compatible adjustable-desk configuration; no app is needed.

Make it fit your space
Interior acoustic panels, carpet and upholstery can be colour-matched to order. Tabletop choices include white, black and oak veneer. Ein ruhigerer Ort zum Denken, Sprechen und konzentrierten Arbeiten.

Lassen Sie den Trubel des Großraumbüros hinter sich. Die Sileopod V5-L bietet Platz für bis zu 4 Personen (kleine Meetings, Brainstorming & hybride Team-Calls) und schafft eine geschlossene akustische Rückzugszone in Büros, Flughäfen, Cafés und hybriden Arbeitswelten.

Italienisches Design für den Arbeitsalltag
Entwickelt mit dem Mailänder Designteam Morpha vereint Sileopod minimalistisches italienisches Design mit durchdachter Akustiktechnik. Die Oberfläche in Altrosa (RAL 3014) fügt sich harmonisch in moderne Räume ein.

Weniger Ablenkung. Mehr Privatsphäre.
Bis zu 32 dB Sprachpegelreduzierung (ISO 23351-1, Akustikklasse A) sorgen dafür, dass vertrauliche Gespräche in der Kabine bleiben und das Umfeld ruhig bleibt.

Frische Luft & schneller Aufbau

Konstruktion der Serie V5
Die V5-Serie vereint einen Rahmen aus Stahl und 6063-Aluminium mit präzise gefertigten Stahl-Außenpaneelen und einer magnetisch schließenden Tür. Im Inneren sorgen 12 mm Akustikpaneele und Teppichboden für angenehme Raumakustik, während Verbundsicherheitsglas (4 + 0,76 + 4 mm) für Offenheit sorgt. Der sechslagige Wandaufbau kombiniert schallabsorbierende, dämpfende und isolierende Schichten. variants.extended_description_fr:
Un espace plus calme pour réfléchir, échanger et avancer efficacement.

Éloignez-vous du bruit ambiant. La Sileopod V5-L offre un refuge acoustique conçu pour jusqu'à 4 personnes (petites réunions, brainstorming et appels d'équipe), idéal pour les bureaux ouverts, aéroports, espaces publics et environnements hybrides.

Design italien pensé pour le travail
Conçue avec le studio milanais Morpha, Sileopod allie esthétique italienne minimaliste et ingénierie acoustique. La finition extérieure Vieux Rose (RAL 3014) affirme une présence élégante dans tout aménagement.

Moins de bruit. Plus de confidentialité.
Réduction du niveau de parole jusqu'à 32 dB (tests ISO 23351-1, performance acoustique Classe A) pour des appels confidentiels sans déranger l'entourage.

Air renouvelé & montage modulaire
La ventilation silencieuse renouvelle l'air toutes les 60 secondes, avec détection de présence pour l'éclairage et la ventilation. L'assemblage modulaire s'effectue à partir de 35 minutes.

Conception de la série V5
La série V5 associe une structure en acier et aluminium 6063 à des panneaux extérieurs en acier thermolaqué et une porte à fermeture magnétique. À l'intérieur, des panneaux acoustiques de 12 mm et une moquette adoucissent l'ambiance, tandis que le verre feuilleté (4 + 0,76 + 4 mm) préserve la connexion visuelle. Sa paroi à six couches combine absorption, amortissement et isolation phonique. Une commande rotative intuitive règle la ventilation, l'éclairage 4000 K variable et les modes appel, travail ou détente sans application.

• Finition extérieure : Vieux Rose (RAL 3014)
• Dimensions extérieures (L × P × H) : 2200 × 1380 × 2285 mm
• Dimensions intérieures au sol (L × P) : 2050 × 1280 mm
• Poids : 590 kg
• Capacité : jusqu'à 4 personnes (petites réunions, brainstorming et appels d'équipe)
variants.extended_description_es:
Un lugar más tranquilo para pensar, hablar y trabajar con foco.

Aléjese del ruido ambiental. Sileopod V5-L ofrece un refugio acústico cerrado pensado para hasta 4 personas (reuniones pequeñas, lluvia de ideas y llamadas híbridas) en oficinas abiertas, aeropuertos, espacios públicos y entornos híbridos.

Diseño italiano para la jornada laboral
Desarrollada junto al equipo milanés Morpha, Sileopod combina estética italiana minimalista e ingeniería acústica. El acabado exterior Rosa Antiguo (RAL 3014) aporta elegancia a cualquier espacio.

Menos distracciones. Más privacidad.
Reducción del nivel de voz de hasta 32 dB (ensayos ISO 23351-1, rendimiento acústico Clase A) para mantener la privacidad de cada conversación.

Aire fresco y montaje rápido
Ventiladores silenciosos renuevan el aire interior cada 60 segundos, con iluminación y ventilación activadas por presencia. Su sistema modular permite el montaje desde 35 minutos.

Construcción de la serie V5
La serie V5 combina una estructura de acero y aluminio 6063 con paneles exteriores de acero pintado y puerta de cierre magnético. En el interior, los paneles acústicos de 12 mm y la moqueta suavizan el espacio, mientras que el vidrio laminado (4 + 0,76 + 4 mm) mantiene la conexión visual. Su pared de seis capas integra materiales fonoabsorbentes, amortiguadores y aislantes. Un mando giratorio permite controlar ventilación, iluminación regulable de 4000 K y modos de llamada, trabajo o descanso sin necesidad de aplicación.

variants.extended_description_it:
Uno spazio più silenzioso per pensare, parlare e lavorare al meglio.

Allontanati dal brusio dell'open space. Sileopod V5-L offre uno spazio acustico chiuso pensato per fino a 4 persone (piccole riunioni, brainstorming e call di squadra), ideale per uffici, aeroporti, aree pubbliche e ambienti ibridi.

Design italiano per il lavoro quotidiano
Sviluppata con il team milanese Morpha, Sileopod unisce stile italiano minimalista e ingegneria acustica. La finitura esterna Rosa Antico (RAL 3014) valorizza con equilibrio ogni ambiente.

Meno distrazioni. Più privacy.
Riduzione del livello vocale fino a 32 dB (test ISO 23351-1, classe acustica A) per conversazioni riservate senza disturbare chi lavora vicino.

Aria sempre fresca e montaggio rapido
Ventole silenziose rinnovano l'aria ogni 60 secondi con accensione automatica di luce e ventilazione tramite sensore di presenza. La struttura modulare consente il montaggio a partire da 35 minuti.

Struttura della serie V5
La serie V5 combina un telaio in acciaio e alluminio 6063 con pannelli esterni in acciaio verniciato e porta a chiusura magnetica. All'interno, pannelli acustici da 12 mm e moquette attenuano il riverbero, mentre il vetro stratificato (4 + 0,76 + 4 mm) mantiene il contatto visivo con l'ambiente. La parete a sei strati unisce materiali fonoassorbenti, smorzanti e isolanti. Un comando rotativo gestisce ventilazione, luce dimmerabile 4000 K e scenari chiamata, lavoro o relax senza bisogno di app.

Entwickelt mit dem Mailänder Designteam Morpha vereint Sileopod minimalistisches italienisches Design mit durchdachter Akustiktechnik. Die Oberfläche in Weiß (RAL 9003) fügt sich harmonisch in moderne Räume ein.

Weniger Ablenkung. Mehr Privatsphäre.
Bis zu 32 dB Sprachpegelreduzierung (ISO 23351-1, Akustikklasse A) sorgen dafür, dass vertrauliche Gespräche in der Kabine bleiben und das Umfeld ruhig bleibt.

Frische Luft & schneller Aufbau
Leise Lüfter erneuern die Innenluft alle 60 Sekunden, gesteuert über Präsenzsensoren für Licht und Belüftung. Dank modularer Steck- und Magnetelemente gelingt die Montage ab ca. 35 Minuten.

Die V4-Serie kombiniert einen präzisen 6063-Aluminiumrahmen mit EPDM-Dichtungen und einem automatischen Honeywell-Türschließer. 12 mm Akustikpaneele und Teppichboden schaffen ein ruhiges Innenklima, während die selbstschließende Tür den täglichen Gebrauch erleichtert. Optional ist ein höhenverstellbarer Schreibtisch (730–1200 mm) erhältlich.

variants.extended_description_fr:
Un espace plus calme pour réfléchir, échanger et avancer efficacement.

Éloignez-vous du bruit ambiant. La Sileopod V4-S offre un refuge acoustique conçu pour 1 personne (appels, visioconférences et travail concentré), idéal pour les bureaux ouverts, aéroports, espaces publics et environnements hybrides.

Design italien pensé pour le travail
Conçue avec le studio milanais Morpha, Sileopod allie esthétique italienne minimaliste et ingénierie acoustique. La finition extérieure Blanc (RAL 9003) affirme une présence élégante dans tout aménagement.

Moins de bruit. Plus de confidentialité.
Réduction du niveau de parole jusqu'à 32 dB (tests ISO 23351-1, performance acoustique Classe A) pour des appels confidentiels sans déranger l'entourage.

Air renouvelé & montage modulaire
La ventilation silencieuse renouvelle l'air toutes les 60 secondes, avec détection de présence pour l'éclairage et la ventilation. L'assemblage modulaire s'effectue à partir de 35 minutes.

Conception de la série V4
La série V4 associe un châssis de précision en aluminium 6063 à des joints EPDM et un ferme-porte automatique Honeywell. Les panneaux acoustiques de 12 mm et la moquette créent un intérieur feutré, tandis que la porte à fermeture automatique facilite les passages quotidiens. La gamme propose en option un bureau réglable en hauteur (730–1200 mm).

• Finition extérieure : Blanc (RAL 9003)
• Dimensions extérieures (L × P × H) : 1074 × 1090 × 2310 mm
• Dimensions intérieures au sol (L × P) : 894 × 920 mm
• Poids : 270 kg
• Capacité : 1 personne (appels, visioconférences et travail concentré)
variants.extended_description_es:
Un lugar más tranquilo para pensar, hablar y trabajar con foco.

Aléjese del ruido ambiental. Sileopod V4-S ofrece un refugio acústico cerrado pensado para 1 persona (llamadas, videollamadas y trabajo individual concentrado) en oficinas abiertas, aeropuertos, espacios públicos y entornos híbridos.

Diseño italiano para la jornada laboral
Desarrollada junto al equipo milanés Morpha, Sileopod combina estética italiana minimalista e ingeniería acústica. El acabado exterior Blanco (RAL 9003) aporta elegancia a cualquier espacio.

Menos distracciones. Más privacidad.
Reducción del nivel de voz de hasta 32 dB (ensayos ISO 23351-1, rendimiento acústico Clase A) para mantener la privacidad de cada conversación.

Aire fresco y montaje rápido
Ventiladores silenciosos renuevan el aire interior cada 60 segundos, con iluminación y ventilación activadas por presencia. Su sistema modular permite el montaje desde 35 minutos.

Construcción de la serie V4
La serie V4 une un bastidor de precisión en aluminio 6063 con juntas EPDM y cierrapuertas automático Honeywell. Los paneles acústicos de 12 mm y la moqueta crean un interior sereno, mientras que la puerta autocierre facilita el uso diario. La gama ofrece opcionalmente un escritorio regulable en altura (730–1200 mm).

Struttura della serie V4
La serie V4 abbina un telaio di precisione in alluminio 6063 a guarnizioni EPDM e chiudiporta automatico Honeywell. La gamma prevede l'opzione scrivania regolabile in altezza (730–1200 mm).

variants.extended_description_en:
A quieter place to think, talk and get things done.

Step away from the open-plan buzz and give your next call, video meeting or focused task a space of its own. A compact personal retreat for phone calls, online meetings and uninterrupted individual work. Sileopod V4-S brings an enclosed acoustic space to offices, public spaces and hybrid workplaces, helping people find focus within a lively shared environment.

Italian design, made for the working day
Developed with Milan design team Morpha, Sileopod combines minimalist Italian styling with acoustic engineering. The Black (RAL 7021) exterior gives this booth a clear identity, whether it blends into a calm office scheme or adds a distinctive accent.

Less distraction. More privacy.
The manufacturer reports speech-level reduction of up to 32 dB for its range, with full-unit testing to ISO 23351-1 and Class A acoustic performance for private calls. In everyday terms, the design helps reduce how much speech carries beyond the booth, so conversations are less distracting to the people working nearby.

Fresh air for a more comfortable workspace
The Sileopod ventilation concept renews the air inside the booth every 60 seconds. Low-noise fans are designed to keep fresh air moving without becoming a distraction, while presence-activated lighting and ventilation make the space convenient to use.

Modular design. Faster setup.
Clip-together components and magnetic panels simplify installation, with assembly in as little as 35 minutes according to the manufacturer. This modular approach makes it easier to introduce a dedicated quiet space into an existing workplace.

Built for everyday use
The V4 pairs a precision 6063 aluminium frame with EPDM seals and a Honeywell automatic door closer. Acoustic panels and carpet create a softer interior, while the self-closing door makes everyday entry and exit straightforward. The range includes a height-adjustable desk option with a 730–1200 mm adjustment range.

Make it fit your space
Interior acoustic panels, carpet and upholstery can be colour-matched to order. Tabletop choices include white, black and oak veneer. Furniture layouts vary by booth size, from individual desk setups to face-to-face seating or meeting furniture; confirm your chosen layout and included items when ordering.

At a glance
Model: V4-S
Exterior finish: Black (RAL 7021)
External dimensions (W × D × H): 1074 × 1090 × 2310 mm.
Internal floor dimensions (W × D): 894 × 920 mm.
Weight: 270 kg.
Capacity: 1 person.
Construction details: 6063 aluminium frame with Honeywell automatic door closer and EPDM seals. 12 mm acoustic panels and carpet. The catalogue lists a height-adjustable desk with a 730–1200 mm range; confirm the supplied furniture configuration when ordering.

The acoustic, air-renewal and assembly figures above are manufacturer-stated range figures. Performance, setup time and equipment depend on the model, configuration and installation conditions.

variants.extended_description_en:
A quieter place to think, talk and get things done.

Step away from the open-plan buzz and give your next call, video meeting or focused task a space of its own. A compact personal retreat for phone calls, online meetings and uninterrupted individual work. Sileopod V4-S brings an enclosed acoustic space to offices, public spaces and hybrid workplaces, helping people find focus within a lively shared environment.

Italian design, made for the working day
Developed with Milan design team Morpha, Sileopod combines minimalist Italian styling with acoustic engineering. The Umbra (RAL 7022) exterior gives this booth a clear identity, whether it blends into a calm office scheme or adds a distinctive accent.

Less distraction. More privacy.
The manufacturer reports speech-level reduction of up to 32 dB for its range, with full-unit testing to ISO 23351-1 and Class A acoustic performance for private calls. In everyday terms, the design helps reduce how much speech carries beyond the booth, so conversations are less distracting to the people working nearby.

Fresh air for a more comfortable workspace
The Sileopod ventilation concept renews the air inside the booth every 60 seconds. Low-noise fans are designed to keep fresh air moving without becoming a distraction, while presence-activated lighting and ventilation make the space convenient to use.

Modular design. Faster setup.
Clip-together components and magnetic panels simplify installation, with assembly in as little as 35 minutes according to the manufacturer. This modular approach makes it easier to introduce a dedicated quiet space into an existing workplace.

Built for everyday use
The V4 pairs a precision 6063 aluminium frame with EPDM seals and a Honeywell automatic door closer. Acoustic panels and carpet create a softer interior, while the self-closing door makes everyday entry and exit straightforward. The range includes a height-adjustable desk option with a 730–1200 mm adjustment range.

Make it fit your space
Interior acoustic panels, carpet and upholstery can be colour-matched to order. Tabletop choices include white, black and oak veneer. Furniture layouts vary by booth size, from individual desk setups to face-to-face seating or meeting furniture; confirm your chosen layout and included items when ordering.

At a glance
Model: V4-S
Exterior finish: Umbra (RAL 7022)
External dimensions (W × D × H): 1074 × 1090 × 2310 mm.
Internal floor dimensions (W × D): 894 × 920 mm.
Weight: 270 kg.
Capacity: 1 person.
Construction details: 6063 aluminium frame with Honeywell automatic door closer and EPDM seals. 12 mm acoustic panels and carpet. The catalogue lists a height-adjustable desk with a 730–1200 mm range; confirm the supplied furniture configuration when ordering.

The acoustic, air-renewal and assembly figures above are manufacturer-stated range figures. Performance, setup time and equipment depend on the model, configuration and installation conditions.

variants.extended_description_en:
A quieter place to think, talk and get things done.

Step away from the open-plan buzz and give your next call, video meeting or focused task a space of its own. A compact personal retreat for phone calls, online meetings and uninterrupted individual work. Sileopod V4-S brings an enclosed acoustic space to offices, public spaces and hybrid workplaces, helping people find focus within a lively shared environment.

Italian design, made for the working day
Developed with Milan design team Morpha, Sileopod combines minimalist Italian styling with acoustic engineering. The Sand (RAL 1002) exterior gives this booth a clear identity, whether it blends into a calm office scheme or adds a distinctive accent.

Less distraction. More privacy.
The manufacturer reports speech-level reduction of up to 32 dB for its range, with full-unit testing to ISO 23351-1 and Class A acoustic performance for private calls. In everyday terms, the design helps reduce how much speech carries beyond the booth, so conversations are less distracting to the people working nearby.

Fresh air for a more comfortable workspace
The Sileopod ventilation concept renews the air inside the booth every 60 seconds. Low-noise fans are designed to keep fresh air moving without becoming a distraction, while presence-activated lighting and ventilation make the space convenient to use.

Modular design. Faster setup.
Clip-together components and magnetic panels simplify installation, with assembly in as little as 35 minutes according to the manufacturer. This modular approach makes it easier to introduce a dedicated quiet space into an existing workplace.

Built for everyday use
The V4 pairs a precision 6063 aluminium frame with EPDM seals and a Honeywell automatic door closer. Acoustic panels and carpet create a softer interior, while the self-closing door makes everyday entry and exit straightforward. The range includes a height-adjustable desk option with a 730–1200 mm adjustment range.

Make it fit your space
Interior acoustic panels, carpet and upholstery can be colour-matched to order. Tabletop choices include white, black and oak veneer. Furniture layouts vary by booth size, from individual desk setups to face-to-face seating or meeting furniture; confirm your chosen layout and included items when ordering.

At a glance
Model: V4-S
Exterior finish: Sand (RAL 1002)
External dimensions (W × D × H): 1074 × 1090 × 2310 mm.
Internal floor dimensions (W × D): 894 × 920 mm.
Weight: 270 kg.
Capacity: 1 person.
Construction details: 6063 aluminium frame with Honeywell automatic door closer and EPDM seals. 12 mm acoustic panels and carpet. The catalogue lists a height-adjustable desk with a 730–1200 mm range; confirm the supplied furniture configuration when ordering.

The acoustic, air-renewal and assembly figures above are manufacturer-stated range figures. Performance, setup time and equipment depend on the model, configuration and installation conditions.

variants.extended_description_de:
Ein ruhigerer Ort zum Denken, Sprechen und konzentrierten Arbeiten.

Lassen Sie den Trubel des Großraumbüros hinter sich. Die Sileopod V4-S bietet Platz für 1 Person (Telefonate, Video-Meetings & konzentrierte Einzelarbeit) und schafft eine geschlossene akustische Rückzugszone in Büros, Flughäfen, Cafés und hybriden Arbeitswelten.

Italienisches Design für den Arbeitsalltag
Entwickelt mit dem Mailänder Designteam Morpha vereint Sileopod minimalistisches italienisches Design mit durchdachter Akustiktechnik. Die Oberfläche in Sandgelb (RAL 1002) fügt sich harmonisch in moderne Räume ein.

Weniger Ablenkung. Mehr Privatsphäre.
Bis zu 32 dB Sprachpegelreduzierung (ISO 23351-1, Akustikklasse A) sorgen dafür, dass vertrauliche Gespräche in der Kabine bleiben und das Umfeld ruhig bleibt.

Frische Luft & schneller Aufbau
Leise Lüfter erneuern die Innenluft alle 60 Sekunden, gesteuert über Präsenzsensoren für Licht und Belüftung. Dank modularer Steck- und Magnetelemente gelingt die Montage ab ca. 35 Minuten.

Konstruktion der Serie V4
Die V4-Serie kombiniert einen präzisen 6063-Aluminiumrahmen mit EPDM-Dichtungen und einem automatischen Honeywell-Türschließer. 12 mm Akustikpaneele und Teppichboden schaffen ein ruhiges Innenklima, während die selbstschließende Tür den täglichen Gebrauch erleichtert. Optional ist ein höhenverstellbarer Schreibtisch (730–1200 mm) erhältlich.

Auf einen Blick
• Modell: V4-S
• Außenfarbe: Sandgelb (RAL 1002)
• Außenmaße (B × T × H): 1074 × 1090 × 2310 mm
• Innenmaße Boden (B × T): 894 × 920 mm
• Gewicht: 270 kg
• Kapazität: 1 Person (Telefonate, Video-Meetings & konzentrierte Einzelarbeit)
variants.extended_description_fr:
Un espace plus calme pour réfléchir, échanger et avancer efficacement.

Éloignez-vous du bruit ambiant. La Sileopod V4-S offre un refuge acoustique conçu pour 1 personne (appels, visioconférences et travail concentré), idéal pour les bureaux ouverts, aéroports, espaces publics et environnements hybrides.

Design italien pensé pour le travail
Conçue avec le studio milanais Morpha, Sileopod allie esthétique italienne minimaliste et ingénierie acoustique. La finition extérieure Sable (RAL 1002) affirme une présence élégante dans tout aménagement.

Moins de bruit. Plus de confidentialité.
Réduction du niveau de parole jusqu'à 32 dB (tests ISO 23351-1, performance acoustique Classe A) pour des appels confidentiels sans déranger l'entourage.

Air renouvelé & montage modulaire
La ventilation silencieuse renouvelle l'air toutes les 60 secondes, avec détection de présence pour l'éclairage et la ventilation. L'assemblage modulaire s'effectue à partir de 35 minutes.

Conception de la série V4
La série V4 associe un châssis de précision en aluminium 6063 à des joints EPDM et un ferme-porte automatique Honeywell. Les panneaux acoustiques de 12 mm et la moquette créent un intérieur feutré, tandis que la porte à fermeture automatique facilite les passages quotidiens. La gamme propose en option un bureau réglable en hauteur (730–1200 mm).

En résumé
• Modèle : V4-S
• Finition extérieure : Sable (RAL 1002)
• Dimensions extérieures (L × P × H) : 1074 × 1090 × 2310 mm
• Dimensions intérieures au sol (L × P) : 894 × 920 mm
• Poids : 270 kg
• Capacité : 1 personne (appels, visioconférences et travail concentré)
variants.extended_description_es:
Un lugar más tranquilo para pensar, hablar y trabajar con foco.

Aléjese del ruido ambiental. Sileopod V4-S ofrece un refugio acústico cerrado pensado para 1 persona (llamadas, videollamadas y trabajo individual concentrado) en oficinas abiertas, aeropuertos, espacios públicos y entornos híbridos.

Diseño italiano para la jornada laboral
Desarrollada junto al equipo milanés Morpha, Sileopod combina estética italiana minimalista e ingeniería acústica. El acabado exterior Arena (RAL 1002) aporta elegancia a cualquier espacio.

Menos distracciones. Más privacidad.
Reducción del nivel de voz de hasta 32 dB (ensayos ISO 23351-1, rendimiento acústico Clase A) para mantener la privacidad de cada conversación.

Aire fresco y montaje rápido
Ventiladores silenciosos renuevan el aire interior cada 60 segundos, con iluminación y ventilación activadas por presencia. Su sistema modular permite el montaje desde 35 minutos.

Construcción de la serie V4
La serie V4 une un bastidor de precisión en aluminio 6063 con juntas EPDM y cierrapuertas automático Honeywell. Los paneles acústicos de 12 mm y la moqueta crean un interior sereno, mientras que la puerta autocierre facilita el uso diario. La gama ofrece opcionalmente un escritorio regulable en altura (730–1200 mm).

De un vistazo
• Modelo: V4-S
• Acabado exterior: Arena (RAL 1002)
• Dimensiones exteriores (An × Pr × Al): 1074 × 1090 × 2310 mm
• Dimensiones interiores de suelo (An × Pr): 894 × 920 mm
• Peso: 270 kg
• Capacidad: 1 persona (llamadas, videollamadas y trabajo individual concentrado)
variants.extended_description_it:
Uno spazio più silenzioso per pensare, parlare e lavorare al meglio.

Allontanati dal brusio dell'open space. Sileopod V4-S offre uno spazio acustico chiuso pensato per 1 persona (chiamate, videochiamate e lavoro individuale concentrato), ideale per uffici, aeroporti, aree pubbliche e ambienti ibridi.

Design italiano per il lavoro quotidiano
Sviluppata con il team milanese Morpha, Sileopod unisce stile italiano minimalista e ingegneria acustica. La finitura esterna Sabbia (RAL 1002) valorizza con equilibrio ogni ambiente.

Meno distrazioni. Più privacy.
Riduzione del livello vocale fino a 32 dB (test ISO 23351-1, classe acustica A) per conversazioni riservate senza disturbare chi lavora vicino.

Aria sempre fresca e montaggio rapido
Ventole silenziose rinnovano l'aria ogni 60 secondi con accensione automatica di luce e ventilazione tramite sensore di presenza. La struttura modulare consente il montaggio a partire da 35 minuti.

Struttura della serie V4
La serie V4 abbina un telaio di precisione in alluminio 6063 a guarnizioni EPDM e chiudiporta automatico Honeywell. I pannelli acustici da 12 mm e la moquette rendono l'interno confortevole, mentre la porta autochiudente agevola l'uso quotidiano. La gamma prevede l'opzione scrivania regolabile in altezza (730–1200 mm).

In sintesi
• Modello: V4-S
• Finitura esterna: Sabbia (RAL 1002)
• Dimensioni esterne (L × P × A): 1074 × 1090 × 2310 mm
• Dimensioni interne pavimento (L × P): 894 × 920 mm
• Peso: 270 kg
• Capacità: 1 persona (chiamate, videochiamate e lavoro individuale concentrato)
variants.extended_description_por:
Um espaço mais silencioso para pensar, falar e trabalhar com concentração.

Afaste-se do ruído dos espaços abertos. A Sileopod V4-S cria um refúgio acústico fechado para 1 pessoa (chamadas, videochamadas e trabalho individual focado), ideal para escritórios, aeroportos, espaços públicos e ambientes híbridos.

Design italiano para o dia de trabalho
Desenvolvida com a equipa de design milanesa Morpha, a Sileopod combina linhas minimalistas italianas com engenharia acústica. O acabamento exterior Areia (RAL 1002) integra-se perfeitamente em interiores modernos.

Menos distrações. Mais privacidade.
Redução do nível de voz até 32 dB (testes ISO 23351-1, desempenho acústico Classe A) para chamadas confidenciais sem perturbar quem trabalha por perto.

Ar fresco e montagem modular
Ventiladores silenciosos renovam o ar interior a cada 60 segundos, com iluminação e ventilação ativadas por sensor de presença. A construção modular permite montagem a partir de 35 minutos.

Construção da série V4
A série V4 combina uma estrutura de precisão em alumínio 6063 com vedantes EPDM e mola de porta automática Honeywell. Os painéis acústicos de 12 mm e a alcatifa proporcionam um interior acolhedor, enquanto a porta de fecho automático facilita o uso diário. A gama inclui a opção de secretária regulável em altura (730–1200 mm).

Em resumo
• Modelo: V4-S
• Acabamento exterior: Areia (RAL 1002)
• Dimensões exteriores (L × P × A): 1074 × 1090 × 2310 mm
• Dimensões interiores do piso (L × P): 894 × 920 mm
• Peso: 270 kg
• Capacidade: 1 pessoa (chamadas, videochamadas e trabalho individual focado)

Aléjese del ruido ambiental. Sileopod V4-S ofrece un refugio acústico cerrado pensado para 1 persona (llamadas, videollamadas y trabajo individual concentrado) en oficinas abiertas, aeropuertos, espacios públicos y entornos híbridos.

Diseño italiano para la jornada laboral
Desarrollada junto al equipo milanés Morpha, Sileopod combina estética italiana minimalista e ingeniería acústica. El acabado exterior Cemento (RAL 7033) aporta elegancia a cualquier espacio.

Menos distracciones. Más privacidad.
Reducción del nivel de voz de hasta 32 dB (ensayos ISO 23351-1, rendimiento acústico Clase A) para mantener la privacidad de cada conversación.

Aire fresco y montaje rápido
Ventiladores silenciosos renuevan el aire interior cada 60 segundos, con iluminación y ventilación activadas por presencia. Su sistema modular permite el montaje desde 35 minutos.

Construcción de la serie V4
La serie V4 une un bastidor de precisión en aluminio 6063 con juntas EPDM y cierrapuertas automático Honeywell. Los paneles acústicos de 12 mm y la moqueta crean un interior sereno, mientras que la puerta autocierre facilita el uso diario. La gama ofrece opcionalmente un escritorio regulable en altura (730–1200 mm).

• Acabado exterior: Cemento (RAL 7033)
• Dimensiones exteriores (An × Pr × Al): 1074 × 1090 × 2310 mm
• Dimensiones interiores de suelo (An × Pr): 894 × 920 mm
• Peso: 270 kg
• Capacidad: 1 persona (llamadas, videollamadas y trabajo individual concentrado)
variants.extended_description_it:
Uno spazio più silenzioso per pensare, parlare e lavorare al meglio.

Allontanati dal brusio dell'open space. Sileopod V4-S offre uno spazio acustico chiuso pensato per 1 persona (chiamate, videochiamate e lavoro individuale concentrato), ideale per uffici, aeroporti, aree pubbliche e ambienti ibridi.

Design italiano per il lavoro quotidiano
Sviluppata con il team milanese Morpha, Sileopod unisce stile italiano minimalista e ingegneria acustica. La finitura esterna Cemento (RAL 7033) valorizza con equilibrio ogni ambiente.

Meno distrazioni. Più privacy.
Riduzione del livello vocale fino a 32 dB (test ISO 23351-1, classe acustica A) per conversazioni riservate senza disturbare chi lavora vicino.

Aria sempre fresca e montaggio rapido
Ventole silenziose rinnovano l'aria ogni 60 secondi con accensione automatica di luce e ventilazione tramite sensore di presenza. La struttura modulare consente il montaggio a partire da 35 minuti.

Struttura della serie V4
La serie V4 abbina un telaio di precisione in alluminio 6063 a guarnizioni EPDM e chiudiporta automatico Honeywell. I pannelli acustici da 12 mm e la moquette rendono l'interno confortevole, mentre la porta autochiudente agevola l'uso quotidiano. La gamma prevede l'opzione scrivania regolabile in altezza (730–1200 mm).

variants.extended_description_por:
Um espaço mais silencioso para pensar, falar e trabalhar com concentração.

Afaste-se do ruído dos espaços abertos. A Sileopod V4-S cria um refúgio acústico fechado para 1 pessoa (chamadas, videochamadas e trabalho individual focado), ideal para escritórios, aeroportos, espaços públicos e ambientes híbridos.

Design italiano para o dia de trabalho
Desenvolvida com a equipa de design milanesa Morpha, a Sileopod combina linhas minimalistas italianas com engenharia acústica. O acabamento exterior Cimento (RAL 7033) integra-se perfeitamente em interiores modernos.

Menos distrações. Mais privacidade.
Redução do nível de voz até 32 dB (testes ISO 23351-1, desempenho acústico Classe A) para chamadas confidenciais sem perturbar quem trabalha por perto.

Ar fresco e montagem modular
Ventiladores silenciosos renovam o ar interior a cada 60 segundos, com iluminação e ventilação ativadas por sensor de presença. A construção modular permite montagem a partir de 35 minutos.

Construção da série V4
A série V4 combina uma estrutura de precisão em alumínio 6063 com vedantes EPDM e mola de porta automática Honeywell. Os painéis acústicos de 12 mm e a alcatifa proporcionam um interior acolhedor, enquanto a porta de fecho automático facilita o uso diário. A gama inclui a opção de secretária regulável em altura (730–1200 mm).

• Dimensões interiores do piso (L × P): 894 × 920 mm
• Peso: 270 kg

variants.extended_description_en:
A quieter place to think, talk and get things done.

Step away from the open-plan buzz and give your next call, video meeting or focused task a space of its own. A compact personal retreat for phone calls, online meetings and uninterrupted individual work. Sileopod V4-S brings an enclosed acoustic space to offices, public spaces and hybrid workplaces, helping people find focus within a lively shared environment.

Italian design, made for the working day
Developed with Milan design team Morpha, Sileopod combines minimalist Italian styling with acoustic engineering. The Red (RAL 3013) exterior gives this booth a clear identity, whether it blends into a calm office scheme or adds a distinctive accent.

Less distraction. More privacy.
The manufacturer reports speech-level reduction of up to 32 dB for its range, with full-unit testing to ISO 23351-1 and Class A acoustic performance for private calls. In everyday terms, the design helps reduce how much speech carries beyond the booth, so conversations are less distracting to the people working nearby.

Fresh air for a more comfortable workspace
The Sileopod ventilation concept renews the air inside the booth every 60 seconds. Low-noise fans are designed to keep fresh air moving without becoming a distraction, while presence-activated lighting and ventilation make the space convenient to use.

Modular design. Faster setup.
Clip-together components and magnetic panels simplify installation, with assembly in as little as 35 minutes according to the manufacturer. This modular approach makes it easier to introduce a dedicated quiet space into an existing workplace.

Built for everyday use
The V4 pairs a precision 6063 aluminium frame with EPDM seals and a Honeywell automatic door closer. Acoustic panels and carpet create a softer interior, while the self-closing door makes everyday entry and exit straightforward. The range includes a height-adjustable desk option with a 730–1200 mm adjustment range.

Make it fit your space
Interior acoustic panels, carpet and upholstery can be colour-matched to order. Tabletop choices include white, black and oak veneer. Furniture layouts vary by booth size, from individual desk setups to face-to-face seating or meeting furniture; confirm your chosen layout and included items when ordering.

At a glance
Model: V4-S
Exterior finish: Red (RAL 3013)
External dimensions (W × D × H): 1074 × 1090 × 2310 mm.
Internal floor dimensions (W × D): 894 × 920 mm.
Weight: 270 kg.
Capacity: 1 person.
Construction details: 6063 aluminium frame with Honeywell automatic door closer and EPDM seals. 12 mm acoustic panels and carpet. The catalogue lists a height-adjustable desk with a 730–1200 mm range; confirm the supplied furniture configuration when ordering.

The acoustic, air-renewal and assembly figures above are manufacturer-stated range figures. Performance, setup time and equipment depend on the model, configuration and installation conditions.

variants.extended_description_de:
Ein ruhigerer Ort zum Denken, Sprechen und konzentrierten Arbeiten.

Lassen Sie den Trubel des Großraumbüros hinter sich. Die Sileopod V4-S bietet Platz für 1 Person (Telefonate, Video-Meetings & konzentrierte Einzelarbeit) und schafft eine geschlossene akustische Rückzugszone in Büros, Flughäfen, Cafés und hybriden Arbeitswelten.

Italienisches Design für den Arbeitsalltag
Entwickelt mit dem Mailänder Designteam Morpha vereint Sileopod minimalistisches italienisches Design mit durchdachter Akustiktechnik. Die Oberfläche in Tomatenrot (RAL 3013) fügt sich harmonisch in moderne Räume ein.

Weniger Ablenkung. Mehr Privatsphäre.
Bis zu 32 dB Sprachpegelreduzierung (ISO 23351-1, Akustikklasse A) sorgen dafür, dass vertrauliche Gespräche in der Kabine bleiben und das Umfeld ruhig bleibt.

Frische Luft & schneller Aufbau
Leise Lüfter erneuern die Innenluft alle 60 Sekunden, gesteuert über Präsenzsensoren für Licht und Belüftung. Dank modularer Steck- und Magnetelemente gelingt die Montage ab ca. 35 Minuten.

Konstruktion der Serie V4
Die V4-Serie kombiniert einen präzisen 6063-Aluminiumrahmen mit EPDM-Dichtungen und einem automatischen Honeywell-Türschließer. 12 mm Akustikpaneele und Teppichboden schaffen ein ruhiges Innenklima, während die selbstschließende Tür den täglichen Gebrauch erleichtert. Optional ist ein höhenverstellbarer Schreibtisch (730–1200 mm) erhältlich.

Auf einen Blick
• Modell: V4-S
• Außenfarbe: Tomatenrot (RAL 3013)
• Außenmaße (B × T × H): 1074 × 1090 × 2310 mm
• Innenmaße Boden (B × T): 894 × 920 mm
• Gewicht: 270 kg
• Kapazität: 1 Person (Telefonate, Video-Meetings & konzentrierte Einzelarbeit)
variants.extended_description_fr:
Un espace plus calme pour réfléchir, échanger et avancer efficacement.

Moins de bruit. Plus de confidentialité.

La gamme propose en option un bureau réglable en hauteur (730–1200 mm).

variants.extended_description_en:
A quieter place to think, talk and get things done.

Step away from the open-plan buzz and give your next call, video meeting or focused task a space of its own. A compact personal retreat for phone calls, online meetings and uninterrupted individual work. Sileopod V4-S brings an enclosed acoustic space to offices, public spaces and hybrid workplaces, helping people find focus within a lively shared environment.

Italian design, made for the working day
Developed with Milan design team Morpha, Sileopod combines minimalist Italian styling with acoustic engineering. The Green (RAL 6005) exterior gives this booth a clear identity, whether it blends into a calm office scheme or adds a distinctive accent.

Less distraction. More privacy.
The manufacturer reports speech-level reduction of up to 32 dB for its range, with full-unit testing to ISO 23351-1 and Class A acoustic performance for private calls. In everyday terms, the design helps reduce how much speech carries beyond the booth, so conversations are less distracting to the people working nearby.

Fresh air for a more comfortable workspace
The Sileopod ventilation concept renews the air inside the booth every 60 seconds. Low-noise fans are designed to keep fresh air moving without becoming a distraction, while presence-activated lighting and ventilation make the space convenient to use.

Modular design. Faster setup.
Clip-together components and magnetic panels simplify installation, with assembly in as little as 35 minutes according to the manufacturer. This modular approach makes it easier to introduce a dedicated quiet space into an existing workplace.

Built for everyday use
The V4 pairs a precision 6063 aluminium frame with EPDM seals and a Honeywell automatic door closer. Acoustic panels and carpet create a softer interior, while the self-closing door makes everyday entry and exit straightforward. The range includes a height-adjustable desk option with a 730–1200 mm adjustment range.

Make it fit your space
Interior acoustic panels, carpet and upholstery can be colour-matched to order. Tabletop choices include white, black and oak veneer. Furniture layouts vary by booth size, from individual desk setups to face-to-face seating or meeting furniture; confirm your chosen layout and included items when ordering.

At a glance
Model: V4-S
Exterior finish: Green (RAL 6005)
External dimensions (W × D × H): 1074 × 1090 × 2310 mm.
Internal floor dimensions (W × D): 894 × 920 mm.
Weight: 270 kg.
Capacity: 1 person.
Construction details: 6063 aluminium frame with Honeywell automatic door closer and EPDM seals. 12 mm acoustic panels and carpet. The catalogue lists a height-adjustable desk with a 730–1200 mm range; confirm the supplied furniture configuration when ordering.

The acoustic, air-renewal and assembly figures above are manufacturer-stated range figures. Performance, setup time and equipment depend on the model, configuration and installation conditions.

variants.extended_description_de:
Ein ruhigerer Ort zum Denken, Sprechen und konzentrierten Arbeiten.

Lassen Sie den Trubel des Großraumbüros hinter sich. Die Sileopod V4-S bietet Platz für 1 Person (Telefonate, Video-Meetings & konzentrierte Einzelarbeit) und schafft eine geschlossene akustische Rückzugszone in Büros, Flughäfen, Cafés und hybriden Arbeitswelten.

Italienisches Design für den Arbeitsalltag
Entwickelt mit dem Mailänder Designteam Morpha vereint Sileopod minimalistisches italienisches Design mit durchdachter Akustiktechnik. Die Oberfläche in Moosgrün (RAL 6005) fügt sich harmonisch in moderne Räume ein.

Weniger Ablenkung. Mehr Privatsphäre.
Bis zu 32 dB Sprachpegelreduzierung (ISO 23351-1, Akustikklasse A) sorgen dafür, dass vertrauliche Gespräche in der Kabine bleiben und das Umfeld ruhig bleibt.

Frische Luft & schneller Aufbau
Leise Lüfter erneuern die Innenluft alle 60 Sekunden, gesteuert über Präsenzsensoren für Licht und Belüftung. Dank modularer Steck- und Magnetelemente gelingt die Montage ab ca. 35 Minuten.

Konstruktion der Serie V4
Die V4-Serie kombiniert einen präzisen 6063-Aluminiumrahmen mit EPDM-Dichtungen und einem automatischen Honeywell-Türschließer. 12 mm Akustikpaneele und Teppichboden schaffen ein ruhiges Innenklima, während die selbstschließende Tür den täglichen Gebrauch erleichtert. Optional ist ein höhenverstellbarer Schreibtisch (730–1200 mm) erhältlich.

• Außenfarbe: Moosgrün (RAL 6005)
• Außenmaße (B × T × H): 1074 × 1090 × 2310 mm
• Innenmaße Boden (B × T): 894 × 920 mm
• Gewicht: 270 kg
• Kapazität: 1 Person (Telefonate, Video-Meetings & konzentrierte Einzelarbeit)
variants.extended_description_fr:

Design italien pensé pour le travail
Conçue avec le studio milanais Morpha, Sileopod allie esthétique italienne minimaliste et ingénierie acoustique. La finition extérieure Vert (RAL 6005) affirme une présence élégante dans tout aménagement.

Moins de bruit. Plus de confidentialité.
Réduction du niveau de parole jusqu'à 32 dB (tests ISO 23351-1, performance acoustique Classe A) pour des appels confidentiels sans déranger l'entourage.

Air renouvelé & montage modulaire
La ventilation silencieuse renouvelle l'air toutes les 60 secondes, avec détection de présence pour l'éclairage et la ventilation. L'assemblage modulaire s'effectue à partir de 35 minutes.

Conception de la série V4
La série V4 associe un châssis de précision en aluminium 6063 à des joints EPDM et un ferme-porte automatique Honeywell. Les panneaux acoustiques de 12 mm et la moquette créent un intérieur feutré, tandis que la porte à fermeture automatique facilite les passages quotidiens. La gamme propose en option un bureau réglable en hauteur (730–1200 mm).

• Poids : 270 kg
• Capacité : 1 personne (appels, visioconférences et travail concentré)

variants.extended_description_en:
A quieter place to think, talk and get things done.

Step away from the open-plan buzz and give your next call, video meeting or focused task a space of its own. A compact personal retreat for phone calls, online meetings and uninterrupted individual work. Sileopod V4-S brings an enclosed acoustic space to offices, public spaces and hybrid workplaces, helping people find focus within a lively shared environment.

Italian design, made for the working day
Developed with Milan design team Morpha, Sileopod combines minimalist Italian styling with acoustic engineering. The Altrosa (RAL 3014) exterior gives this booth a clear identity, whether it blends into a calm office scheme or adds a distinctive accent.

Less distraction. More privacy.
The manufacturer reports speech-level reduction of up to 32 dB for its range, with full-unit testing to ISO 23351-1 and Class A acoustic performance for private calls. In everyday terms, the design helps reduce how much speech carries beyond the booth, so conversations are less distracting to the people working nearby.

Fresh air for a more comfortable workspace
The Sileopod ventilation concept renews the air inside the booth every 60 seconds. Low-noise fans are designed to keep fresh air moving without becoming a distraction, while presence-activated lighting and ventilation make the space convenient to use.

Modular design. Faster setup.
Clip-together components and magnetic panels simplify installation, with assembly in as little as 35 minutes according to the manufacturer. This modular approach makes it easier to introduce a dedicated quiet space into an existing workplace.

Built for everyday use
The V4 pairs a precision 6063 aluminium frame with EPDM seals and a Honeywell automatic door closer. Acoustic panels and carpet create a softer interior, while the self-closing door makes everyday entry and exit straightforward. The range includes a height-adjustable desk option with a 730–1200 mm adjustment range.

Make it fit your space
Interior acoustic panels, carpet and upholstery can be colour-matched to order. Tabletop choices include white, black and oak veneer. Furniture layouts vary by booth size, from individual desk setups to face-to-face seating or meeting furniture; confirm your chosen layout and included items when ordering.

Ein ruhigerer Ort zum Denken, Sprechen und konzentrierten Arbeiten.

Lassen Sie den Trubel des Großraumbüros hinter sich. Die Sileopod V4-S bietet Platz für 1 Person (Telefonate, Video-Meetings & konzentrierte Einzelarbeit) und schafft eine geschlossene akustische Rückzugszone in Büros, Flughäfen, Cafés und hybriden Arbeitswelten.

Italienisches Design für den Arbeitsalltag
Entwickelt mit dem Mailänder Designteam Morpha vereint Sileopod minimalistisches italienisches Design mit durchdachter Akustiktechnik. Die Oberfläche in Altrosa (RAL 3014) fügt sich harmonisch in moderne Räume ein.

Weniger Ablenkung. Mehr Privatsphäre.
Bis zu 32 dB Sprachpegelreduzierung (ISO 23351-1, Akustikklasse A) sorgen dafür, dass vertrauliche Gespräche in der Kabine bleiben und das Umfeld ruhig bleibt.

Frische Luft & schneller Aufbau
Leise Lüfter erneuern die Innenluft alle 60 Sekunden, gesteuert über Präsenzsensoren für Licht und Belüftung. Dank modularer Steck- und Magnetelemente gelingt die Montage ab ca. 35 Minuten.

Die V4-Serie kombiniert einen präzisen 6063-Aluminiumrahmen mit EPDM-Dichtungen und einem automatischen Honeywell-Türschließer. 12 mm Akustikpaneele und Teppichboden schaffen ein ruhiges Innenklima, während die selbstschließende Tür den täglichen Gebrauch erleichtert. Optional ist ein höhenverstellbarer Schreibtisch (730–1200 mm) erhältlich.

Design italien pensé pour le travail
Conçue avec le studio milanais Morpha, Sileopod allie esthétique italienne minimaliste et ingénierie acoustique. La finition extérieure Vieux Rose (RAL 3014) affirme une présence élégante dans tout aménagement.

variants.extended_description_en:
A quieter place to think, talk and get things done.

Bring a little more privacy to the conversations that matter, with a dedicated space for two. Room for two makes it a practical choice for one-to-one meetings, interviews, collaborative work and video calls. Sileopod V4-M brings an enclosed acoustic space to offices, public spaces and hybrid workplaces, helping people find focus within a lively shared environment.

Italian design, made for the working day
Developed with Milan design team Morpha, Sileopod combines minimalist Italian styling with acoustic engineering. The Black (RAL 7021) exterior gives this booth a clear identity, whether it blends into a calm office scheme or adds a distinctive accent.

Less distraction. More privacy.
The manufacturer reports speech-level reduction of up to 32 dB for its range, with full-unit testing to ISO 23351-1 and Class A acoustic performance for private calls. In everyday terms, the design helps reduce how much speech carries beyond the booth, so conversations are less distracting to the people working nearby.

Fresh air for a more comfortable workspace
The Sileopod ventilation concept renews the air inside the booth every 60 seconds. Low-noise fans are designed to keep fresh air moving without becoming a distraction, while presence-activated lighting and ventilation make the space convenient to use.

Modular design. Faster setup.
Clip-together components and magnetic panels simplify installation, with assembly in as little as 35 minutes according to the manufacturer. This modular approach makes it easier to introduce a dedicated quiet space into an existing workplace.

Built for everyday use
The V4 pairs a precision 6063 aluminium frame with EPDM seals and a Honeywell automatic door closer. Acoustic panels and carpet create a softer interior, while the self-closing door makes everyday entry and exit straightforward. The range includes a height-adjustable desk option with a 730–1200 mm adjustment range.

Make it fit your space
Interior acoustic panels, carpet and upholstery can be colour-matched to order. Tabletop choices include white, black and oak veneer. Furniture layouts vary by booth size, from individual desk setups to face-to-face seating or meeting furniture; confirm your chosen layout and included items when ordering.

At a glance
Model: V4-M
Exterior finish: Black (RAL 7021)
External dimensions (W × D × H): 1620 × 1390 × 2310 mm.
Internal floor dimensions (W × D): 1440 × 1220 mm.
Weight: 370 kg.
Capacity: 2 people.
Construction details: 6063 aluminium frame with Honeywell automatic door closer and EPDM seals. 12 mm acoustic panels and carpet. The catalogue lists a height-adjustable desk with a 730–1200 mm range; confirm the supplied furniture configuration when ordering.

The acoustic, air-renewal and assembly figures above are manufacturer-stated range figures. Performance, setup time and equipment depend on the model, configuration and installation conditions.

variants.extended_description_en:
A quieter place to think, talk and get things done.

Bring a little more privacy to the conversations that matter, with a dedicated space for two. Room for two makes it a practical choice for one-to-one meetings, interviews, collaborative work and video calls. Sileopod V4-M brings an enclosed acoustic space to offices, public spaces and hybrid workplaces, helping people find focus within a lively shared environment.

Italian design, made for the working day
Developed with Milan design team Morpha, Sileopod combines minimalist Italian styling with acoustic engineering. The Umbra (RAL 7022) exterior gives this booth a clear identity, whether it blends into a calm office scheme or adds a distinctive accent.

Less distraction. More privacy.
The manufacturer reports speech-level reduction of up to 32 dB for its range, with full-unit testing to ISO 23351-1 and Class A acoustic performance for private calls. In everyday terms, the design helps reduce how much speech carries beyond the booth, so conversations are less distracting to the people working nearby.

Fresh air for a more comfortable workspace
The Sileopod ventilation concept renews the air inside the booth every 60 seconds. Low-noise fans are designed to keep fresh air moving without becoming a distraction, while presence-activated lighting and ventilation make the space convenient to use.

Modular design. Faster setup.
Clip-together components and magnetic panels simplify installation, with assembly in as little as 35 minutes according to the manufacturer. This modular approach makes it easier to introduce a dedicated quiet space into an existing workplace.

Built for everyday use
The V4 pairs a precision 6063 aluminium frame with EPDM seals and a Honeywell automatic door closer. Acoustic panels and carpet create a softer interior, while the self-closing door makes everyday entry and exit straightforward. The range includes a height-adjustable desk option with a 730–1200 mm adjustment range.

Make it fit your space
Interior acoustic panels, carpet and upholstery can be colour-matched to order. Tabletop choices include white, black and oak veneer. Furniture layouts vary by booth size, from individual desk setups to face-to-face seating or meeting furniture; confirm your chosen layout and included items when ordering.

At a glance
Model: V4-M
Exterior finish: Umbra (RAL 7022)
External dimensions (W × D × H): 1620 × 1390 × 2310 mm.
Internal floor dimensions (W × D): 1440 × 1220 mm.
Weight: 370 kg.
Capacity: 2 people.
Construction details: 6063 aluminium frame with Honeywell automatic door closer and EPDM seals. 12 mm acoustic panels and carpet. The catalogue lists a height-adjustable desk with a 730–1200 mm range; confirm the supplied furniture configuration when ordering.

The acoustic, air-renewal and assembly figures above are manufacturer-stated range figures. Performance, setup time and equipment depend on the model, configuration and installation conditions.

variants.extended_description_en:
A quieter place to think, talk and get things done.

Bring a little more privacy to the conversations that matter, with a dedicated space for two. Room for two makes it a practical choice for one-to-one meetings, interviews, collaborative work and video calls. Sileopod V4-M brings an enclosed acoustic space to offices, public spaces and hybrid workplaces, helping people find focus within a lively shared environment.

Italian design, made for the working day
Developed with Milan design team Morpha, Sileopod combines minimalist Italian styling with acoustic engineering. The Sand (RAL 1002) exterior gives this booth a clear identity, whether it blends into a calm office scheme or adds a distinctive accent.

Less distraction. More privacy.
The manufacturer reports speech-level reduction of up to 32 dB for its range, with full-unit testing to ISO 23351-1 and Class A acoustic performance for private calls. In everyday terms, the design helps reduce how much speech carries beyond the booth, so conversations are less distracting to the people working nearby.

Fresh air for a more comfortable workspace
The Sileopod ventilation concept renews the air inside the booth every 60 seconds. Low-noise fans are designed to keep fresh air moving without becoming a distraction, while presence-activated lighting and ventilation make the space convenient to use.

Modular design. Faster setup.
Clip-together components and magnetic panels simplify installation, with assembly in as little as 35 minutes according to the manufacturer. This modular approach makes it easier to introduce a dedicated quiet space into an existing workplace.

Built for everyday use
The V4 pairs a precision 6063 aluminium frame with EPDM seals and a Honeywell automatic door closer. Acoustic panels and carpet create a softer interior, while the self-closing door makes everyday entry and exit straightforward. The range includes a height-adjustable desk option with a 730–1200 mm adjustment range.

Make it fit your space
Interior acoustic panels, carpet and upholstery can be colour-matched to order. Tabletop choices include white, black and oak veneer. Furniture layouts vary by booth size, from individual desk setups to face-to-face seating or meeting furniture; confirm your chosen layout and included items when ordering.

At a glance
Model: V4-M
Exterior finish: Sand (RAL 1002)
External dimensions (W × D × H): 1620 × 1390 × 2310 mm.
Internal floor dimensions (W × D): 1440 × 1220 mm.
Weight: 370 kg.
Capacity: 2 people.
Construction details: 6063 aluminium frame with Honeywell automatic door closer and EPDM seals. 12 mm acoustic panels and carpet. The catalogue lists a height-adjustable desk with a 730–1200 mm range; confirm the supplied furniture configuration when ordering.

The acoustic, air-renewal and assembly figures above are manufacturer-stated range figures. Performance, setup time and equipment depend on the model, configuration and installation conditions.

variants.extended_description_de:
Ein ruhigerer Ort zum Denken, Sprechen und konzentrierten Arbeiten.

Lassen Sie den Trubel des Großraumbüros hinter sich. Die Sileopod V4-M bietet Platz für 2 Personen (1:1-Gespräche, Interviews & gemeinsames Arbeiten) und schafft eine geschlossene akustische Rückzugszone in Büros, Flughäfen, Cafés und hybriden Arbeitswelten.

Italienisches Design für den Arbeitsalltag
Entwickelt mit dem Mailänder Designteam Morpha vereint Sileopod minimalistisches italienisches Design mit durchdachter Akustiktechnik. Die Oberfläche in Sandgelb (RAL 1002) fügt sich harmonisch in moderne Räume ein.

Weniger Ablenkung. Mehr Privatsphäre.
Bis zu 32 dB Sprachpegelreduzierung (ISO 23351-1, Akustikklasse A) sorgen dafür, dass vertrauliche Gespräche in der Kabine bleiben und das Umfeld ruhig bleibt.

Frische Luft & schneller Aufbau
Leise Lüfter erneuern die Innenluft alle 60 Sekunden, gesteuert über Präsenzsensoren für Licht und Belüftung. Dank modularer Steck- und Magnetelemente gelingt die Montage ab ca. 35 Minuten.

Konstruktion der Serie V4
Die V4-Serie kombiniert einen präzisen 6063-Aluminiumrahmen mit EPDM-Dichtungen und einem automatischen Honeywell-Türschließer. 12 mm Akustikpaneele und Teppichboden schaffen ein ruhiges Innenklima, während die selbstschließende Tür den täglichen Gebrauch erleichtert. Optional ist ein höhenverstellbarer Schreibtisch (730–1200 mm) erhältlich.

Auf einen Blick
• Modell: V4-M
• Außenfarbe: Sandgelb (RAL 1002)
• Außenmaße (B × T × H): 1620 × 1390 × 2310 mm
• Innenmaße Boden (B × T): 1440 × 1220 mm
• Gewicht: 370 kg
• Kapazität: 2 Personen (1:1-Gespräche, Interviews & gemeinsames Arbeiten)
variants.extended_description_fr:
Un espace plus calme pour réfléchir, échanger et avancer efficacement.

Éloignez-vous du bruit ambiant. La Sileopod V4-M offre un refuge acoustique conçu pour 2 personnes (entretiens, réunions en duo et travail collaboratif), idéal pour les bureaux ouverts, aéroports, espaces publics et environnements hybrides.

Design italien pensé pour le travail
Conçue avec le studio milanais Morpha, Sileopod allie esthétique italienne minimaliste et ingénierie acoustique. La finition extérieure Sable (RAL 1002) affirme une présence élégante dans tout aménagement.

Moins de bruit. Plus de confidentialité.
Réduction du niveau de parole jusqu'à 32 dB (tests ISO 23351-1, performance acoustique Classe A) pour des appels confidentiels sans déranger l'entourage.

Air renouvelé & montage modulaire
La ventilation silencieuse renouvelle l'air toutes les 60 secondes, avec détection de présence pour l'éclairage et la ventilation. L'assemblage modulaire s'effectue à partir de 35 minutes.

Conception de la série V4
La série V4 associe un châssis de précision en aluminium 6063 à des joints EPDM et un ferme-porte automatique Honeywell. Les panneaux acoustiques de 12 mm et la moquette créent un intérieur feutré, tandis que la porte à fermeture automatique facilite les passages quotidiens. La gamme propose en option un bureau réglable en hauteur (730–1200 mm).

En résumé
• Modèle : V4-M
• Finition extérieure : Sable (RAL 1002)
• Dimensions extérieures (L × P × H) : 1620 × 1390 × 2310 mm
• Dimensions intérieures au sol (L × P) : 1440 × 1220 mm
• Poids : 370 kg
• Capacité : 2 personnes (entretiens, réunions en duo et travail collaboratif)
variants.extended_description_es:
Un lugar más tranquilo para pensar, hablar y trabajar con foco.

Aléjese del ruido ambiental. Sileopod V4-M ofrece un refugio acústico cerrado pensado para 2 personas (reuniones uno a uno, entrevistas y trabajo colaborativo) en oficinas abiertas, aeropuertos, espacios públicos y entornos híbridos.

Diseño italiano para la jornada laboral
Desarrollada junto al equipo milanés Morpha, Sileopod combina estética italiana minimalista e ingeniería acústica. El acabado exterior Arena (RAL 1002) aporta elegancia a cualquier espacio.

Menos distracciones. Más privacidad.
Reducción del nivel de voz de hasta 32 dB (ensayos ISO 23351-1, rendimiento acústico Clase A) para mantener la privacidad de cada conversación.

Aire fresco y montaje rápido
Ventiladores silenciosos renuevan el aire interior cada 60 segundos, con iluminación y ventilación activadas por presencia. Su sistema modular permite el montaje desde 35 minutos.

Construcción de la serie V4
La serie V4 une un bastidor de precisión en aluminio 6063 con juntas EPDM y cierrapuertas automático Honeywell. Los paneles acústicos de 12 mm y la moqueta crean un interior sereno, mientras que la puerta autocierre facilita el uso diario. La gama ofrece opcionalmente un escritorio regulable en altura (730–1200 mm).

De un vistazo
• Modelo: V4-M
• Acabado exterior: Arena (RAL 1002)
• Dimensiones exteriores (An × Pr × Al): 1620 × 1390 × 2310 mm
• Dimensiones interiores de suelo (An × Pr): 1440 × 1220 mm
• Peso: 370 kg
• Capacidad: 2 personas (reuniones uno a uno, entrevistas y trabajo colaborativo)
variants.extended_description_it:
Uno spazio più silenzioso per pensare, parlare e lavorare al meglio.

Allontanati dal brusio dell'open space. Sileopod V4-M offre uno spazio acustico chiuso pensato per 2 persone (colloqui, riunioni a due e lavoro collaborativo), ideale per uffici, aeroporti, aree pubbliche e ambienti ibridi.

Design italiano per il lavoro quotidiano
Sviluppata con il team milanese Morpha, Sileopod unisce stile italiano minimalista e ingegneria acustica. La finitura esterna Sabbia (RAL 1002) valorizza con equilibrio ogni ambiente.

Meno distrazioni. Più privacy.
Riduzione del livello vocale fino a 32 dB (test ISO 23351-1, classe acustica A) per conversazioni riservate senza disturbare chi lavora vicino.

Aria sempre fresca e montaggio rapido
Ventole silenziose rinnovano l'aria ogni 60 secondi con accensione automatica di luce e ventilazione tramite sensore di presenza. La struttura modulare consente il montaggio a partire da 35 minuti.

Struttura della serie V4
La serie V4 abbina un telaio di precisione in alluminio 6063 a guarnizioni EPDM e chiudiporta automatico Honeywell. I pannelli acustici da 12 mm e la moquette rendono l'interno confortevole, mentre la porta autochiudente agevola l'uso quotidiano. La gamma prevede l'opzione scrivania regolabile in altezza (730–1200 mm).

In sintesi
• Modello: V4-M
• Finitura esterna: Sabbia (RAL 1002)
• Dimensioni esterne (L × P × A): 1620 × 1390 × 2310 mm
• Dimensioni interne pavimento (L × P): 1440 × 1220 mm
• Peso: 370 kg
• Capacità: 2 persone (colloqui, riunioni a due e lavoro collaborativo)
variants.extended_description_por:
Um espaço mais silencioso para pensar, falar e trabalhar com concentração.

Afaste-se do ruído dos espaços abertos. A Sileopod V4-M cria um refúgio acústico fechado para 2 pessoas (reuniões individuais, entrevistas e trabalho colaborativo), ideal para escritórios, aeroportos, espaços públicos e ambientes híbridos.

Design italiano para o dia de trabalho
Desenvolvida com a equipa de design milanesa Morpha, a Sileopod combina linhas minimalistas italianas com engenharia acústica. O acabamento exterior Areia (RAL 1002) integra-se perfeitamente em interiores modernos.

Menos distrações. Mais privacidade.
Redução do nível de voz até 32 dB (testes ISO 23351-1, desempenho acústico Classe A) para chamadas confidenciais sem perturbar quem trabalha por perto.

Ar fresco e montagem modular
Ventiladores silenciosos renovam o ar interior a cada 60 segundos, com iluminação e ventilação ativadas por sensor de presença. A construção modular permite montagem a partir de 35 minutos.

Construção da série V4
A série V4 combina uma estrutura de precisão em alumínio 6063 com vedantes EPDM e mola de porta automática Honeywell. Os painéis acústicos de 12 mm e a alcatifa proporcionam um interior acolhedor, enquanto a porta de fecho automático facilita o uso diário. A gama inclui a opção de secretária regulável em altura (730–1200 mm).

Em resumo
• Modelo: V4-M
• Acabamento exterior: Areia (RAL 1002)
• Dimensões exteriores (L × P × A): 1620 × 1390 × 2310 mm
• Dimensões interiores do piso (L × P): 1440 × 1220 mm
• Peso: 370 kg
• Capacidade: 2 pessoas (reuniões individuais, entrevistas e trabalho colaborativo)

Aléjese del ruido ambiental. Sileopod V4-M ofrece un refugio acústico cerrado pensado para 2 personas (reuniones uno a uno, entrevistas y trabajo colaborativo) en oficinas abiertas, aeropuertos, espacios públicos y entornos híbridos.

Diseño italiano para la jornada laboral
Desarrollada junto al equipo milanés Morpha, Sileopod combina estética italiana minimalista e ingeniería acústica. El acabado exterior Cemento (RAL 7033) aporta elegancia a cualquier espacio.

Menos distracciones. Más privacidad.
Reducción del nivel de voz de hasta 32 dB (ensayos ISO 23351-1, rendimiento acústico Clase A) para mantener la privacidad de cada conversación.

Aire fresco y montaje rápido
Ventiladores silenciosos renuevan el aire interior cada 60 segundos, con iluminación y ventilación activadas por presencia. Su sistema modular permite el montaje desde 35 minutos.

Construcción de la serie V4
La serie V4 une un bastidor de precisión en aluminio 6063 con juntas EPDM y cierrapuertas automático Honeywell. Los paneles acústicos de 12 mm y la moqueta crean un interior sereno, mientras que la puerta autocierre facilita el uso diario. La gama ofrece opcionalmente un escritorio regulable en altura (730–1200 mm).

• Dimensiones interiores de suelo (An × Pr): 1440 × 1220 mm
• Peso: 370 kg
• Capacidad: 2 personas (reuniones uno a uno, entrevistas y trabajo colaborativo)
variants.extended_description_it:
Uno spazio più silenzioso per pensare, parlare e lavorare al meglio.

Allontanati dal brusio dell'open space. Sileopod V4-M offre uno spazio acustico chiuso pensato per 2 persone (colloqui, riunioni a due e lavoro collaborativo), ideale per uffici, aeroporti, aree pubbliche e ambienti ibridi.

Design italiano per il lavoro quotidiano
Sviluppata con il team milanese Morpha, Sileopod unisce stile italiano minimalista e ingegneria acustica. La finitura esterna Cemento (RAL 7033) valorizza con equilibrio ogni ambiente.

Meno distrazioni. Più privacy.
Riduzione del livello vocale fino a 32 dB (test ISO 23351-1, classe acustica A) per conversazioni riservate senza disturbare chi lavora vicino.

Aria sempre fresca e montaggio rapido
Ventole silenziose rinnovano l'aria ogni 60 secondi con accensione automatica di luce e ventilazione tramite sensore di presenza. La struttura modulare consente il montaggio a partire da 35 minuti.

Struttura della serie V4
La serie V4 abbina un telaio di precisione in alluminio 6063 a guarnizioni EPDM e chiudiporta automatico Honeywell. I pannelli acustici da 12 mm e la moquette rendono l'interno confortevole, mentre la porta autochiudente agevola l'uso quotidiano. La gamma prevede l'opzione scrivania regolabile in altezza (730–1200 mm).

variants.extended_description_por:
Um espaço mais silencioso para pensar, falar e trabalhar com concentração.

Afaste-se do ruído dos espaços abertos. A Sileopod V4-M cria um refúgio acústico fechado para 2 pessoas (reuniões individuais, entrevistas e trabalho colaborativo), ideal para escritórios, aeroportos, espaços públicos e ambientes híbridos.

Design italiano para o dia de trabalho
Desenvolvida com a equipa de design milanesa Morpha, a Sileopod combina linhas minimalistas italianas com engenharia acústica. O acabamento exterior Cimento (RAL 7033) integra-se perfeitamente em interiores modernos.

Menos distrações. Mais privacidade.
Redução do nível de voz até 32 dB (testes ISO 23351-1, desempenho acústico Classe A) para chamadas confidenciais sem perturbar quem trabalha por perto.

Ar fresco e montagem modular
Ventiladores silenciosos renovam o ar interior a cada 60 segundos, com iluminação e ventilação ativadas por sensor de presença. A construção modular permite montagem a partir de 35 minutos.

Construção da série V4
A série V4 combina uma estrutura de precisão em alumínio 6063 com vedantes EPDM e mola de porta automática Honeywell. Os painéis acústicos de 12 mm e a alcatifa proporcionam um interior acolhedor, enquanto a porta de fecho automático facilita o uso diário. A gama inclui a opção de secretária regulável em altura (730–1200 mm).
