variants.extended_description_de:
Ein ruhigerer Ort zum Denken, Sprechen und konzentrierten Arbeiten.

Lassen Sie den Trubel des Großraumbüros hinter sich. Die Sileopod UI1-S bietet Platz für 1 Person (Telefonate, Video-Meetings & konzentrierte Einzelarbeit) und schafft eine geschlossene akustische Rückzugszone in Büros, Flughäfen, Cafés und hybriden Arbeitswelten.

Italienisches Design für den Arbeitsalltag
Entwickelt mit dem Mailänder Designteam Morpha vereint Sileopod minimalistisches italienisches Design mit durchdachter Akustiktechnik. Die Oberfläche in Sandgelb (RAL 1002) fügt sich harmonisch in moderne Räume ein.

Weniger Ablenkung. Mehr Privatsphäre.
Bis zu 32 dB Sprachpegelreduzierung (ISO 23351-1, Akustikklasse A) sorgen dafür, dass vertrauliche Gespräche in der Kabine bleiben und das Umfeld ruhig bleibt.

Frische Luft & schneller Aufbau
Leise Lüfter erneuern die Innenluft alle 60 Sekunden, gesteuert über Präsenzsensoren für Licht und Belüftung. Dank modularer Steck- und Magnetelemente gelingt die Montage ab ca. 35 Minuten.

Konstruktion der Serie UI1
Die UI1-Serie nutzt eine Carbon-Verbundstruktur mit 55 mm Carbon-Schalldämmung, 15 mm Akustikpaneelen und Teppichboden. Ein automatischer Honeywell-Türschließer sorgt für hohen Alltagskomfort, und die Serie bietet zudem die Option auf einen höhenverstellbaren Schreibtisch.

Auf einen Blick
• Modell: UI1-S
• Außenfarbe: Sandgelb (RAL 1002)
• Außenmaße (B × T × H): 1000 × 1086 × 2240 mm
• Innenmaße Boden (B × T): 846 × 986 mm
• Gewicht: 326 kg
• Kapazität: 1 Person (Telefonate, Video-Meetings & konzentrierte Einzelarbeit)
variants.extended_description_fr:
Un espace plus calme pour réfléchir, échanger et avancer efficacement.

Éloignez-vous du bruit ambiant. La Sileopod UI1-S offre un refuge acoustique conçu pour 1 personne (appels, visioconférences et travail concentré), idéal pour les bureaux ouverts, aéroports, espaces publics et environnements hybrides.

Design italien pensé pour le travail
Conçue avec le studio milanais Morpha, Sileopod allie esthétique italienne minimaliste et ingénierie acoustique. La finition extérieure Sable (RAL 1002) affirme une présence élégante dans tout aménagement.

Moins de bruit. Plus de confidentialité.
Réduction du niveau de parole jusqu'à 32 dB (tests ISO 23351-1, performance acoustique Classe A) pour des appels confidentiels sans déranger l'entourage.

Air renouvelé & montage modulaire
La ventilation silencieuse renouvelle l'air toutes les 60 secondes, avec détection de présence pour l'éclairage et la ventilation. L'assemblage modulaire s'effectue à partir de 35 minutes.

Conception de la série UI1
La série UI1 repose sur une structure composite carbone avec isolation phonique carbone de 55 mm, panneaux acoustiques de 15 mm et moquette. Un ferme-porte automatique Honeywell assure un confort d'utilisation quotidien, et la gamme propose une option bureau réglable en hauteur.

En résumé
• Modèle : UI1-S
• Finition extérieure : Sable (RAL 1002)
• Dimensions extérieures (L × P × H) : 1000 × 1086 × 2240 mm
• Dimensions intérieures au sol (L × P) : 846 × 986 mm
• Poids : 326 kg
• Capacité : 1 personne (appels, visioconférences et travail concentré)
variants.extended_description_es:
Un lugar más tranquilo para pensar, hablar y trabajar con foco.

Aléjese del ruido ambiental. Sileopod UI1-S ofrece un refugio acústico cerrado pensado para 1 persona (llamadas, videollamadas y trabajo individual concentrado) en oficinas abiertas, aeropuertos, espacios públicos y entornos híbridos.

Diseño italiano para la jornada laboral
Desarrollada junto al equipo milanés Morpha, Sileopod combina estética italiana minimalista e ingeniería acústica. El acabado exterior Arena (RAL 1002) aporta elegancia a cualquier espacio.

Menos distracciones. Más privacidad.
Reducción del nivel de voz de hasta 32 dB (ensayos ISO 23351-1, rendimiento acústico Clase A) para mantener la privacidad de cada conversación.

Aire fresco y montaje rápido
Ventiladores silenciosos renuevan el aire interior cada 60 segundos, con iluminación y ventilación activadas por presencia. Su sistema modular permite el montaje desde 35 minutos.

Construcción de la serie UI1
La serie UI1 emplea una estructura compuesta de carbono con aislamiento acústico de carbono de 55 mm, paneles acústicos de 15 mm y moqueta. Un cierrapuertas automático Honeywell aporta comodidad diaria y la gama incluye la opción de escritorio regulable en altura.

De un vistazo
• Modelo: UI1-S
• Acabado exterior: Arena (RAL 1002)
• Dimensiones exteriores (An × Pr × Al): 1000 × 1086 × 2240 mm
• Dimensiones interiores de suelo (An × Pr): 846 × 986 mm
• Peso: 326 kg
• Capacidad: 1 persona (llamadas, videollamadas y trabajo individual concentrado)
variants.extended_description_it:
Uno spazio più silenzioso per pensare, parlare e lavorare al meglio.

Allontanati dal brusio dell'open space. Sileopod UI1-S offre uno spazio acustico chiuso pensato per 1 persona (chiamate, videochiamate e lavoro individuale concentrato), ideale per uffici, aeroporti, aree pubbliche e ambienti ibridi.

Design italiano per il lavoro quotidiano
Sviluppata con il team milanese Morpha, Sileopod unisce stile italiano minimalista e ingegneria acustica. La finitura esterna Sabbia (RAL 1002) valorizza con equilibrio ogni ambiente.

Meno distrazioni. Più privacy.
Riduzione del livello vocale fino a 32 dB (test ISO 23351-1, classe acustica A) per conversazioni riservate senza disturbare chi lavora vicino.

Aria sempre fresca e montaggio rapido
Ventole silenziose rinnovano l'aria ogni 60 secondi con accensione automatica di luce e ventilazione tramite sensore di presenza. La struttura modulare consente il montaggio a partire da 35 minuti.

Struttura della serie UI1
La serie UI1 utilizza una struttura in composito di carbonio con isolamento acustico al carbonio da 55 mm, pannelli acustici da 15 mm e moquette. Un chiudiporta automatico Honeywell garantisce praticità quotidiana e la gamma include l'opzione scrivania regolabile in altezza.

In sintesi
• Modello: UI1-S
• Finitura esterna: Sabbia (RAL 1002)
• Dimensioni esterne (L × P × A): 1000 × 1086 × 2240 mm
• Dimensioni interne pavimento (L × P): 846 × 986 mm
• Peso: 326 kg
• Capacità: 1 persona (chiamate, videochiamate e lavoro individuale concentrato)
variants.extended_description_por:
Um espaço mais silencioso para pensar, falar e trabalhar com concentração.

Afaste-se do ruído dos espaços abertos. A Sileopod UI1-S cria um refúgio acústico fechado para 1 pessoa (chamadas, videochamadas e trabalho individual focado), ideal para escritórios, aeroportos, espaços públicos e ambientes híbridos.

Design italiano para o dia de trabalho
Desenvolvida com a equipa de design milanesa Morpha, a Sileopod combina linhas minimalistas italianas com engenharia acústica. O acabamento exterior Areia (RAL 1002) integra-se perfeitamente em interiores modernos.

Menos distrações. Mais privacidade.
Redução do nível de voz até 32 dB (testes ISO 23351-1, desempenho acústico Classe A) para chamadas confidenciais sem perturbar quem trabalha por perto.

Ar fresco e montagem modular
Ventiladores silenciosos renovam o ar interior a cada 60 segundos, com iluminação e ventilação ativadas por sensor de presença. A construção modular permite montagem a partir de 35 minutos.

Construção da série UI1
A série UI1 utiliza uma estrutura em compósito de carbono com isolamento acústico de carbono de 55 mm, painéis acústicos de 15 mm e alcatifa. Uma mola de porta automática Honeywell garante praticidade diária e a gama inclui a opção de secretária regulável em altura.

Em resumo
• Modelo: UI1-S
• Acabamento exterior: Areia (RAL 1002)
• Dimensões exteriores (L × P × A): 1000 × 1086 × 2240 mm
• Dimensões interiores do piso (L × P): 846 × 986 mm
• Peso: 326 kg
• Capacidade: 1 pessoa (chamadas, videochamadas e trabalho individual focado)

Italienisches Design für den Arbeitsalltag
Entwickelt mit dem Mailänder Designteam Morpha vereint Sileopod minimalistisches italienisches Design mit durchdachter Akustiktechnik. Die Oberfläche in Blaugrau (RAL 7031) fügt sich harmonisch in moderne Räume ein.

Weniger Ablenkung. Mehr Privatsphäre.
Bis zu 32 dB Sprachpegelreduzierung (ISO 23351-1, Akustikklasse A) sorgen dafür, dass vertrauliche Gespräche in der Kabine bleiben und das Umfeld ruhig bleibt.

Frische Luft & schneller Aufbau
Leise Lüfter erneuern die Innenluft alle 60 Sekunden, gesteuert über Präsenzsensoren für Licht und Belüftung. Dank modularer Steck- und Magnetelemente gelingt die Montage ab ca. 35 Minuten.

Die UI1-Serie nutzt eine Carbon-Verbundstruktur mit 55 mm Carbon-Schalldämmung, 15 mm Akustikpaneelen und Teppichboden. Ein automatischer Honeywell-Türschließer sorgt für hohen Alltagskomfort, und die Serie bietet zudem die Option auf einen höhenverstellbaren Schreibtisch.

variants.extended_description_fr:
Un espace plus calme pour réfléchir, échanger et avancer efficacement.

Éloignez-vous du bruit ambiant. La Sileopod UI1-S offre un refuge acoustique conçu pour 1 personne (appels, visioconférences et travail concentré), idéal pour les bureaux ouverts, aéroports, espaces publics et environnements hybrides.

Design italien pensé pour le travail
Conçue avec le studio milanais Morpha, Sileopod allie esthétique italienne minimaliste et ingénierie acoustique. La finition extérieure Bleu (RAL 7031) affirme une présence élégante dans tout aménagement.

Moins de bruit. Plus de confidentialité.
Réduction du niveau de parole jusqu'à 32 dB (tests ISO 23351-1, performance acoustique Classe A) pour des appels confidentiels sans déranger l'entourage.

Air renouvelé & montage modulaire
La ventilation silencieuse renouvelle l'air toutes les 60 secondes, avec détection de présence pour l'éclairage et la ventilation. L'assemblage modulaire s'effectue à partir de 35 minutes.

Conception de la série UI1
La série UI1 repose sur une structure composite carbone avec isolation phonique carbone de 55 mm, panneaux acoustiques de 15 mm et moquette. Un ferme-porte automatique Honeywell assure un confort d'utilisation quotidien, et la gamme propose une option bureau réglable en hauteur.

• Dimensions extérieures (L × P × H) : 1000 × 1086 × 2240 mm
• Dimensions intérieures au sol (L × P) : 846 × 986 mm
• Poids : 326 kg
• Capacité : 1 personne (appels, visioconférences et travail concentré)
variants.extended_description_es:
Un lugar más tranquilo para pensar, hablar y trabajar con foco.

Aléjese del ruido ambiental. Sileopod UI1-S ofrece un refugio acústico cerrado pensado para 1 persona (llamadas, videollamadas y trabajo individual concentrado) en oficinas abiertas, aeropuertos, espacios públicos y entornos híbridos.

Diseño italiano para la jornada laboral
Desarrollada junto al equipo milanés Morpha, Sileopod combina estética italiana minimalista e ingeniería acústica. El acabado exterior Azul (RAL 7031) aporta elegancia a cualquier espacio.

Menos distracciones. Más privacidad.
Reducción del nivel de voz de hasta 32 dB (ensayos ISO 23351-1, rendimiento acústico Clase A) para mantener la privacidad de cada conversación.

Aire fresco y montaje rápido
Ventiladores silenciosos renuevan el aire interior cada 60 segundos, con iluminación y ventilación activadas por presencia. Su sistema modular permite el montaje desde 35 minutos.

Construcción de la serie UI1
La serie UI1 emplea una estructura compuesta de carbono con aislamiento acústico de carbono de 55 mm, paneles acústicos de 15 mm y moqueta. Un cierrapuertas automático Honeywell aporta comodidad diaria y la gama incluye la opción de escritorio regulable en altura.

Design italiano per il lavoro quotidiano

variants.extended_description_por:

Design italiano para o dia de trabalho
Desenvolvida com a equipa de design milanesa Morpha, a Sileopod combina linhas minimalistas italianas com engenharia acústica. O acabamento exterior Azul (RAL 7031) integra-se perfeitamente em interiores modernos.

Menos distrações. Mais privacidade.
Redução do nível de voz até 32 dB (testes ISO 23351-1, desempenho acústico Classe A) para chamadas confidenciais sem perturbar quem trabalha por perto.

Ar fresco e montagem modular

variants.extended_description_en:
A quieter place to think, talk and get things done.

Step away from the open-plan buzz and give your next call, video meeting or focused task a space of its own. A compact personal retreat for phone calls, online meetings and uninterrupted individual work. Sileopod UI1-S brings an enclosed acoustic space to offices, public spaces and hybrid workplaces, helping people find focus within a lively shared environment.

Italian design, made for the working day
Developed with Milan design team Morpha, Sileopod combines minimalist Italian styling with acoustic engineering. The Cement (RAL 7033) exterior gives this booth a clear identity, whether it blends into a calm office scheme or adds a distinctive accent.

Less distraction. More privacy.
The manufacturer reports speech-level reduction of up to 32 dB for its range, with full-unit testing to ISO 23351-1 and Class A acoustic performance for private calls. In everyday terms, the design helps reduce how much speech carries beyond the booth, so conversations are less distracting to the people working nearby.

Fresh air for a more comfortable workspace
The Sileopod ventilation concept renews the air inside the booth every 60 seconds. Low-noise fans are designed to keep fresh air moving without becoming a distraction, while presence-activated lighting and ventilation make the space convenient to use.

Modular design. Faster setup.
Clip-together components and magnetic panels simplify installation, with assembly in as little as 35 minutes according to the manufacturer. This modular approach makes it easier to introduce a dedicated quiet space into an existing workplace.

Built for everyday use
The UI1 uses a carbon composite structure with 55 mm carbon sound insulation, 15 mm acoustic panels and carpet. A Honeywell automatic door closer supports convenient everyday use, and the range includes a height-adjustable desk option.

Make it fit your space
Interior acoustic panels, carpet and upholstery can be colour-matched to order. Tabletop choices include white, black and oak veneer. Furniture layouts vary by booth size, from individual desk setups to face-to-face seating or meeting furniture; confirm your chosen layout and included items when ordering.

At a glance
Model: UI1-S
Exterior finish: Cement (RAL 7033)
External dimensions (W × D × H): 1000 × 1086 × 2240 mm.
Internal floor dimensions (W × D): 846 × 986 mm.
Weight: 326 kg.
Capacity: 1 person.
Construction details: Carbon composite structure with 55 mm carbon sound insulation. 15 mm acoustic panels and carpet. Honeywell automatic door closer. The catalogue lists a height-adjustable desk; confirm the supplied furniture configuration when ordering.

The acoustic, air-renewal and assembly figures above are manufacturer-stated range figures. Performance, setup time and equipment depend on the model, configuration and installation conditions.

variants.extended_description_en:
A quieter place to think, talk and get things done.

Step away from the open-plan buzz and give your next call, video meeting or focused task a space of its own. A compact personal retreat for phone calls, online meetings and uninterrupted individual work. Sileopod UI1-S brings an enclosed acoustic space to offices, public spaces and hybrid workplaces, helping people find focus within a lively shared environment.

Italian design, made for the working day
Developed with Milan design team Morpha, Sileopod combines minimalist Italian styling with acoustic engineering. The Red (RAL 3013) exterior gives this booth a clear identity, whether it blends into a calm office scheme or adds a distinctive accent.

Less distraction. More privacy.
The manufacturer reports speech-level reduction of up to 32 dB for its range, with full-unit testing to ISO 23351-1 and Class A acoustic performance for private calls. In everyday terms, the design helps reduce how much speech carries beyond the booth, so conversations are less distracting to the people working nearby.

Fresh air for a more comfortable workspace
The Sileopod ventilation concept renews the air inside the booth every 60 seconds. Low-noise fans are designed to keep fresh air moving without becoming a distraction, while presence-activated lighting and ventilation make the space convenient to use.

Modular design. Faster setup.
Clip-together components and magnetic panels simplify installation, with assembly in as little as 35 minutes according to the manufacturer. This modular approach makes it easier to introduce a dedicated quiet space into an existing workplace.

Built for everyday use
The UI1 uses a carbon composite structure with 55 mm carbon sound insulation, 15 mm acoustic panels and carpet. A Honeywell automatic door closer supports convenient everyday use, and the range includes a height-adjustable desk option.

Make it fit your space
Interior acoustic panels, carpet and upholstery can be colour-matched to order. Tabletop choices include white, black and oak veneer. Furniture layouts vary by booth size, from individual desk setups to face-to-face seating or meeting furniture; confirm your chosen layout and included items when ordering.

At a glance
Model: UI1-S
Exterior finish: Red (RAL 3013)
External dimensions (W × D × H): 1000 × 1086 × 2240 mm.
Internal floor dimensions (W × D): 846 × 986 mm.
Weight: 326 kg.
Capacity: 1 person.
Construction details: Carbon composite structure with 55 mm carbon sound insulation. 15 mm acoustic panels and carpet. Honeywell automatic door closer. The catalogue lists a height-adjustable desk; confirm the supplied furniture configuration when ordering.

The acoustic, air-renewal and assembly figures above are manufacturer-stated range figures. Performance, setup time and equipment depend on the model, configuration and installation conditions.

Ein ruhigerer Ort zum Denken, Sprechen und konzentrierten Arbeiten.

Italienisches Design für den Arbeitsalltag
Entwickelt mit dem Mailänder Designteam Morpha vereint Sileopod minimalistisches italienisches Design mit durchdachter Akustiktechnik. Die Oberfläche in Tomatenrot (RAL 3013) fügt sich harmonisch in moderne Räume ein.

Weniger Ablenkung. Mehr Privatsphäre.

Leise Lüfter erneuern die Innenluft alle 60 Sekunden, gesteuert über Präsenzsensoren für Licht und Belüftung. Dank modularer Steck- und Magnetelemente gelingt die Montage ab ca. 35 Minuten.

Konstruktion der Serie UI1
Die UI1-Serie nutzt eine Carbon-Verbundstruktur mit 55 mm Carbon-Schalldämmung, 15 mm Akustikpaneelen und Teppichboden. Ein automatischer Honeywell-Türschließer sorgt für hohen Alltagskomfort, und die Serie bietet zudem die Option auf einen höhenverstellbaren Schreibtisch.

variants.extended_description_en:
A quieter place to think, talk and get things done.

Step away from the open-plan buzz and give your next call, video meeting or focused task a space of its own. A compact personal retreat for phone calls, online meetings and uninterrupted individual work. Sileopod UI1-S brings an enclosed acoustic space to offices, public spaces and hybrid workplaces, helping people find focus within a lively shared environment.

Italian design, made for the working day
Developed with Milan design team Morpha, Sileopod combines minimalist Italian styling with acoustic engineering. The Green (RAL 6005) exterior gives this booth a clear identity, whether it blends into a calm office scheme or adds a distinctive accent.

Less distraction. More privacy.
The manufacturer reports speech-level reduction of up to 32 dB for its range, with full-unit testing to ISO 23351-1 and Class A acoustic performance for private calls. In everyday terms, the design helps reduce how much speech carries beyond the booth, so conversations are less distracting to the people working nearby.

Fresh air for a more comfortable workspace
The Sileopod ventilation concept renews the air inside the booth every 60 seconds. Low-noise fans are designed to keep fresh air moving without becoming a distraction, while presence-activated lighting and ventilation make the space convenient to use.

Modular design. Faster setup.
Clip-together components and magnetic panels simplify installation, with assembly in as little as 35 minutes according to the manufacturer. This modular approach makes it easier to introduce a dedicated quiet space into an existing workplace.

Built for everyday use
The UI1 uses a carbon composite structure with 55 mm carbon sound insulation, 15 mm acoustic panels and carpet. A Honeywell automatic door closer supports convenient everyday use, and the range includes a height-adjustable desk option.

Make it fit your space
Interior acoustic panels, carpet and upholstery can be colour-matched to order. Tabletop choices include white, black and oak veneer. Furniture layouts vary by booth size, from individual desk setups to face-to-face seating or meeting furniture; confirm your chosen layout and included items when ordering.

At a glance
Model: UI1-S
Exterior finish: Green (RAL 6005)
External dimensions (W × D × H): 1000 × 1086 × 2240 mm.
Internal floor dimensions (W × D): 846 × 986 mm.
Weight: 326 kg.
Capacity: 1 person.
Construction details: Carbon composite structure with 55 mm carbon sound insulation. 15 mm acoustic panels and carpet. Honeywell automatic door closer. The catalogue lists a height-adjustable desk; confirm the supplied furniture configuration when ordering.

The acoustic, air-renewal and assembly figures above are manufacturer-stated range figures. Performance, setup time and equipment depend on the model, configuration and installation conditions.

variants.extended_description_de:
Ein ruhigerer Ort zum Denken, Sprechen und konzentrierten Arbeiten.

Lassen Sie den Trubel des Großraumbüros hinter sich. Die Sileopod UI1-S bietet Platz für 1 Person (Telefonate, Video-Meetings & konzentrierte Einzelarbeit) und schafft eine geschlossene akustische Rückzugszone in Büros, Flughäfen, Cafés und hybriden Arbeitswelten.

Italienisches Design für den Arbeitsalltag
Entwickelt mit dem Mailänder Designteam Morpha vereint Sileopod minimalistisches italienisches Design mit durchdachter Akustiktechnik. Die Oberfläche in Moosgrün (RAL 6005) fügt sich harmonisch in moderne Räume ein.

Weniger Ablenkung. Mehr Privatsphäre.
Bis zu 32 dB Sprachpegelreduzierung (ISO 23351-1, Akustikklasse A) sorgen dafür, dass vertrauliche Gespräche in der Kabine bleiben und das Umfeld ruhig bleibt.

Frische Luft & schneller Aufbau
Leise Lüfter erneuern die Innenluft alle 60 Sekunden, gesteuert über Präsenzsensoren für Licht und Belüftung. Dank modularer Steck- und Magnetelemente gelingt die Montage ab ca. 35 Minuten.

Konstruktion der Serie UI1
Die UI1-Serie nutzt eine Carbon-Verbundstruktur mit 55 mm Carbon-Schalldämmung, 15 mm Akustikpaneelen und Teppichboden. Ein automatischer Honeywell-Türschließer sorgt für hohen Alltagskomfort, und die Serie bietet zudem die Option auf einen höhenverstellbaren Schreibtisch.

Auf einen Blick
• Modell: UI1-S
• Außenfarbe: Moosgrün (RAL 6005)
• Außenmaße (B × T × H): 1000 × 1086 × 2240 mm
• Innenmaße Boden (B × T): 846 × 986 mm
• Gewicht: 326 kg
• Kapazität: 1 Person (Telefonate, Video-Meetings & konzentrierte Einzelarbeit)
variants.extended_description_fr:
Un espace plus calme pour réfléchir, échanger et avancer efficacement.

Éloignez-vous du bruit ambiant. La Sileopod UI1-S offre un refuge acoustique conçu pour 1 personne (appels, visioconférences et travail concentré), idéal pour les bureaux ouverts, aéroports, espaces publics et environnements hybrides.

Design italien pensé pour le travail
Conçue avec le studio milanais Morpha, Sileopod allie esthétique italienne minimaliste et ingénierie acoustique. La finition extérieure Vert (RAL 6005) affirme une présence élégante dans tout aménagement.

Moins de bruit. Plus de confidentialité.
Réduction du niveau de parole jusqu'à 32 dB (tests ISO 23351-1, performance acoustique Classe A) pour des appels confidentiels sans déranger l'entourage.

Air renouvelé & montage modulaire
La ventilation silencieuse renouvelle l'air toutes les 60 secondes, avec détection de présence pour l'éclairage et la ventilation. L'assemblage modulaire s'effectue à partir de 35 minutes.

Conception de la série UI1
La série UI1 repose sur une structure composite carbone avec isolation phonique carbone de 55 mm, panneaux acoustiques de 15 mm et moquette. Un ferme-porte automatique Honeywell assure un confort d'utilisation quotidien, et la gamme propose une option bureau réglable en hauteur.

En résumé
• Modèle : UI1-S
• Finition extérieure : Vert (RAL 6005)
• Dimensions extérieures (L × P × H) : 1000 × 1086 × 2240 mm
• Dimensions intérieures au sol (L × P) : 846 × 986 mm
• Poids : 326 kg
• Capacité : 1 personne (appels, visioconférences et travail concentré)
variants.extended_description_es:
Un lugar más tranquilo para pensar, hablar y trabajar con foco.

Aléjese del ruido ambiental. Sileopod UI1-S ofrece un refugio acústico cerrado pensado para 1 persona (llamadas, videollamadas y trabajo individual concentrado) en oficinas abiertas, aeropuertos, espacios públicos y entornos híbridos.

Diseño italiano para la jornada laboral
Desarrollada junto al equipo milanés Morpha, Sileopod combina estética italiana minimalista e ingeniería acústica. El acabado exterior Verde (RAL 6005) aporta elegancia a cualquier espacio.

Menos distracciones. Más privacidad.
Reducción del nivel de voz de hasta 32 dB (ensayos ISO 23351-1, rendimiento acústico Clase A) para mantener la privacidad de cada conversación.

Aire fresco y montaje rápido
Ventiladores silenciosos renuevan el aire interior cada 60 segundos, con iluminación y ventilación activadas por presencia. Su sistema modular permite el montaje desde 35 minutos.

Construcción de la serie UI1
La serie UI1 emplea una estructura compuesta de carbono con aislamiento acústico de carbono de 55 mm, paneles acústicos de 15 mm y moqueta. Un cierrapuertas automático Honeywell aporta comodidad diaria y la gama incluye la opción de escritorio regulable en altura.

De un vistazo
• Modelo: UI1-S
• Acabado exterior: Verde (RAL 6005)
• Dimensiones exteriores (An × Pr × Al): 1000 × 1086 × 2240 mm
• Dimensiones interiores de suelo (An × Pr): 846 × 986 mm
• Peso: 326 kg
• Capacidad: 1 persona (llamadas, videollamadas y trabajo individual concentrado)
variants.extended_description_it:
Uno spazio più silenzioso per pensare, parlare e lavorare al meglio.

Allontanati dal brusio dell'open space. Sileopod UI1-S offre uno spazio acustico chiuso pensato per 1 persona (chiamate, videochiamate e lavoro individuale concentrato), ideale per uffici, aeroporti, aree pubbliche e ambienti ibridi.

Design italiano per il lavoro quotidiano
Sviluppata con il team milanese Morpha, Sileopod unisce stile italiano minimalista e ingegneria acustica. La finitura esterna Verde (RAL 6005) valorizza con equilibrio ogni ambiente.

Meno distrazioni. Più privacy.
Riduzione del livello vocale fino a 32 dB (test ISO 23351-1, classe acustica A) per conversazioni riservate senza disturbare chi lavora vicino.

Aria sempre fresca e montaggio rapido
Ventole silenziose rinnovano l'aria ogni 60 secondi con accensione automatica di luce e ventilazione tramite sensore di presenza. La struttura modulare consente il montaggio a partire da 35 minuti.

Struttura della serie UI1
La serie UI1 utilizza una struttura in composito di carbonio con isolamento acustico al carbonio da 55 mm, pannelli acustici da 15 mm e moquette. Un chiudiporta automatico Honeywell garantisce praticità quotidiana e la gamma include l'opzione scrivania regolabile in altezza.

In sintesi
• Modello: UI1-S
• Finitura esterna: Verde (RAL 6005)
• Dimensioni esterne (L × P × A): 1000 × 1086 × 2240 mm
• Dimensioni interne pavimento (L × P): 846 × 986 mm
• Peso: 326 kg
• Capacità: 1 persona (chiamate, videochiamate e lavoro individuale concentrato)
variants.extended_description_por:
Um espaço mais silencioso para pensar, falar e trabalhar com concentração.

Afaste-se do ruído dos espaços abertos. A Sileopod UI1-S cria um refúgio acústico fechado para 1 pessoa (chamadas, videochamadas e trabalho individual focado), ideal para escritórios, aeroportos, espaços públicos e ambientes híbridos.

Design italiano para o dia de trabalho
Desenvolvida com a equipa de design milanesa Morpha, a Sileopod combina linhas minimalistas italianas com engenharia acústica. O acabamento exterior Verde (RAL 6005) integra-se perfeitamente em interiores modernos.

Menos distrações. Mais privacidade.
Redução do nível de voz até 32 dB (testes ISO 23351-1, desempenho acústico Classe A) para chamadas confidenciais sem perturbar quem trabalha por perto.

Ar fresco e montagem modular
Ventiladores silenciosos renovam o ar interior a cada 60 segundos, com iluminação e ventilação ativadas por sensor de presença. A construção modular permite montagem a partir de 35 minutos.

Construção da série UI1
A série UI1 utiliza uma estrutura em compósito de carbono com isolamento acústico de carbono de 55 mm, painéis acústicos de 15 mm e alcatifa. Uma mola de porta automática Honeywell garante praticidade diária e a gama inclui a opção de secretária regulável em altura.

Em resumo
• Modelo: UI1-S
• Acabamento exterior: Verde (RAL 6005)
• Dimensões exteriores (L × P × A): 1000 × 1086 × 2240 mm
• Dimensões interiores do piso (L × P): 846 × 986 mm
• Peso: 326 kg
• Capacidade: 1 pessoa (chamadas, videochamadas e trabalho individual focado)

variants.extended_description_fr:
Un espace plus calme pour réfléchir, échanger et avancer efficacement.

Éloignez-vous du bruit ambiant. La Sileopod UI1-S offre un refuge acoustique conçu pour 1 personne (appels, visioconférences et travail concentré), idéal pour les bureaux ouverts, aéroports, espaces publics et environnements hybrides.

Design italien pensé pour le travail
Conçue avec le studio milanais Morpha, Sileopod allie esthétique italienne minimaliste et ingénierie acoustique. La finition extérieure Vieux Rose (RAL 3014) affirme une présence élégante dans tout aménagement.

Moins de bruit. Plus de confidentialité.
Réduction du niveau de parole jusqu'à 32 dB (tests ISO 23351-1, performance acoustique Classe A) pour des appels confidentiels sans déranger l'entourage.

Air renouvelé & montage modulaire

Conception de la série UI1
La série UI1 repose sur une structure composite carbone avec isolation phonique carbone de 55 mm, panneaux acoustiques de 15 mm et moquette. Un ferme-porte automatique Honeywell assure un confort d'utilisation quotidien, et la gamme propose une option bureau réglable en hauteur.

Diseño italiano para la jornada laboral

variants.extended_description_en:
A quieter place to think, talk and get things done.

Bring a little more privacy to the conversations that matter, with a dedicated space for two. Room for two makes it a practical choice for one-to-one meetings, interviews, collaborative work and video calls. Sileopod UI1-M brings an enclosed acoustic space to offices, public spaces and hybrid workplaces, helping people find focus within a lively shared environment.

Italian design, made for the working day
Developed with Milan design team Morpha, Sileopod combines minimalist Italian styling with acoustic engineering. The White (RAL 9003) exterior gives this booth a clear identity, whether it blends into a calm office scheme or adds a distinctive accent.

Less distraction. More privacy.
The manufacturer reports speech-level reduction of up to 32 dB for its range, with full-unit testing to ISO 23351-1 and Class A acoustic performance for private calls. In everyday terms, the design helps reduce how much speech carries beyond the booth, so conversations are less distracting to the people working nearby.

Fresh air for a more comfortable workspace
The Sileopod ventilation concept renews the air inside the booth every 60 seconds. Low-noise fans are designed to keep fresh air moving without becoming a distraction, while presence-activated lighting and ventilation make the space convenient to use.

Modular design. Faster setup.
Clip-together components and magnetic panels simplify installation, with assembly in as little as 35 minutes according to the manufacturer. This modular approach makes it easier to introduce a dedicated quiet space into an existing workplace.

Built for everyday use
The UI1 uses a carbon composite structure with 55 mm carbon sound insulation, 15 mm acoustic panels and carpet. A Honeywell automatic door closer supports convenient everyday use, and the range includes a height-adjustable desk option.

Make it fit your space
Interior acoustic panels, carpet and upholstery can be colour-matched to order. Tabletop choices include white, black and oak veneer. Furniture layouts vary by booth size, from individual desk setups to face-to-face seating or meeting furniture; confirm your chosen layout and included items when ordering.

At a glance
Model: UI1-M
Exterior finish: White (RAL 9003)
External dimensions (W × D × H): 1500 × 1386 × 2240 mm.
Internal floor dimensions (W × D): 1346 × 1286 mm.
Weight: 499 kg.
Capacity: 2 people.
Construction details: Carbon composite structure with 55 mm carbon sound insulation. 15 mm acoustic panels and carpet. Honeywell automatic door closer. The catalogue lists a height-adjustable desk; confirm the supplied furniture configuration when ordering.

The acoustic, air-renewal and assembly figures above are manufacturer-stated range figures. Performance, setup time and equipment depend on the model, configuration and installation conditions.

Afaste-se do ruído dos espaços abertos. A Sileopod UI1-M cria um refúgio acústico fechado para 2 pessoas (reuniões individuais, entrevistas e trabalho colaborativo), ideal para escritórios, aeroportos, espaços públicos e ambientes híbridos.

Design italiano para o dia de trabalho
Desenvolvida com a equipa de design milanesa Morpha, a Sileopod combina linhas minimalistas italianas com engenharia acústica. O acabamento exterior Branco (RAL 9003) integra-se perfeitamente em interiores modernos.

Menos distrações. Mais privacidade.
Redução do nível de voz até 32 dB (testes ISO 23351-1, desempenho acústico Classe A) para chamadas confidenciais sem perturbar quem trabalha por perto.

Ar fresco e montagem modular
Ventiladores silenciosos renovam o ar interior a cada 60 segundos, com iluminação e ventilação ativadas por sensor de presença. A construção modular permite montagem a partir de 35 minutos.

Construção da série UI1
A série UI1 utiliza uma estrutura em compósito de carbono com isolamento acústico de carbono de 55 mm, painéis acústicos de 15 mm e alcatifa. Uma mola de porta automática Honeywell garante praticidade diária e a gama inclui a opção de secretária regulável em altura.

Em resumo
• Modelo: UI1-M
• Acabamento exterior: Branco (RAL 9003)
• Dimensões exteriores (L × P × A): 1500 × 1386 × 2240 mm
• Dimensões interiores do piso (L × P): 1346 × 1286 mm
• Peso: 499 kg
• Capacidade: 2 pessoas (reuniões individuais, entrevistas e trabalho colaborativo)

variants.extended_description_en:
A quieter place to think, talk and get things done.

Bring a little more privacy to the conversations that matter, with a dedicated space for two. Room for two makes it a practical choice for one-to-one meetings, interviews, collaborative work and video calls. Sileopod UI1-M brings an enclosed acoustic space to offices, public spaces and hybrid workplaces, helping people find focus within a lively shared environment.

Italian design, made for the working day
Developed with Milan design team Morpha, Sileopod combines minimalist Italian styling with acoustic engineering. The Black (RAL 7021) exterior gives this booth a clear identity, whether it blends into a calm office scheme or adds a distinctive accent.

Less distraction. More privacy.
The manufacturer reports speech-level reduction of up to 32 dB for its range, with full-unit testing to ISO 23351-1 and Class A acoustic performance for private calls. In everyday terms, the design helps reduce how much speech carries beyond the booth, so conversations are less distracting to the people working nearby.

Fresh air for a more comfortable workspace
The Sileopod ventilation concept renews the air inside the booth every 60 seconds. Low-noise fans are designed to keep fresh air moving without becoming a distraction, while presence-activated lighting and ventilation make the space convenient to use.

Modular design. Faster setup.
Clip-together components and magnetic panels simplify installation, with assembly in as little as 35 minutes according to the manufacturer. This modular approach makes it easier to introduce a dedicated quiet space into an existing workplace.

Built for everyday use
The UI1 uses a carbon composite structure with 55 mm carbon sound insulation, 15 mm acoustic panels and carpet. A Honeywell automatic door closer supports convenient everyday use, and the range includes a height-adjustable desk option.

Make it fit your space
Interior acoustic panels, carpet and upholstery can be colour-matched to order. Tabletop choices include white, black and oak veneer. Furniture layouts vary by booth size, from individual desk setups to face-to-face seating or meeting furniture; confirm your chosen layout and included items when ordering.

At a glance
Model: UI1-M
Exterior finish: Black (RAL 7021)
External dimensions (W × D × H): 1500 × 1386 × 2240 mm.
Internal floor dimensions (W × D): 1346 × 1286 mm.
Weight: 499 kg.
Capacity: 2 people.
Construction details: Carbon composite structure with 55 mm carbon sound insulation. 15 mm acoustic panels and carpet. Honeywell automatic door closer. The catalogue lists a height-adjustable desk; confirm the supplied furniture configuration when ordering.

The acoustic, air-renewal and assembly figures above are manufacturer-stated range figures. Performance, setup time and equipment depend on the model, configuration and installation conditions.

variants.extended_description_de:
Ein ruhigerer Ort zum Denken, Sprechen und konzentrierten Arbeiten.

Lassen Sie den Trubel des Großraumbüros hinter sich. Die Sileopod UI1-M bietet Platz für 2 Personen (1:1-Gespräche, Interviews & gemeinsames Arbeiten) und schafft eine geschlossene akustische Rückzugszone in Büros, Flughäfen, Cafés und hybriden Arbeitswelten.

Italienisches Design für den Arbeitsalltag
Entwickelt mit dem Mailänder Designteam Morpha vereint Sileopod minimalistisches italienisches Design mit durchdachter Akustiktechnik. Die Oberfläche in Schwarzgrau (RAL 7021) fügt sich harmonisch in moderne Räume ein.

Weniger Ablenkung. Mehr Privatsphäre.
Bis zu 32 dB Sprachpegelreduzierung (ISO 23351-1, Akustikklasse A) sorgen dafür, dass vertrauliche Gespräche in der Kabine bleiben und das Umfeld ruhig bleibt.

Frische Luft & schneller Aufbau
Leise Lüfter erneuern die Innenluft alle 60 Sekunden, gesteuert über Präsenzsensoren für Licht und Belüftung. Dank modularer Steck- und Magnetelemente gelingt die Montage ab ca. 35 Minuten.

Konstruktion der Serie UI1
Die UI1-Serie nutzt eine Carbon-Verbundstruktur mit 55 mm Carbon-Schalldämmung, 15 mm Akustikpaneelen und Teppichboden. Ein automatischer Honeywell-Türschließer sorgt für hohen Alltagskomfort, und die Serie bietet zudem die Option auf einen höhenverstellbaren Schreibtisch.

Auf einen Blick
• Modell: UI1-M
• Außenfarbe: Schwarzgrau (RAL 7021)
• Außenmaße (B × T × H): 1500 × 1386 × 2240 mm
• Innenmaße Boden (B × T): 1346 × 1286 mm
• Gewicht: 499 kg
• Kapazität: 2 Personen (1:1-Gespräche, Interviews & gemeinsames Arbeiten)
variants.extended_description_fr:
Un espace plus calme pour réfléchir, échanger et avancer efficacement.

Éloignez-vous du bruit ambiant. La Sileopod UI1-M offre un refuge acoustique conçu pour 2 personnes (entretiens, réunions en duo et travail collaboratif), idéal pour les bureaux ouverts, aéroports, espaces publics et environnements hybrides.

Design italien pensé pour le travail
Conçue avec le studio milanais Morpha, Sileopod allie esthétique italienne minimaliste et ingénierie acoustique. La finition extérieure Noir (RAL 7021) affirme une présence élégante dans tout aménagement.

Moins de bruit. Plus de confidentialité.
Réduction du niveau de parole jusqu'à 32 dB (tests ISO 23351-1, performance acoustique Classe A) pour des appels confidentiels sans déranger l'entourage.

Air renouvelé & montage modulaire
La ventilation silencieuse renouvelle l'air toutes les 60 secondes, avec détection de présence pour l'éclairage et la ventilation. L'assemblage modulaire s'effectue à partir de 35 minutes.

Conception de la série UI1
La série UI1 repose sur une structure composite carbone avec isolation phonique carbone de 55 mm, panneaux acoustiques de 15 mm et moquette. Un ferme-porte automatique Honeywell assure un confort d'utilisation quotidien, et la gamme propose une option bureau réglable en hauteur.

En résumé
• Modèle : UI1-M
• Finition extérieure : Noir (RAL 7021)
• Dimensions extérieures (L × P × H) : 1500 × 1386 × 2240 mm
• Dimensions intérieures au sol (L × P) : 1346 × 1286 mm
• Poids : 499 kg
• Capacité : 2 personnes (entretiens, réunions en duo et travail collaboratif)
variants.extended_description_es:
Un lugar más tranquilo para pensar, hablar y trabajar con foco.

Aléjese del ruido ambiental. Sileopod UI1-M ofrece un refugio acústico cerrado pensado para 2 personas (reuniones uno a uno, entrevistas y trabajo colaborativo) en oficinas abiertas, aeropuertos, espacios públicos y entornos híbridos.

Diseño italiano para la jornada laboral
Desarrollada junto al equipo milanés Morpha, Sileopod combina estética italiana minimalista e ingeniería acústica. El acabado exterior Negro (RAL 7021) aporta elegancia a cualquier espacio.

Menos distracciones. Más privacidad.
Reducción del nivel de voz de hasta 32 dB (ensayos ISO 23351-1, rendimiento acústico Clase A) para mantener la privacidad de cada conversación.

Aire fresco y montaje rápido
Ventiladores silenciosos renuevan el aire interior cada 60 segundos, con iluminación y ventilación activadas por presencia. Su sistema modular permite el montaje desde 35 minutos.

Construcción de la serie UI1
La serie UI1 emplea una estructura compuesta de carbono con aislamiento acústico de carbono de 55 mm, paneles acústicos de 15 mm y moqueta. Un cierrapuertas automático Honeywell aporta comodidad diaria y la gama incluye la opción de escritorio regulable en altura.

De un vistazo
• Modelo: UI1-M
• Acabado exterior: Negro (RAL 7021)
• Dimensiones exteriores (An × Pr × Al): 1500 × 1386 × 2240 mm
• Dimensiones interiores de suelo (An × Pr): 1346 × 1286 mm
• Peso: 499 kg
• Capacidad: 2 personas (reuniones uno a uno, entrevistas y trabajo colaborativo)

Design italiano per il lavoro quotidiano
Sviluppata con il team milanese Morpha, Sileopod unisce stile italiano minimalista e ingegneria acustica. La finitura esterna Nero (RAL 7021) valorizza con equilibrio ogni ambiente.

Meno distrazioni. Più privacy.
Riduzione del livello vocale fino a 32 dB (test ISO 23351-1, classe acustica A) per conversazioni riservate senza disturbare chi lavora vicino.

Aria sempre fresca e montaggio rapido
Ventole silenziose rinnovano l'aria ogni 60 secondi con accensione automatica di luce e ventilazione tramite sensore di presenza. La struttura modulare consente il montaggio a partire da 35 minuti.

Struttura della serie UI1
La serie UI1 utilizza una struttura in composito di carbonio con isolamento acustico al carbonio da 55 mm, pannelli acustici da 15 mm e moquette. Un chiudiporta automatico Honeywell garantisce praticità quotidiana e la gamma include l'opzione scrivania regolabile in altezza.

variants.extended_description_en:
A quieter place to think, talk and get things done.

Bring a little more privacy to the conversations that matter, with a dedicated space for two. Room for two makes it a practical choice for one-to-one meetings, interviews, collaborative work and video calls. Sileopod UI1-M brings an enclosed acoustic space to offices, public spaces and hybrid workplaces, helping people find focus within a lively shared environment.

Italian design, made for the working day
Developed with Milan design team Morpha, Sileopod combines minimalist Italian styling with acoustic engineering. The Umbra (RAL 7022) exterior gives this booth a clear identity, whether it blends into a calm office scheme or adds a distinctive accent.

Less distraction. More privacy.
The manufacturer reports speech-level reduction of up to 32 dB for its range, with full-unit testing to ISO 23351-1 and Class A acoustic performance for private calls. In everyday terms, the design helps reduce how much speech carries beyond the booth, so conversations are less distracting to the people working nearby.

Fresh air for a more comfortable workspace
The Sileopod ventilation concept renews the air inside the booth every 60 seconds. Low-noise fans are designed to keep fresh air moving without becoming a distraction, while presence-activated lighting and ventilation make the space convenient to use.

Modular design. Faster setup.
Clip-together components and magnetic panels simplify installation, with assembly in as little as 35 minutes according to the manufacturer. This modular approach makes it easier to introduce a dedicated quiet space into an existing workplace.

Built for everyday use
The UI1 uses a carbon composite structure with 55 mm carbon sound insulation, 15 mm acoustic panels and carpet. A Honeywell automatic door closer supports convenient everyday use, and the range includes a height-adjustable desk option.

Make it fit your space
Interior acoustic panels, carpet and upholstery can be colour-matched to order. Tabletop choices include white, black and oak veneer. Furniture layouts vary by booth size, from individual desk setups to face-to-face seating or meeting furniture; confirm your chosen layout and included items when ordering.

Model: UI1-M
Exterior finish: Umbra (RAL 7022)
External dimensions (W × D × H): 1500 × 1386 × 2240 mm.
Internal floor dimensions (W × D): 1346 × 1286 mm.
Weight: 499 kg.
Capacity: 2 people.
Construction details: Carbon composite structure with 55 mm carbon sound insulation. 15 mm acoustic panels and carpet. Honeywell automatic door closer. The catalogue lists a height-adjustable desk; confirm the supplied furniture configuration when ordering.

The acoustic, air-renewal and assembly figures above are manufacturer-stated range figures. Performance, setup time and equipment depend on the model, configuration and installation conditions.

variants.extended_description_de:
Ein ruhigerer Ort zum Denken, Sprechen und konzentrierten Arbeiten.

Lassen Sie den Trubel des Großraumbüros hinter sich. Die Sileopod UI1-M bietet Platz für 2 Personen (1:1-Gespräche, Interviews & gemeinsames Arbeiten) und schafft eine geschlossene akustische Rückzugszone in Büros, Flughäfen, Cafés und hybriden Arbeitswelten.

Italienisches Design für den Arbeitsalltag
Entwickelt mit dem Mailänder Designteam Morpha vereint Sileopod minimalistisches italienisches Design mit durchdachter Akustiktechnik. Die Oberfläche in Umbragrau (RAL 7022) fügt sich harmonisch in moderne Räume ein.

Weniger Ablenkung. Mehr Privatsphäre.
Bis zu 32 dB Sprachpegelreduzierung (ISO 23351-1, Akustikklasse A) sorgen dafür, dass vertrauliche Gespräche in der Kabine bleiben und das Umfeld ruhig bleibt.

Frische Luft & schneller Aufbau
Leise Lüfter erneuern die Innenluft alle 60 Sekunden, gesteuert über Präsenzsensoren für Licht und Belüftung. Dank modularer Steck- und Magnetelemente gelingt die Montage ab ca. 35 Minuten.

Konstruktion der Serie UI1
Die UI1-Serie nutzt eine Carbon-Verbundstruktur mit 55 mm Carbon-Schalldämmung, 15 mm Akustikpaneelen und Teppichboden. Ein automatischer Honeywell-Türschließer sorgt für hohen Alltagskomfort, und die Serie bietet zudem die Option auf einen höhenverstellbaren Schreibtisch.

Auf einen Blick
• Modell: UI1-M
• Außenfarbe: Umbragrau (RAL 7022)
• Außenmaße (B × T × H): 1500 × 1386 × 2240 mm
• Innenmaße Boden (B × T): 1346 × 1286 mm
• Gewicht: 499 kg
• Kapazität: 2 Personen (1:1-Gespräche, Interviews & gemeinsames Arbeiten)
variants.extended_description_fr:
Un espace plus calme pour réfléchir, échanger et avancer efficacement.

Éloignez-vous du bruit ambiant. La Sileopod UI1-M offre un refuge acoustique conçu pour 2 personnes (entretiens, réunions en duo et travail collaboratif), idéal pour les bureaux ouverts, aéroports, espaces publics et environnements hybrides.

Design italien pensé pour le travail
Conçue avec le studio milanais Morpha, Sileopod allie esthétique italienne minimaliste et ingénierie acoustique. La finition extérieure Ombre (RAL 7022) affirme une présence élégante dans tout aménagement.

Moins de bruit. Plus de confidentialité.
Réduction du niveau de parole jusqu'à 32 dB (tests ISO 23351-1, performance acoustique Classe A) pour des appels confidentiels sans déranger l'entourage.

Air renouvelé & montage modulaire
La ventilation silencieuse renouvelle l'air toutes les 60 secondes, avec détection de présence pour l'éclairage et la ventilation. L'assemblage modulaire s'effectue à partir de 35 minutes.

Conception de la série UI1
La série UI1 repose sur une structure composite carbone avec isolation phonique carbone de 55 mm, panneaux acoustiques de 15 mm et moquette. Un ferme-porte automatique Honeywell assure un confort d'utilisation quotidien, et la gamme propose une option bureau réglable en hauteur.

• Modèle : UI1-M
• Finition extérieure : Ombre (RAL 7022)
• Dimensions extérieures (L × P × H) : 1500 × 1386 × 2240 mm
• Dimensions intérieures au sol (L × P) : 1346 × 1286 mm
• Poids : 499 kg
• Capacité : 2 personnes (entretiens, réunions en duo et travail collaboratif)
variants.extended_description_es:
Un lugar más tranquilo para pensar, hablar y trabajar con foco.

Aléjese del ruido ambiental. Sileopod UI1-M ofrece un refugio acústico cerrado pensado para 2 personas (reuniones uno a uno, entrevistas y trabajo colaborativo) en oficinas abiertas, aeropuertos, espacios públicos y entornos híbridos.

Diseño italiano para la jornada laboral
Desarrollada junto al equipo milanés Morpha, Sileopod combina estética italiana minimalista e ingeniería acústica. El acabado exterior Sombra (RAL 7022) aporta elegancia a cualquier espacio.

Menos distracciones. Más privacidad.
Reducción del nivel de voz de hasta 32 dB (ensayos ISO 23351-1, rendimiento acústico Clase A) para mantener la privacidad de cada conversación.

Aire fresco y montaje rápido
Ventiladores silenciosos renuevan el aire interior cada 60 segundos, con iluminación y ventilación activadas por presencia. Su sistema modular permite el montaje desde 35 minutos.

Construcción de la serie UI1
La serie UI1 emplea una estructura compuesta de carbono con aislamiento acústico de carbono de 55 mm, paneles acústicos de 15 mm y moqueta. Un cierrapuertas automático Honeywell aporta comodidad diaria y la gama incluye la opción de escritorio regulable en altura.

variants.extended_description_it:
Uno spazio più silenzioso per pensare, parlare e lavorare al meglio.

Allontanati dal brusio dell'open space. Sileopod UI1-M offre uno spazio acustico chiuso pensato per 2 persone (colloqui, riunioni a due e lavoro collaborativo), ideale per uffici, aeroporti, aree pubbliche e ambienti ibridi.

Design italiano per il lavoro quotidiano
Sviluppata con il team milanese Morpha, Sileopod unisce stile italiano minimalista e ingegneria acustica. La finitura esterna Ombra (RAL 7022) valorizza con equilibrio ogni ambiente.

Meno distrazioni. Più privacy.
Riduzione del livello vocale fino a 32 dB (test ISO 23351-1, classe acustica A) per conversazioni riservate senza disturbare chi lavora vicino.

Aria sempre fresca e montaggio rapido
Ventole silenziose rinnovano l'aria ogni 60 secondi con accensione automatica di luce e ventilazione tramite sensore di presenza. La struttura modulare consente il montaggio a partire da 35 minuti.

Struttura della serie UI1
La serie UI1 utilizza una struttura in composito di carbonio con isolamento acustico al carbonio da 55 mm, pannelli acustici da 15 mm e moquette. Un chiudiporta automatico Honeywell garantisce praticità quotidiana e la gamma include l'opzione scrivania regolabile in altezza.

variants.extended_description_por:
Um espaço mais silencioso para pensar, falar e trabalhar com concentração.

Design italiano para o dia de trabalho
Desenvolvida com a equipa de design milanesa Morpha, a Sileopod combina linhas minimalistas italianas com engenharia acústica. O acabamento exterior Umbra (RAL 7022) integra-se perfeitamente em interiores modernos.

Menos distrações. Mais privacidade.
Redução do nível de voz até 32 dB (testes ISO 23351-1, desempenho acústico Classe A) para chamadas confidenciais sem perturbar quem trabalha por perto.

Ar fresco e montagem modular
Ventiladores silenciosos renovam o ar interior a cada 60 segundos, com iluminação e ventilação ativadas por sensor de presença. A construção modular permite montagem a partir de 35 minutos.

Construção da série UI1

variants.extended_description_en:
A quieter place to think, talk and get things done.

Bring a little more privacy to the conversations that matter, with a dedicated space for two. Room for two makes it a practical choice for one-to-one meetings, interviews, collaborative work and video calls. Sileopod UI1-M brings an enclosed acoustic space to offices, public spaces and hybrid workplaces, helping people find focus within a lively shared environment.

Italian design, made for the working day
Developed with Milan design team Morpha, Sileopod combines minimalist Italian styling with acoustic engineering. The Blue (RAL 7031) exterior gives this booth a clear identity, whether it blends into a calm office scheme or adds a distinctive accent.

Less distraction. More privacy.
The manufacturer reports speech-level reduction of up to 32 dB for its range, with full-unit testing to ISO 23351-1 and Class A acoustic performance for private calls. In everyday terms, the design helps reduce how much speech carries beyond the booth, so conversations are less distracting to the people working nearby.

Fresh air for a more comfortable workspace
The Sileopod ventilation concept renews the air inside the booth every 60 seconds. Low-noise fans are designed to keep fresh air moving without becoming a distraction, while presence-activated lighting and ventilation make the space convenient to use.

Modular design. Faster setup.
Clip-together components and magnetic panels simplify installation, with assembly in as little as 35 minutes according to the manufacturer. This modular approach makes it easier to introduce a dedicated quiet space into an existing workplace.

Built for everyday use
The UI1 uses a carbon composite structure with 55 mm carbon sound insulation, 15 mm acoustic panels and carpet. A Honeywell automatic door closer supports convenient everyday use, and the range includes a height-adjustable desk option.

Make it fit your space
Interior acoustic panels, carpet and upholstery can be colour-matched to order. Tabletop choices include white, black and oak veneer. Furniture layouts vary by booth size, from individual desk setups to face-to-face seating or meeting furniture; confirm your chosen layout and included items when ordering.

At a glance
Model: UI1-M
Exterior finish: Blue (RAL 7031)
External dimensions (W × D × H): 1500 × 1386 × 2240 mm.
Internal floor dimensions (W × D): 1346 × 1286 mm.
Weight: 499 kg.
Capacity: 2 people.
Construction details: Carbon composite structure with 55 mm carbon sound insulation. 15 mm acoustic panels and carpet. Honeywell automatic door closer. The catalogue lists a height-adjustable desk; confirm the supplied furniture configuration when ordering.

The acoustic, air-renewal and assembly figures above are manufacturer-stated range figures. Performance, setup time and equipment depend on the model, configuration and installation conditions.

variants.extended_description_en:
A quieter place to think, talk and get things done.

Bring a little more privacy to the conversations that matter, with a dedicated space for two. Room for two makes it a practical choice for one-to-one meetings, interviews, collaborative work and video calls. Sileopod UI1-M brings an enclosed acoustic space to offices, public spaces and hybrid workplaces, helping people find focus within a lively shared environment.

Italian design, made for the working day
Developed with Milan design team Morpha, Sileopod combines minimalist Italian styling with acoustic engineering. The Cement (RAL 7033) exterior gives this booth a clear identity, whether it blends into a calm office scheme or adds a distinctive accent.

Less distraction. More privacy.
The manufacturer reports speech-level reduction of up to 32 dB for its range, with full-unit testing to ISO 23351-1 and Class A acoustic performance for private calls. In everyday terms, the design helps reduce how much speech carries beyond the booth, so conversations are less distracting to the people working nearby.

Fresh air for a more comfortable workspace
The Sileopod ventilation concept renews the air inside the booth every 60 seconds. Low-noise fans are designed to keep fresh air moving without becoming a distraction, while presence-activated lighting and ventilation make the space convenient to use.

Modular design. Faster setup.
Clip-together components and magnetic panels simplify installation, with assembly in as little as 35 minutes according to the manufacturer. This modular approach makes it easier to introduce a dedicated quiet space into an existing workplace.

Built for everyday use
The UI1 uses a carbon composite structure with 55 mm carbon sound insulation, 15 mm acoustic panels and carpet. A Honeywell automatic door closer supports convenient everyday use, and the range includes a height-adjustable desk option.

Make it fit your space
Interior acoustic panels, carpet and upholstery can be colour-matched to order. Tabletop choices include white, black and oak veneer. Furniture layouts vary by booth size, from individual desk setups to face-to-face seating or meeting furniture; confirm your chosen layout and included items when ordering.

At a glance
Model: UI1-M
Exterior finish: Cement (RAL 7033)
External dimensions (W × D × H): 1500 × 1386 × 2240 mm.
Internal floor dimensions (W × D): 1346 × 1286 mm.
Weight: 499 kg.
Capacity: 2 people.
Construction details: Carbon composite structure with 55 mm carbon sound insulation. 15 mm acoustic panels and carpet. Honeywell automatic door closer. The catalogue lists a height-adjustable desk; confirm the supplied furniture configuration when ordering.

The acoustic, air-renewal and assembly figures above are manufacturer-stated range figures. Performance, setup time and equipment depend on the model, configuration and installation conditions.

variants.extended_description_en:
A quieter place to think, talk and get things done.

Bring a little more privacy to the conversations that matter, with a dedicated space for two. Room for two makes it a practical choice for one-to-one meetings, interviews, collaborative work and video calls. Sileopod UI1-M brings an enclosed acoustic space to offices, public spaces and hybrid workplaces, helping people find focus within a lively shared environment.

Italian design, made for the working day
Developed with Milan design team Morpha, Sileopod combines minimalist Italian styling with acoustic engineering. The Red (RAL 3013) exterior gives this booth a clear identity, whether it blends into a calm office scheme or adds a distinctive accent.

Less distraction. More privacy.
The manufacturer reports speech-level reduction of up to 32 dB for its range, with full-unit testing to ISO 23351-1 and Class A acoustic performance for private calls. In everyday terms, the design helps reduce how much speech carries beyond the booth, so conversations are less distracting to the people working nearby.

Fresh air for a more comfortable workspace
The Sileopod ventilation concept renews the air inside the booth every 60 seconds. Low-noise fans are designed to keep fresh air moving without becoming a distraction, while presence-activated lighting and ventilation make the space convenient to use.

Modular design. Faster setup.
Clip-together components and magnetic panels simplify installation, with assembly in as little as 35 minutes according to the manufacturer. This modular approach makes it easier to introduce a dedicated quiet space into an existing workplace.

Built for everyday use
The UI1 uses a carbon composite structure with 55 mm carbon sound insulation, 15 mm acoustic panels and carpet. A Honeywell automatic door closer supports convenient everyday use, and the range includes a height-adjustable desk option.

Make it fit your space
Interior acoustic panels, carpet and upholstery can be colour-matched to order. Tabletop choices include white, black and oak veneer. Furniture layouts vary by booth size, from individual desk setups to face-to-face seating or meeting furniture; confirm your chosen layout and included items when ordering.

At a glance
Model: UI1-M
Exterior finish: Red (RAL 3013)
External dimensions (W × D × H): 1500 × 1386 × 2240 mm.
Internal floor dimensions (W × D): 1346 × 1286 mm.
Weight: 499 kg.
Capacity: 2 people.
Construction details: Carbon composite structure with 55 mm carbon sound insulation. 15 mm acoustic panels and carpet. Honeywell automatic door closer. The catalogue lists a height-adjustable desk; confirm the supplied furniture configuration when ordering.

The acoustic, air-renewal and assembly figures above are manufacturer-stated range figures. Performance, setup time and equipment depend on the model, configuration and installation conditions.

variants.extended_description_de:
Ein ruhigerer Ort zum Denken, Sprechen und konzentrierten Arbeiten.

Lassen Sie den Trubel des Großraumbüros hinter sich. Die Sileopod UI1-M bietet Platz für 2 Personen (1:1-Gespräche, Interviews & gemeinsames Arbeiten) und schafft eine geschlossene akustische Rückzugszone in Büros, Flughäfen, Cafés und hybriden Arbeitswelten.

Italienisches Design für den Arbeitsalltag
Entwickelt mit dem Mailänder Designteam Morpha vereint Sileopod minimalistisches italienisches Design mit durchdachter Akustiktechnik. Die Oberfläche in Tomatenrot (RAL 3013) fügt sich harmonisch in moderne Räume ein.

Weniger Ablenkung. Mehr Privatsphäre.
Bis zu 32 dB Sprachpegelreduzierung (ISO 23351-1, Akustikklasse A) sorgen dafür, dass vertrauliche Gespräche in der Kabine bleiben und das Umfeld ruhig bleibt.

Frische Luft & schneller Aufbau
Leise Lüfter erneuern die Innenluft alle 60 Sekunden, gesteuert über Präsenzsensoren für Licht und Belüftung. Dank modularer Steck- und Magnetelemente gelingt die Montage ab ca. 35 Minuten.

Konstruktion der Serie UI1
Die UI1-Serie nutzt eine Carbon-Verbundstruktur mit 55 mm Carbon-Schalldämmung, 15 mm Akustikpaneelen und Teppichboden. Ein automatischer Honeywell-Türschließer sorgt für hohen Alltagskomfort, und die Serie bietet zudem die Option auf einen höhenverstellbaren Schreibtisch.

Auf einen Blick
• Modell: UI1-M
• Außenfarbe: Tomatenrot (RAL 3013)
• Außenmaße (B × T × H): 1500 × 1386 × 2240 mm
• Innenmaße Boden (B × T): 1346 × 1286 mm
• Gewicht: 499 kg
• Kapazität: 2 Personen (1:1-Gespräche, Interviews & gemeinsames Arbeiten)
variants.extended_description_fr:
Un espace plus calme pour réfléchir, échanger et avancer efficacement.

Éloignez-vous du bruit ambiant. La Sileopod UI1-M offre un refuge acoustique conçu pour 2 personnes (entretiens, réunions en duo et travail collaboratif), idéal pour les bureaux ouverts, aéroports, espaces publics et environnements hybrides.

Design italien pensé pour le travail
Conçue avec le studio milanais Morpha, Sileopod allie esthétique italienne minimaliste et ingénierie acoustique. La finition extérieure Rouge (RAL 3013) affirme une présence élégante dans tout aménagement.

Moins de bruit. Plus de confidentialité.
Réduction du niveau de parole jusqu'à 32 dB (tests ISO 23351-1, performance acoustique Classe A) pour des appels confidentiels sans déranger l'entourage.

Air renouvelé & montage modulaire
La ventilation silencieuse renouvelle l'air toutes les 60 secondes, avec détection de présence pour l'éclairage et la ventilation. L'assemblage modulaire s'effectue à partir de 35 minutes.

Conception de la série UI1
La série UI1 repose sur une structure composite carbone avec isolation phonique carbone de 55 mm, panneaux acoustiques de 15 mm et moquette. Un ferme-porte automatique Honeywell assure un confort d'utilisation quotidien, et la gamme propose une option bureau réglable en hauteur.

En résumé
• Modèle : UI1-M
• Finition extérieure : Rouge (RAL 3013)
• Dimensions extérieures (L × P × H) : 1500 × 1386 × 2240 mm
• Dimensions intérieures au sol (L × P) : 1346 × 1286 mm
• Poids : 499 kg
• Capacité : 2 personnes (entretiens, réunions en duo et travail collaboratif)
variants.extended_description_es:
Un lugar más tranquilo para pensar, hablar y trabajar con foco.

Aléjese del ruido ambiental. Sileopod UI1-M ofrece un refugio acústico cerrado pensado para 2 personas (reuniones uno a uno, entrevistas y trabajo colaborativo) en oficinas abiertas, aeropuertos, espacios públicos y entornos híbridos.

Diseño italiano para la jornada laboral
Desarrollada junto al equipo milanés Morpha, Sileopod combina estética italiana minimalista e ingeniería acústica. El acabado exterior Rojo (RAL 3013) aporta elegancia a cualquier espacio.

Menos distracciones. Más privacidad.
Reducción del nivel de voz de hasta 32 dB (ensayos ISO 23351-1, rendimiento acústico Clase A) para mantener la privacidad de cada conversación.

Aire fresco y montaje rápido
Ventiladores silenciosos renuevan el aire interior cada 60 segundos, con iluminación y ventilación activadas por presencia. Su sistema modular permite el montaje desde 35 minutos.

Construcción de la serie UI1
La serie UI1 emplea una estructura compuesta de carbono con aislamiento acústico de carbono de 55 mm, paneles acústicos de 15 mm y moqueta. Un cierrapuertas automático Honeywell aporta comodidad diaria y la gama incluye la opción de escritorio regulable en altura.

De un vistazo
• Modelo: UI1-M
• Acabado exterior: Rojo (RAL 3013)
• Dimensiones exteriores (An × Pr × Al): 1500 × 1386 × 2240 mm
• Dimensiones interiores de suelo (An × Pr): 1346 × 1286 mm
• Peso: 499 kg
• Capacidad: 2 personas (reuniones uno a uno, entrevistas y trabajo colaborativo)
variants.extended_description_it:
Uno spazio più silenzioso per pensare, parlare e lavorare al meglio.

Allontanati dal brusio dell'open space. Sileopod UI1-M offre uno spazio acustico chiuso pensato per 2 persone (colloqui, riunioni a due e lavoro collaborativo), ideale per uffici, aeroporti, aree pubbliche e ambienti ibridi.

Design italiano per il lavoro quotidiano
Sviluppata con il team milanese Morpha, Sileopod unisce stile italiano minimalista e ingegneria acustica. La finitura esterna Rosso (RAL 3013) valorizza con equilibrio ogni ambiente.

Meno distrazioni. Più privacy.
Riduzione del livello vocale fino a 32 dB (test ISO 23351-1, classe acustica A) per conversazioni riservate senza disturbare chi lavora vicino.

Aria sempre fresca e montaggio rapido
Ventole silenziose rinnovano l'aria ogni 60 secondi con accensione automatica di luce e ventilazione tramite sensore di presenza. La struttura modulare consente il montaggio a partire da 35 minuti.

Struttura della serie UI1
La serie UI1 utilizza una struttura in composito di carbonio con isolamento acustico al carbonio da 55 mm, pannelli acustici da 15 mm e moquette. Un chiudiporta automatico Honeywell garantisce praticità quotidiana e la gamma include l'opzione scrivania regolabile in altezza.

In sintesi
• Modello: UI1-M
• Finitura esterna: Rosso (RAL 3013)
• Dimensioni esterne (L × P × A): 1500 × 1386 × 2240 mm
• Dimensioni interne pavimento (L × P): 1346 × 1286 mm
• Peso: 499 kg
• Capacità: 2 persone (colloqui, riunioni a due e lavoro collaborativo)
variants.extended_description_por:
Um espaço mais silencioso para pensar, falar e trabalhar com concentração.

Afaste-se do ruído dos espaços abertos. A Sileopod UI1-M cria um refúgio acústico fechado para 2 pessoas (reuniões individuais, entrevistas e trabalho colaborativo), ideal para escritórios, aeroportos, espaços públicos e ambientes híbridos.

Design italiano para o dia de trabalho
Desenvolvida com a equipa de design milanesa Morpha, a Sileopod combina linhas minimalistas italianas com engenharia acústica. O acabamento exterior Vermelho (RAL 3013) integra-se perfeitamente em interiores modernos.

Menos distrações. Mais privacidade.
Redução do nível de voz até 32 dB (testes ISO 23351-1, desempenho acústico Classe A) para chamadas confidenciais sem perturbar quem trabalha por perto.

Ar fresco e montagem modular
Ventiladores silenciosos renovam o ar interior a cada 60 segundos, com iluminação e ventilação ativadas por sensor de presença. A construção modular permite montagem a partir de 35 minutos.

Construção da série UI1
A série UI1 utiliza uma estrutura em compósito de carbono com isolamento acústico de carbono de 55 mm, painéis acústicos de 15 mm e alcatifa. Uma mola de porta automática Honeywell garante praticidade diária e a gama inclui a opção de secretária regulável em altura.

• Modelo: UI1-M
• Acabamento exterior: Vermelho (RAL 3013)
• Dimensões exteriores (L × P × A): 1500 × 1386 × 2240 mm
• Dimensões interiores do piso (L × P): 1346 × 1286 mm
• Peso: 499 kg
• Capacidade: 2 pessoas (reuniões individuais, entrevistas e trabalho colaborativo)

Éloignez-vous du bruit ambiant. La Sileopod UI1-M offre un refuge acoustique conçu pour 2 personnes (entretiens, réunions en duo et travail collaboratif), idéal pour les bureaux ouverts, aéroports, espaces publics et environnements hybrides.

Design italien pensé pour le travail
Conçue avec le studio milanais Morpha, Sileopod allie esthétique italienne minimaliste et ingénierie acoustique. La finition extérieure Vert (RAL 6005) affirme une présence élégante dans tout aménagement.

Moins de bruit. Plus de confidentialité.

variants.extended_description_en:
A quieter place to think, talk and get things done.

Bring a little more privacy to the conversations that matter, with a dedicated space for two. Room for two makes it a practical choice for one-to-one meetings, interviews, collaborative work and video calls. Sileopod UI1-M brings an enclosed acoustic space to offices, public spaces and hybrid workplaces, helping people find focus within a lively shared environment.

Italian design, made for the working day
Developed with Milan design team Morpha, Sileopod combines minimalist Italian styling with acoustic engineering. The Altrosa (RAL 3014) exterior gives this booth a clear identity, whether it blends into a calm office scheme or adds a distinctive accent.

Less distraction. More privacy.
The manufacturer reports speech-level reduction of up to 32 dB for its range, with full-unit testing to ISO 23351-1 and Class A acoustic performance for private calls. In everyday terms, the design helps reduce how much speech carries beyond the booth, so conversations are less distracting to the people working nearby.

Fresh air for a more comfortable workspace
The Sileopod ventilation concept renews the air inside the booth every 60 seconds. Low-noise fans are designed to keep fresh air moving without becoming a distraction, while presence-activated lighting and ventilation make the space convenient to use.

Modular design. Faster setup.
Clip-together components and magnetic panels simplify installation, with assembly in as little as 35 minutes according to the manufacturer. This modular approach makes it easier to introduce a dedicated quiet space into an existing workplace.

Built for everyday use
The UI1 uses a carbon composite structure with 55 mm carbon sound insulation, 15 mm acoustic panels and carpet. A Honeywell automatic door closer supports convenient everyday use, and the range includes a height-adjustable desk option.

Make it fit your space
Interior acoustic panels, carpet and upholstery can be colour-matched to order. Tabletop choices include white, black and oak veneer. Furniture layouts vary by booth size, from individual desk setups to face-to-face seating or meeting furniture; confirm your chosen layout and included items when ordering.

At a glance
Model: UI1-M
Exterior finish: Altrosa (RAL 3014)
External dimensions (W × D × H): 1500 × 1386 × 2240 mm.
Internal floor dimensions (W × D): 1346 × 1286 mm.
Weight: 499 kg.
Capacity: 2 people.
Construction details: Carbon composite structure with 55 mm carbon sound insulation. 15 mm acoustic panels and carpet. Honeywell automatic door closer. The catalogue lists a height-adjustable desk; confirm the supplied furniture configuration when ordering.

The acoustic, air-renewal and assembly figures above are manufacturer-stated range figures. Performance, setup time and equipment depend on the model, configuration and installation conditions.

Afaste-se do ruído dos espaços abertos. A Sileopod UI1-M cria um refúgio acústico fechado para 2 pessoas (reuniões individuais, entrevistas e trabalho colaborativo), ideal para escritórios, aeroportos, espaços públicos e ambientes híbridos.

Design italiano para o dia de trabalho
Desenvolvida com a equipa de design milanesa Morpha, a Sileopod combina linhas minimalistas italianas com engenharia acústica. O acabamento exterior Rosa Antigo (RAL 3014) integra-se perfeitamente em interiores modernos.

Menos distrações. Mais privacidade.
Redução do nível de voz até 32 dB (testes ISO 23351-1, desempenho acústico Classe A) para chamadas confidenciais sem perturbar quem trabalha por perto.

Ar fresco e montagem modular
Ventiladores silenciosos renovam o ar interior a cada 60 segundos, com iluminação e ventilação ativadas por sensor de presença. A construção modular permite montagem a partir de 35 minutos.

Construção da série UI1
A série UI1 utiliza uma estrutura em compósito de carbono com isolamento acústico de carbono de 55 mm, painéis acústicos de 15 mm e alcatifa. Uma mola de porta automática Honeywell garante praticidade diária e a gama inclui a opção de secretária regulável em altura.

Em resumo
• Modelo: UI1-M
• Acabamento exterior: Rosa Antigo (RAL 3014)
• Dimensões exteriores (L × P × A): 1500 × 1386 × 2240 mm
• Dimensões interiores do piso (L × P): 1346 × 1286 mm
• Peso: 499 kg
• Capacidade: 2 pessoas (reuniões individuais, entrevistas e trabalho colaborativo)

variants.extended_description_en:
A quieter place to think, talk and get things done.

Give small teams a quieter place to connect, exchange ideas and move work forward. Designed for up to four people, it creates a useful setting for small meetings, brainstorming and hybrid team calls. Sileopod UI1-L brings an enclosed acoustic space to offices, public spaces and hybrid workplaces, helping people find focus within a lively shared environment.

Italian design, made for the working day
Developed with Milan design team Morpha, Sileopod combines minimalist Italian styling with acoustic engineering. The White (RAL 9003) exterior gives this booth a clear identity, whether it blends into a calm office scheme or adds a distinctive accent.

Less distraction. More privacy.
The manufacturer reports speech-level reduction of up to 32 dB for its range, with full-unit testing to ISO 23351-1 and Class A acoustic performance for private calls. In everyday terms, the design helps reduce how much speech carries beyond the booth, so conversations are less distracting to the people working nearby.

Fresh air for a more comfortable workspace
The Sileopod ventilation concept renews the air inside the booth every 60 seconds. Low-noise fans are designed to keep fresh air moving without becoming a distraction, while presence-activated lighting and ventilation make the space convenient to use.

Modular design. Faster setup.
Clip-together components and magnetic panels simplify installation, with assembly in as little as 35 minutes according to the manufacturer. This modular approach makes it easier to introduce a dedicated quiet space into an existing workplace.

Built for everyday use
The UI1 uses a carbon composite structure with 55 mm carbon sound insulation, 15 mm acoustic panels and carpet. A Honeywell automatic door closer supports convenient everyday use, and the range includes a height-adjustable desk option.

Make it fit your space
Interior acoustic panels, carpet and upholstery can be colour-matched to order. Tabletop choices include white, black and oak veneer. Furniture layouts vary by booth size, from individual desk setups to face-to-face seating or meeting furniture; confirm your chosen layout and included items when ordering.

At a glance
Model: UI1-L
Exterior finish: White (RAL 9003)
External dimensions (W × D × H): 2200 × 1386 × 2240 mm.
Internal floor dimensions (W × D): 2046 × 1286 mm.
Weight: 650 kg.
Capacity: 4 people.
Construction details: Carbon composite structure with 55 mm carbon sound insulation. 15 mm acoustic panels and carpet. Honeywell automatic door closer. The catalogue lists a height-adjustable desk; confirm the supplied furniture configuration when ordering.

The acoustic, air-renewal and assembly figures above are manufacturer-stated range figures. Performance, setup time and equipment depend on the model, configuration and installation conditions.
