variants.extended_description_de:
Ein ruhigerer Ort zum Denken, Sprechen und konzentrierten Arbeiten.

Lassen Sie den Trubel des Großraumbüros hinter sich. Die Sileopod UI1-XL bietet Platz für Großformatige Besprechungs- und Teamkabine (XL) und schafft eine geschlossene akustische Rückzugszone in Büros, Flughäfen, Cafés und hybriden Arbeitswelten.

Italienisches Design für den Arbeitsalltag
Entwickelt mit dem Mailänder Designteam Morpha vereint Sileopod minimalistisches italienisches Design mit durchdachter Akustiktechnik. Die Oberfläche in Tomatenrot (RAL 3013) fügt sich harmonisch in moderne Räume ein.

Weniger Ablenkung. Mehr Privatsphäre.
Bis zu 32 dB Sprachpegelreduzierung (ISO 23351-1, Akustikklasse A) sorgen dafür, dass vertrauliche Gespräche in der Kabine bleiben und das Umfeld ruhig bleibt.

Frische Luft & schneller Aufbau
Leise Lüfter erneuern die Innenluft alle 60 Sekunden, gesteuert über Präsenzsensoren für Licht und Belüftung. Dank modularer Steck- und Magnetelemente gelingt die Montage ab ca. 35 Minuten.

Konstruktion der Serie UI1
Die UI1-Serie nutzt eine Carbon-Verbundstruktur mit 55 mm Carbon-Schalldämmung, 15 mm Akustikpaneelen und Teppichboden. Ein automatischer Honeywell-Türschließer sorgt für hohen Alltagskomfort, und die Serie bietet zudem die Option auf einen höhenverstellbaren Schreibtisch.

Auf einen Blick
• Modell: UI1-XL
• Außenfarbe: Tomatenrot (RAL 3013)
• Kapazität: Großformatige Besprechungs- und Teamkabine (XL)
variants.extended_description_fr:
Un espace plus calme pour réfléchir, échanger et avancer efficacement.

Éloignez-vous du bruit ambiant. La Sileopod UI1-XL offre un refuge acoustique conçu pour Cabine acoustique grand format pour équipes (XL), idéal pour les bureaux ouverts, aéroports, espaces publics et environnements hybrides.

Design italien pensé pour le travail
Conçue avec le studio milanais Morpha, Sileopod allie esthétique italienne minimaliste et ingénierie acoustique. La finition extérieure Rouge (RAL 3013) affirme une présence élégante dans tout aménagement.

Moins de bruit. Plus de confidentialité.
Réduction du niveau de parole jusqu'à 32 dB (tests ISO 23351-1, performance acoustique Classe A) pour des appels confidentiels sans déranger l'entourage.

Air renouvelé & montage modulaire
La ventilation silencieuse renouvelle l'air toutes les 60 secondes, avec détection de présence pour l'éclairage et la ventilation. L'assemblage modulaire s'effectue à partir de 35 minutes.

Conception de la série UI1
La série UI1 repose sur une structure composite carbone avec isolation phonique carbone de 55 mm, panneaux acoustiques de 15 mm et moquette. Un ferme-porte automatique Honeywell assure un confort d'utilisation quotidien, et la gamme propose une option bureau réglable en hauteur.

En résumé
• Modèle : UI1-XL
• Finition extérieure : Rouge (RAL 3013)
• Capacité : Cabine acoustique grand format pour équipes (XL)
variants.extended_description_es:
Un lugar más tranquilo para pensar, hablar y trabajar con foco.

Aléjese del ruido ambiental. Sileopod UI1-XL ofrece un refugio acústico cerrado pensado para Cabina acústica de gran formato para equipos (XL) en oficinas abiertas, aeropuertos, espacios públicos y entornos híbridos.

Diseño italiano para la jornada laboral
Desarrollada junto al equipo milanés Morpha, Sileopod combina estética italiana minimalista e ingeniería acústica. El acabado exterior Rojo (RAL 3013) aporta elegancia a cualquier espacio.

Menos distracciones. Más privacidad.
Reducción del nivel de voz de hasta 32 dB (ensayos ISO 23351-1, rendimiento acústico Clase A) para mantener la privacidad de cada conversación.

Aire fresco y montaje rápido
Ventiladores silenciosos renuevan el aire interior cada 60 segundos, con iluminación y ventilación activadas por presencia. Su sistema modular permite el montaje desde 35 minutos.

Construcción de la serie UI1
La serie UI1 emplea una estructura compuesta de carbono con aislamiento acústico de carbono de 55 mm, paneles acústicos de 15 mm y moqueta. Un cierrapuertas automático Honeywell aporta comodidad diaria y la gama incluye la opción de escritorio regulable en altura.

De un vistazo
• Modelo: UI1-XL
• Acabado exterior: Rojo (RAL 3013)
• Capacidad: Cabina acústica de gran formato para equipos (XL)
variants.extended_description_it:
Uno spazio più silenzioso per pensare, parlare e lavorare al meglio.

Allontanati dal brusio dell'open space. Sileopod UI1-XL offre uno spazio acustico chiuso pensato per Cabina acustica di grande formato per team (XL), ideale per uffici, aeroporti, aree pubbliche e ambienti ibridi.

Design italiano per il lavoro quotidiano
Sviluppata con il team milanese Morpha, Sileopod unisce stile italiano minimalista e ingegneria acustica. La finitura esterna Rosso (RAL 3013) valorizza con equilibrio ogni ambiente.

Meno distrazioni. Più privacy.
Riduzione del livello vocale fino a 32 dB (test ISO 23351-1, classe acustica A) per conversazioni riservate senza disturbare chi lavora vicino.

Aria sempre fresca e montaggio rapido
Ventole silenziose rinnovano l'aria ogni 60 secondi con accensione automatica di luce e ventilazione tramite sensore di presenza. La struttura modulare consente il montaggio a partire da 35 minuti.

Struttura della serie UI1
La serie UI1 utilizza una struttura in composito di carbonio con isolamento acustico al carbonio da 55 mm, pannelli acustici da 15 mm e moquette. Un chiudiporta automatico Honeywell garantisce praticità quotidiana e la gamma include l'opzione scrivania regolabile in altezza.

In sintesi
• Modello: UI1-XL
• Finitura esterna: Rosso (RAL 3013)
• Capacità: Cabina acustica di grande formato per team (XL)
variants.extended_description_por:
Um espaço mais silencioso para pensar, falar e trabalhar com concentração.

Afaste-se do ruído dos espaços abertos. A Sileopod UI1-XL cria um refúgio acústico fechado para Cabine acústica de grande formato para equipas (XL), ideal para escritórios, aeroportos, espaços públicos e ambientes híbridos.

Design italiano para o dia de trabalho
Desenvolvida com a equipa de design milanesa Morpha, a Sileopod combina linhas minimalistas italianas com engenharia acústica. O acabamento exterior Vermelho (RAL 3013) integra-se perfeitamente em interiores modernos.

Menos distrações. Mais privacidade.
Redução do nível de voz até 32 dB (testes ISO 23351-1, desempenho acústico Classe A) para chamadas confidenciais sem perturbar quem trabalha por perto.

Ar fresco e montagem modular
Ventiladores silenciosos renovam o ar interior a cada 60 segundos, com iluminação e ventilação ativadas por sensor de presença. A construção modular permite montagem a partir de 35 minutos.

Construção da série UI1
A série UI1 utiliza uma estrutura em compósito de carbono com isolamento acústico de carbono de 55 mm, painéis acústicos de 15 mm e alcatifa. Uma mola de porta automática Honeywell garante praticidade diária e a gama inclui a opção de secretária regulável em altura.

Em resumo
• Modelo: UI1-XL
• Acabamento exterior: Vermelho (RAL 3013)
• Capacidade: Cabine acústica de grande formato para equipas (XL)

variants.extended_description_en:
A quieter place to think, talk and get things done.

Create a dedicated acoustic space within a busy workplace, with the larger-format Sileopod UI1-XL. An XL option in the UI1 family for projects that need an additional enclosed acoustic space. Confirm the room layout, capacity and dimensions for your selected configuration. Sileopod UI1-XL brings an enclosed acoustic space to offices, public spaces and hybrid workplaces, helping people find focus within a lively shared environment.

Italian design, made for the working day
Developed with Milan design team Morpha, Sileopod combines minimalist Italian styling with acoustic engineering. The Altrosa (RAL 3014) exterior gives this booth a clear identity, whether it blends into a calm office scheme or adds a distinctive accent.

Less distraction. More privacy.
The manufacturer reports speech-level reduction of up to 32 dB for its range, with full-unit testing to ISO 23351-1 and Class A acoustic performance for private calls. In everyday terms, the design helps reduce how much speech carries beyond the booth, so conversations are less distracting to the people working nearby.

Fresh air for a more comfortable workspace
The Sileopod ventilation concept renews the air inside the booth every 60 seconds. Low-noise fans are designed to keep fresh air moving without becoming a distraction, while presence-activated lighting and ventilation make the space convenient to use.

Modular design. Faster setup.
Clip-together components and magnetic panels simplify installation, with assembly in as little as 35 minutes according to the manufacturer. This modular approach makes it easier to introduce a dedicated quiet space into an existing workplace.

The UI1-XL belongs to the Sileopod carbon composite family. Model-specific construction details and equipment should be confirmed for the selected XL configuration.

Make it fit your space
Interior acoustic panels, carpet and upholstery can be colour-matched to order. Tabletop choices include white, black and oak veneer. Furniture layouts vary by booth size, from individual desk setups to face-to-face seating or meeting furniture; confirm your chosen layout and included items when ordering.

At a glance
Model: UI1-XL
Exterior finish: Altrosa (RAL 3014)
UI1-XL dimensions, weight, capacity and included furniture: to be confirmed.

The acoustic, air-renewal and assembly figures above are manufacturer-stated range figures. Performance, setup time and equipment depend on the model, configuration and installation conditions.

variants.extended_description_en:
Your music. Your moment. Your Moonchair.

Moonchair invites you to slow down and stay a little longer. Put your feet up on the matching ottoman, play a favourite album and let an ordinary evening become a moment to look forward to. With its enveloping round silhouette, generous cushioning and built-in Bluetooth HiFi audio, Moonchair brings comfort, music and sculptural design together in one distinctive lounge set.

A shape that draws you in
Created by Paris-based French designer JF Rolet, Moonchair opens towards you in layers of upholstered rings. The rounded shell frames a thick circular seat cushion and a contoured backrest, creating an inviting place to curl up with a book, enjoy a playlist or simply pause. An internal steel frame gives structure to the expressive form, while foam cushioning softens the seat and back.

Put your feet up and settle in
The matching round ottoman completes the experience, giving you somewhere to rest your feet as you unwind. Its upholstered top and ribbed base echo the chair's rounded design, so the two pieces feel like a considered pair. Together, they create a ready-made retreat in a living room, bedroom corner or dedicated listening space.

Your soundtrack, built into your seat
The Bluetooth-connected HiFi speaker system is integrated into the chair's shell, bringing your music into the design itself. Pair your device using the built-in Bluetooth button, then tailor your listening with separate volume, bass and treble controls. The control panel also includes a power control and a USB port, keeping the audio controls close at hand.

Turn towards whatever matters
A full 360° swivel on a five-star metal base lets the chair move with the moment. Turn towards a conversation, face the room or enjoy a different view without shifting the whole chair. The open, rounded form makes Moonchair a striking focal point from different angles.

Texture that brings the curves to life
The 3D mesh upholstery adds a tactile, dimensional finish to the layered silhouette. Fabric 77912 is made from 100% polyester, with a fabric weight of 530 g/m². This version is Orange, colour code 03: a distinctive finishing touch for your own corner of the room.

At a glance
• Set: lounge chair with matching round ottoman
• Designer: JF Rolet, Paris
• Manufacturer model: LN6789
• Chair dimensions: 114 × 104 × 135 cm (width × depth × height)
• Structure: internal steel frame with foam cushioning
• Base: five-star metal base with 360° swivel
• Audio: built-in Bluetooth HiFi speaker system
• Controls: power, Bluetooth pairing, volume, bass and treble
• Connection: USB port
• Upholstery: textured 3D mesh, 100% polyester
• Fabric: 77912 / Orange / colour code 03

Make room for your next favourite moment. Moonchair gives your music, your reading time and your evening wind-down a place of their own.

Please confirm your chosen fabric swatch before ordering. Product photographs show reference finishes and may differ from the selected colour.

variants.extended_description_de:
Ihre Musik. Ihr Moment. Ihr Moonchair.

Moonchair lädt zum Entschleunigen ein. Legen Sie die Füße auf dem passenden runden Hocker hoch, starten Sie Ihre Lieblingsplaylist und genießen Sie skulpturales Design mit integriertem Bluetooth-HiFi-Klang.

Entworfen in Paris von JF Rolet
Die markante, aus gepolsterten Ringen geformte Schale umschließt ein dickes Sitzkissen und eine ergonomische Rückenlehne. Ein innenliegender Stahlrahmen sorgt für Stabilität, während weicher Schaumstoff hohen Sitzkomfort bietet.

Integriertes Bluetooth-HiFi-Soundsystem
Die Lautsprecher sind direkt in die Schale integriert. Koppeln Sie Ihr Gerät per Bluetooth-Taste und passen Sie Lautstärke, Bass und Höhen separat am Bedienfeld an – inklusive Ein-/Ausschalter und USB-Anschluss.

360° drehbar & strukturierter 3D-Mesh-Bezug
Auf dem fünfstrahligen Metallfuß dreht sich der Moonchair mühelos um 360°. Der 3D-Mesh-Stoff 77912 (100 % Polyester, 530 g/m²) verleiht den Rundungen eine markante Tiefe. Ausführung: Orange (Farbcode 03).

Auf einen Blick
• Set: Lounge-Sessel inkl. passendem runden Hocker
• Designer: JF Rolet, Paris (Modell LN6789)
• Maße Sessel (B × T × H): 114 × 104 × 135 cm
• Gestell: Innenliegender Stahlrahmen mit Schaumpolsterung
• Fuß: Fünfstrahliger Metallfuß, 360° drehbar
• Audio: Integriertes Bluetooth-HiFi-System (Lautstärke, Bass, Höhen, USB)
• Bezug: Strukturierter 3D-Mesh-Stoff 77912 (100 % Polyester) – Orange (03)

variants.extended_description_fr:
Votre musique. Votre moment. Votre Moonchair.

Moonchair vous invite à ralentir et savourer l'instant. Posez vos pieds sur le pouf assorti, lancez votre album préféré et profitez d'un design sculptural intégrant un système audio HiFi Bluetooth.

Une forme signée JF Rolet, Paris
Sa coque arrondie composée d'anneaux rembourrés encadre un coussin d'assise circulaire généreux et un dossier enveloppant. Une structure interne en acier garantit la tenue, tandis que le garnissage mousse offre un confort durable.

Votre bande-son intégrée au fauteuil
Le système HiFi Bluetooth est intégré directement dans la coque. Appairez votre appareil en un geste et réglez séparément le volume, les basses et les aigus depuis le panneau de commande équipé d'un bouton marche/arrêt et d'un port USB.

Rotation 360° et tissu mesh 3D texturé
Monté sur un piètement métallique cinq branches pivotant à 360°, Moonchair s'adapte à chaque moment. Le tissu 77912 en mesh 3D (100 % polyester, 530 g/m²) sublime chaque courbe. Finition : Orange (code 03).

En résumé
• Ensemble : fauteuil lounge avec pouf rond assorti
• Designer : JF Rolet, Paris (modèle LN6789)
• Dimensions fauteuil (L × P × H) : 114 × 104 × 135 cm
• Structure : cadre interne en acier et mousse haute densité
• Base : piètement métal 5 branches pivotant à 360°
• Audio : enceintes HiFi Bluetooth intégrées (volume, basses, aigus, USB)
• Revêtement : mesh 3D texturé 77912 (100 % polyester) – Orange (03)

variants.extended_description_es:
Tu música. Tu momento. Tu Moonchair.

Moonchair invita a desconectar y disfrutar sin prisas. Apoya los pies en la otomana a juego, pon tu álbum favorito y descubre un icono de diseño con sonido HiFi Bluetooth integrado.

Diseño parisino de JF Rolet
Su carcasa esférica formada por anillos tapizados envuelve un grueso asiento circular y un respaldo ergonómico. Su estructura interna de acero aporta solidez y el acolchado de espuma garantiza máxima comodidad.

Sonido HiFi Bluetooth integrado
El sistema de altavoces HiFi se integra dentro de la propia carcasa. Empareja tu dispositivo mediante Bluetooth y ajusta por separado volumen, graves y agudos desde el panel integrado con interruptor y puerto USB.

Giro de 360° y malla 3D texturizada
Su base metálica de cinco puntas gira 360° con suavidad. El tejido 77912 en malla 3D (100 % poliéster, 530 g/m²) realza las curvas del diseño. Acabado: Naranja (código 03).

De un vistazo
• Conjunto: sillón lounge con otomana redonda a juego
• Diseñador: JF Rolet, París (modelo LN6789)
• Dimensiones del sillón (An × Pr × Al): 114 × 104 × 135 cm
• Estructura: bastidor interno de acero con acolchado de espuma
• Base: pie metálico de 5 radios con giro de 360°
• Audio: altavoces HiFi Bluetooth integrados (volumen, graves, agudos, USB)
• Tapizado: malla 3D texturizada 77912 (100 % poliéster) – Naranja (03)

Por favor, confirme su muestra de tejido antes de pedir. Las fotografías muestran acabados de referencia.
variants.extended_description_it:
La tua musica. Il tuo momento. La tua Moonchair.

Moonchair invita a rallentare e godersi il momento. Appoggia i piedi sul pouf coordinato, avvia la tua playlist preferita e lasciati avvolgere dal design scultoreo con audio HiFi Bluetooth integrato.

Creata a Parigi dal designer JF Rolet
La scocca tondeggiante a fasce imbottite racchiude un generoso cuscino circolare e uno schienale ergonomico. Il telaio interno in acciaio dona solidità, mentre l'imbottitura in schiuma assicura comfort avvolgente.

Audio HiFi Bluetooth integrato nella scocca
Abbina il tuo dispositivo con il tasto Bluetooth e personalizza il suono grazie ai controlli separati di volume, bassi e alti, completi di accensione e porta USB a portata di mano.

Rotazione a 360° e rivestimento 3D mesh
La base metallica a cinque razze ruota liberamente a 360°. Il tessuto 3D mesh 77912 (100% poliestere, 530 g/m²) valorizza ogni curva. Versione: Arancione (codice 03).

In sintesi
• Set: poltrona lounge con pouf rotondo coordinato
• Designer: JF Rolet, Parigi (modello LN6789)
• Dimensioni poltrona (L × P × A): 114 × 104 × 135 cm
• Struttura: telaio interno in acciaio con imbottitura in schiuma
• Base: base metallica a 5 razze girevole a 360°
• Audio: sistema HiFi Bluetooth integrato (volume, bassi, alti, USB)
• Rivestimento: rete 3D testurizzata 77912 (100% poliestere) – Arancione (03)

Conferma il campione di tessuto scelto prima di ordinare. Le fotografie mostrano finiture di riferimento.
variants.extended_description_por:
A sua música. O seu momento. A sua Moonchair.

A Moonchair convida a abrandar e aproveitar o momento. Apoie os pés no pufe a condizer, coloque o seu álbum favorito e desfrute de um design escultural com som HiFi Bluetooth integrado.

Criada em Paris pelo designer JF Rolet
A concha arredondada em anéis estofados envolve um assento circular generoso e um encosto anatómico. A estrutura interna em aço garante solidez e o acolchoamento em espuma oferece conforto duradouro.

Som HiFi Bluetooth integrado na estrutura
Emparelhe o seu dispositivo através do botão Bluetooth e ajuste separadamente volume, graves e agudos no painel lateral com interruptor e porta USB.

Rotação de 360° e malha 3D texturizada
A base metálica de cinco pontas gira suavemente 360°. O tecido 3D mesh 77912 (100% poliéster, 530 g/m²) dá profundidade a cada curva. Acabamento: Laranja (código 03).

Em resumo
• Conjunto: poltrona lounge com pufe redondo a condizer
• Designer: JF Rolet, Paris (modelo LN6789)
• Dimensões da poltrona (L × P × A): 114 × 104 × 135 cm
• Estrutura: armação interna em aço com acolchoamento em espuma
• Base: base metálica de 5 braços com rotação de 360°
• Áudio: sistema HiFi Bluetooth integrado (volume, graves, agudos, USB)
• Estofo: malha 3D texturizada 77912 (100% poliéster) – Laranja (03)

Confirme a amostra de tecido escolhida antes de encomendar. As fotografias mostram acabamentos de referência.

An internal steel frame gives structure to the expressive form, while foam cushioning softens the seat and back.

Put your feet up and settle in
The matching round ottoman completes the experience, giving you somewhere to rest your feet as you unwind. Its upholstered top and ribbed base echo the chair's rounded design, so the two pieces feel like a considered pair. Together, they create a ready-made retreat in a living room, bedroom corner or dedicated listening space.

Your soundtrack, built into your seat
The Bluetooth-connected HiFi speaker system is integrated into the chair's shell, bringing your music into the design itself. Pair your device using the built-in Bluetooth button, then tailor your listening with separate volume, bass and treble controls. The control panel also includes a power control and a USB port, keeping the audio controls close at hand.

Turn towards whatever matters
A full 360° swivel on a five-star metal base lets the chair move with the moment. Turn towards a conversation, face the room or enjoy a different view without shifting the whole chair. The open, rounded form makes Moonchair a striking focal point from different angles.

Texture that brings the curves to life
The 3D mesh upholstery adds a tactile, dimensional finish to the layered silhouette. Fabric 77912 is made from 100% polyester, with a fabric weight of 530 g/m². This version is Beige, colour code 08: a distinctive finishing touch for your own corner of the room.

variants.extended_description_de:
Ihre Musik. Ihr Moment. Ihr Moonchair.

Moonchair lädt zum Entschleunigen ein. Legen Sie die Füße auf dem passenden runden Hocker hoch, starten Sie Ihre Lieblingsplaylist und genießen Sie skulpturales Design mit integriertem Bluetooth-HiFi-Klang.

Entworfen in Paris von JF Rolet
Die markante, aus gepolsterten Ringen geformte Schale umschließt ein dickes Sitzkissen und eine ergonomische Rückenlehne. Ein innenliegender Stahlrahmen sorgt für Stabilität, während weicher Schaumstoff hohen Sitzkomfort bietet.

Integriertes Bluetooth-HiFi-Soundsystem
Die Lautsprecher sind direkt in die Schale integriert. Koppeln Sie Ihr Gerät per Bluetooth-Taste und passen Sie Lautstärke, Bass und Höhen separat am Bedienfeld an – inklusive Ein-/Ausschalter und USB-Anschluss.

360° drehbar & strukturierter 3D-Mesh-Bezug
Auf dem fünfstrahligen Metallfuß dreht sich der Moonchair mühelos um 360°. Der 3D-Mesh-Stoff 77912 (100 % Polyester, 530 g/m²) verleiht den Rundungen eine markante Tiefe. Ausführung: Beige (Farbcode 08).

Auf einen Blick
• Set: Lounge-Sessel inkl. passendem runden Hocker
• Designer: JF Rolet, Paris (Modell LN6789)
• Maße Sessel (B × T × H): 114 × 104 × 135 cm
• Gestell: Innenliegender Stahlrahmen mit Schaumpolsterung
• Fuß: Fünfstrahliger Metallfuß, 360° drehbar
• Audio: Integriertes Bluetooth-HiFi-System (Lautstärke, Bass, Höhen, USB)
• Bezug: Strukturierter 3D-Mesh-Stoff 77912 (100 % Polyester) – Beige (08)

variants.extended_description_fr:
Votre musique. Votre moment. Votre Moonchair.

Moonchair vous invite à ralentir et savourer l'instant. Posez vos pieds sur le pouf assorti, lancez votre album préféré et profitez d'un design sculptural intégrant un système audio HiFi Bluetooth.

Une forme signée JF Rolet, Paris
Sa coque arrondie composée d'anneaux rembourrés encadre un coussin d'assise circulaire généreux et un dossier enveloppant. Une structure interne en acier garantit la tenue, tandis que le garnissage mousse offre un confort durable.

Votre bande-son intégrée au fauteuil
Le système HiFi Bluetooth est intégré directement dans la coque. Appairez votre appareil en un geste et réglez séparément le volume, les basses et les aigus depuis le panneau de commande équipé d'un bouton marche/arrêt et d'un port USB.

Rotation 360° et tissu mesh 3D texturé
Monté sur un piètement métallique cinq branches pivotant à 360°, Moonchair s'adapte à chaque moment. Le tissu 77912 en mesh 3D (100 % polyester, 530 g/m²) sublime chaque courbe. Finition : Beige (code 08).

En résumé
• Ensemble : fauteuil lounge avec pouf rond assorti
• Designer : JF Rolet, Paris (modèle LN6789)
• Dimensions fauteuil (L × P × H) : 114 × 104 × 135 cm
• Structure : cadre interne en acier et mousse haute densité
• Base : piètement métal 5 branches pivotant à 360°
• Audio : enceintes HiFi Bluetooth intégrées (volume, basses, aigus, USB)
• Revêtement : mesh 3D texturé 77912 (100 % polyester) – Beige (08)

variants.extended_description_es:
Tu música. Tu momento. Tu Moonchair.

Moonchair invita a desconectar y disfrutar sin prisas. Apoya los pies en la otomana a juego, pon tu álbum favorito y descubre un icono de diseño con sonido HiFi Bluetooth integrado.

Diseño parisino de JF Rolet
Su carcasa esférica formada por anillos tapizados envuelve un grueso asiento circular y un respaldo ergonómico. Su estructura interna de acero aporta solidez y el acolchado de espuma garantiza máxima comodidad.

Sonido HiFi Bluetooth integrado
El sistema de altavoces HiFi se integra dentro de la propia carcasa. Empareja tu dispositivo mediante Bluetooth y ajusta por separado volumen, graves y agudos desde el panel integrado con interruptor y puerto USB.

Giro de 360° y malla 3D texturizada
Su base metálica de cinco puntas gira 360° con suavidad. El tejido 77912 en malla 3D (100 % poliéster, 530 g/m²) realza las curvas del diseño. Acabado: Beige (código 08).

De un vistazo
• Conjunto: sillón lounge con otomana redonda a juego
• Diseñador: JF Rolet, París (modelo LN6789)
• Dimensiones del sillón (An × Pr × Al): 114 × 104 × 135 cm
• Estructura: bastidor interno de acero con acolchado de espuma
• Base: pie metálico de 5 radios con giro de 360°
• Audio: altavoces HiFi Bluetooth integrados (volumen, graves, agudos, USB)
• Tapizado: malla 3D texturizada 77912 (100 % poliéster) – Beige (08)

Por favor, confirme su muestra de tejido antes de pedir. Las fotografías muestran acabados de referencia.
variants.extended_description_it:
La tua musica. Il tuo momento. La tua Moonchair.

Moonchair invita a rallentare e godersi il momento. Appoggia i piedi sul pouf coordinato, avvia la tua playlist preferita e lasciati avvolgere dal design scultoreo con audio HiFi Bluetooth integrato.

Creata a Parigi dal designer JF Rolet

Audio HiFi Bluetooth integrato nella scocca
Abbina il tuo dispositivo con il tasto Bluetooth e personalizza il suono grazie ai controlli separati di volume, bassi e alti, completi di accensione e porta USB a portata di mano.

Rotazione a 360° e rivestimento 3D mesh
La base metallica a cinque razze ruota liberamente a 360°. Il tessuto 3D mesh 77912 (100% poliestere, 530 g/m²) valorizza ogni curva. Versione: Beige (codice 08).

In sintesi
• Set: poltrona lounge con pouf rotondo coordinato
• Designer: JF Rolet, Parigi (modello LN6789)
• Dimensioni poltrona (L × P × A): 114 × 104 × 135 cm
• Struttura: telaio interno in acciaio con imbottitura in schiuma
• Base: base metallica a 5 razze girevole a 360°
• Audio: sistema HiFi Bluetooth integrato (volume, bassi, alti, USB)
• Rivestimento: rete 3D testurizzata 77912 (100% poliestere) – Beige (08)

Conferma il campione di tessuto scelto prima di ordinare. Le fotografie mostrano finiture di riferimento.

variants.extended_description_en:
Your music. Your moment. Your Moonchair.

Moonchair invites you to slow down and stay a little longer. Put your feet up on the matching ottoman, play a favourite album and let an ordinary evening become a moment to look forward to. With its enveloping round silhouette, generous cushioning and built-in Bluetooth HiFi audio, Moonchair brings comfort, music and sculptural design together in one distinctive lounge set.

A shape that draws you in
Created by Paris-based French designer JF Rolet, Moonchair opens towards you in layers of upholstered rings. The rounded shell frames a thick circular seat cushion and a contoured backrest, creating an inviting place to curl up with a book, enjoy a playlist or simply pause. An internal steel frame gives structure to the expressive form, while foam cushioning softens the seat and back.

Put your feet up and settle in
The matching round ottoman completes the experience, giving you somewhere to rest your feet as you unwind. Its upholstered top and ribbed base echo the chair's rounded design, so the two pieces feel like a considered pair. Together, they create a ready-made retreat in a living room, bedroom corner or dedicated listening space.

Your soundtrack, built into your seat
The Bluetooth-connected HiFi speaker system is integrated into the chair's shell, bringing your music into the design itself. Pair your device using the built-in Bluetooth button, then tailor your listening with separate volume, bass and treble controls. The control panel also includes a power control and a USB port, keeping the audio controls close at hand.

Turn towards whatever matters
A full 360° swivel on a five-star metal base lets the chair move with the moment. Turn towards a conversation, face the room or enjoy a different view without shifting the whole chair. The open, rounded form makes Moonchair a striking focal point from different angles.

Texture that brings the curves to life
The 3D mesh upholstery adds a tactile, dimensional finish to the layered silhouette. Fabric 77912 is made from 100% polyester, with a fabric weight of 530 g/m². This version is Grey, colour code 09: a distinctive finishing touch for your own corner of the room.

At a glance
• Set: lounge chair with matching round ottoman
• Designer: JF Rolet, Paris
• Manufacturer model: LN6789
• Chair dimensions: 114 × 104 × 135 cm (width × depth × height)
• Structure: internal steel frame with foam cushioning
• Base: five-star metal base with 360° swivel
• Audio: built-in Bluetooth HiFi speaker system
• Controls: power, Bluetooth pairing, volume, bass and treble
• Connection: USB port
• Upholstery: textured 3D mesh, 100% polyester
• Fabric: 77912 / Grey / colour code 09

Make room for your next favourite moment. Moonchair gives your music, your reading time and your evening wind-down a place of their own.

Please confirm your chosen fabric swatch before ordering. Product photographs show reference finishes and may differ from the selected colour.

variants.extended_description_en:
Your music. Your moment. Your Moonchair.

Moonchair invites you to slow down and stay a little longer. Put your feet up on the matching ottoman, play a favourite album and let an ordinary evening become a moment to look forward to. With its enveloping round silhouette, generous cushioning and built-in Bluetooth HiFi audio, Moonchair brings comfort, music and sculptural design together in one distinctive lounge set.

A shape that draws you in
Created by Paris-based French designer JF Rolet, Moonchair opens towards you in layers of upholstered rings. The rounded shell frames a thick circular seat cushion and a contoured backrest, creating an inviting place to curl up with a book, enjoy a playlist or simply pause. An internal steel frame gives structure to the expressive form, while foam cushioning softens the seat and back.

Put your feet up and settle in
The matching round ottoman completes the experience, giving you somewhere to rest your feet as you unwind. Its upholstered top and ribbed base echo the chair's rounded design, so the two pieces feel like a considered pair. Together, they create a ready-made retreat in a living room, bedroom corner or dedicated listening space.

Your soundtrack, built into your seat
The Bluetooth-connected HiFi speaker system is integrated into the chair's shell, bringing your music into the design itself. Pair your device using the built-in Bluetooth button, then tailor your listening with separate volume, bass and treble controls. The control panel also includes a power control and a USB port, keeping the audio controls close at hand.

Turn towards whatever matters
A full 360° swivel on a five-star metal base lets the chair move with the moment. Turn towards a conversation, face the room or enjoy a different view without shifting the whole chair. The open, rounded form makes Moonchair a striking focal point from different angles.

Texture that brings the curves to life
The 3D mesh upholstery adds a tactile, dimensional finish to the layered silhouette. Fabric 77912 is made from 100% polyester, with a fabric weight of 530 g/m². This version is Taupe, colour code 02: a distinctive finishing touch for your own corner of the room.

At a glance
• Set: lounge chair with matching round ottoman
• Designer: JF Rolet, Paris
• Manufacturer model: LN6789
• Chair dimensions: 114 × 104 × 135 cm (width × depth × height)
• Structure: internal steel frame with foam cushioning
• Base: five-star metal base with 360° swivel
• Audio: built-in Bluetooth HiFi speaker system
• Controls: power, Bluetooth pairing, volume, bass and treble
• Connection: USB port
• Upholstery: textured 3D mesh, 100% polyester
• Fabric: 77912 / Taupe / colour code 02

Make room for your next favourite moment. Moonchair gives your music, your reading time and your evening wind-down a place of their own.

Please confirm your chosen fabric swatch before ordering. Product photographs show reference finishes and may differ from the selected colour.

variants.extended_description_fr:
Votre musique. Votre moment. Votre Moonchair.

Moonchair vous invite à ralentir et savourer l'instant. Posez vos pieds sur le pouf assorti, lancez votre album préféré et profitez d'un design sculptural intégrant un système audio HiFi Bluetooth.

Une forme signée JF Rolet, Paris
Sa coque arrondie composée d'anneaux rembourrés encadre un coussin d'assise circulaire généreux et un dossier enveloppant. Une structure interne en acier garantit la tenue, tandis que le garnissage mousse offre un confort durable.

Votre bande-son intégrée au fauteuil
Le système HiFi Bluetooth est intégré directement dans la coque. Appairez votre appareil en un geste et réglez séparément le volume, les basses et les aigus depuis le panneau de commande équipé d'un bouton marche/arrêt et d'un port USB.

Rotation 360° et tissu mesh 3D texturé
Monté sur un piètement métallique cinq branches pivotant à 360°, Moonchair s'adapte à chaque moment. Le tissu 77912 en mesh 3D (100 % polyester, 530 g/m²) sublime chaque courbe. Finition : Taupe (code 02).

En résumé
• Ensemble : fauteuil lounge avec pouf rond assorti
• Designer : JF Rolet, Paris (modèle LN6789)
• Dimensions fauteuil (L × P × H) : 114 × 104 × 135 cm
• Structure : cadre interne en acier et mousse haute densité
• Base : piètement métal 5 branches pivotant à 360°
• Audio : enceintes HiFi Bluetooth intégrées (volume, basses, aigus, USB)

Moonchair invita a desconectar y disfrutar sin prisas. Apoya los pies en la otomana a juego, pon tu álbum favorito y descubre un icono de diseño con sonido HiFi Bluetooth integrado.

Diseño parisino de JF Rolet
Su carcasa esférica formada por anillos tapizados envuelve un grueso asiento circular y un respaldo ergonómico. Su estructura interna de acero aporta solidez y el acolchado de espuma garantiza máxima comodidad.

Sonido HiFi Bluetooth integrado
El sistema de altavoces HiFi se integra dentro de la propia carcasa. Empareja tu dispositivo mediante Bluetooth y ajusta por separado volumen, graves y agudos desde el panel integrado con interruptor y puerto USB.

Giro de 360° y malla 3D texturizada
Su base metálica de cinco puntas gira 360° con suavidad. El tejido 77912 en malla 3D (100 % poliéster, 530 g/m²) realza las curvas del diseño. Acabado: Topo (código 02).

De un vistazo
• Conjunto: sillón lounge con otomana redonda a juego
• Diseñador: JF Rolet, París (modelo LN6789)
• Dimensiones del sillón (An × Pr × Al): 114 × 104 × 135 cm
• Estructura: bastidor interno de acero con acolchado de espuma
• Base: pie metálico de 5 radios con giro de 360°
• Audio: altavoces HiFi Bluetooth integrados (volumen, graves, agudos, USB)
• Tapizado: malla 3D texturizada 77912 (100 % poliéster) – Topo (02)

Rotazione a 360° e rivestimento 3D mesh

variants.extended_description_en:
Your music. Your moment. Your Moonchair.

Moonchair invites you to slow down and stay a little longer. Put your feet up on the matching ottoman, play a favourite album and let an ordinary evening become a moment to look forward to. With its enveloping round silhouette, generous cushioning and built-in Bluetooth HiFi audio, Moonchair brings comfort, music and sculptural design together in one distinctive lounge set.

A shape that draws you in
Created by Paris-based French designer JF Rolet, Moonchair opens towards you in layers of upholstered rings. The rounded shell frames a thick circular seat cushion and a contoured backrest, creating an inviting place to curl up with a book, enjoy a playlist or simply pause. An internal steel frame gives structure to the expressive form, while foam cushioning softens the seat and back.

Put your feet up and settle in
The matching round ottoman completes the experience, giving you somewhere to rest your feet as you unwind. Its upholstered top and ribbed base echo the chair's rounded design, so the two pieces feel like a considered pair. Together, they create a ready-made retreat in a living room, bedroom corner or dedicated listening space.

Your soundtrack, built into your seat
The Bluetooth-connected HiFi speaker system is integrated into the chair's shell, bringing your music into the design itself. Pair your device using the built-in Bluetooth button, then tailor your listening with separate volume, bass and treble controls. The control panel also includes a power control and a USB port, keeping the audio controls close at hand.

Turn towards whatever matters
A full 360° swivel on a five-star metal base lets the chair move with the moment. Turn towards a conversation, face the room or enjoy a different view without shifting the whole chair. The open, rounded form makes Moonchair a striking focal point from different angles.

Texture that brings the curves to life
The 3D mesh upholstery adds a tactile, dimensional finish to the layered silhouette. Fabric 77912 is made from 100% polyester, with a fabric weight of 530 g/m². This version is Mustard, colour code 11: a distinctive finishing touch for your own corner of the room.

At a glance
• Set: lounge chair with matching round ottoman
• Designer: JF Rolet, Paris
• Manufacturer model: LN6789
• Chair dimensions: 114 × 104 × 135 cm (width × depth × height)
• Structure: internal steel frame with foam cushioning
• Base: five-star metal base with 360° swivel
• Audio: built-in Bluetooth HiFi speaker system
• Controls: power, Bluetooth pairing, volume, bass and treble
• Connection: USB port
• Upholstery: textured 3D mesh, 100% polyester
• Fabric: 77912 / Mustard / colour code 11

Make room for your next favourite moment. Moonchair gives your music, your reading time and your evening wind-down a place of their own.

variants.extended_description_de:
Ihre Musik. Ihr Moment. Ihr Moonchair.

Moonchair lädt zum Entschleunigen ein. Legen Sie die Füße auf dem passenden runden Hocker hoch, starten Sie Ihre Lieblingsplaylist und genießen Sie skulpturales Design mit integriertem Bluetooth-HiFi-Klang.

Entworfen in Paris von JF Rolet
Die markante, aus gepolsterten Ringen geformte Schale umschließt ein dickes Sitzkissen und eine ergonomische Rückenlehne. Ein innenliegender Stahlrahmen sorgt für Stabilität, während weicher Schaumstoff hohen Sitzkomfort bietet.

Integriertes Bluetooth-HiFi-Soundsystem
Die Lautsprecher sind direkt in die Schale integriert. Koppeln Sie Ihr Gerät per Bluetooth-Taste und passen Sie Lautstärke, Bass und Höhen separat am Bedienfeld an – inklusive Ein-/Ausschalter und USB-Anschluss.

360° drehbar & strukturierter 3D-Mesh-Bezug
Auf dem fünfstrahligen Metallfuß dreht sich der Moonchair mühelos um 360°. Der 3D-Mesh-Stoff 77912 (100 % Polyester, 530 g/m²) verleiht den Rundungen eine markante Tiefe. Ausführung: Senfgelb (Farbcode 11).

Auf einen Blick
• Set: Lounge-Sessel inkl. passendem runden Hocker
• Designer: JF Rolet, Paris (Modell LN6789)
• Maße Sessel (B × T × H): 114 × 104 × 135 cm
• Gestell: Innenliegender Stahlrahmen mit Schaumpolsterung
• Fuß: Fünfstrahliger Metallfuß, 360° drehbar
• Audio: Integriertes Bluetooth-HiFi-System (Lautstärke, Bass, Höhen, USB)
• Bezug: Strukturierter 3D-Mesh-Stoff 77912 (100 % Polyester) – Senfgelb (11)

variants.extended_description_fr:
Votre musique. Votre moment. Votre Moonchair.

Moonchair vous invite à ralentir et savourer l'instant. Posez vos pieds sur le pouf assorti, lancez votre album préféré et profitez d'un design sculptural intégrant un système audio HiFi Bluetooth.

Une forme signée JF Rolet, Paris
Sa coque arrondie composée d'anneaux rembourrés encadre un coussin d'assise circulaire généreux et un dossier enveloppant. Une structure interne en acier garantit la tenue, tandis que le garnissage mousse offre un confort durable.

Votre bande-son intégrée au fauteuil
Le système HiFi Bluetooth est intégré directement dans la coque. Appairez votre appareil en un geste et réglez séparément le volume, les basses et les aigus depuis le panneau de commande équipé d'un bouton marche/arrêt et d'un port USB.

Rotation 360° et tissu mesh 3D texturé
Monté sur un piètement métallique cinq branches pivotant à 360°, Moonchair s'adapte à chaque moment. Le tissu 77912 en mesh 3D (100 % polyester, 530 g/m²) sublime chaque courbe. Finition : Moutarde (code 11).

En résumé
• Ensemble : fauteuil lounge avec pouf rond assorti
• Designer : JF Rolet, Paris (modèle LN6789)
• Dimensions fauteuil (L × P × H) : 114 × 104 × 135 cm
• Structure : cadre interne en acier et mousse haute densité
• Base : piètement métal 5 branches pivotant à 360°
• Audio : enceintes HiFi Bluetooth intégrées (volume, basses, aigus, USB)
• Revêtement : mesh 3D texturé 77912 (100 % polyester) – Moutarde (11)

variants.extended_description_es:
Tu música. Tu momento. Tu Moonchair.

Moonchair invita a desconectar y disfrutar sin prisas. Apoya los pies en la otomana a juego, pon tu álbum favorito y descubre un icono de diseño con sonido HiFi Bluetooth integrado.

Diseño parisino de JF Rolet
Su carcasa esférica formada por anillos tapizados envuelve un grueso asiento circular y un respaldo ergonómico. Su estructura interna de acero aporta solidez y el acolchado de espuma garantiza máxima comodidad.

Sonido HiFi Bluetooth integrado
El sistema de altavoces HiFi se integra dentro de la propia carcasa. Empareja tu dispositivo mediante Bluetooth y ajusta por separado volumen, graves y agudos desde el panel integrado con interruptor y puerto USB.

Giro de 360° y malla 3D texturizada
Su base metálica de cinco puntas gira 360° con suavidad. El tejido 77912 en malla 3D (100 % poliéster, 530 g/m²) realza las curvas del diseño. Acabado: Mostaza (código 11).

De un vistazo
• Conjunto: sillón lounge con otomana redonda a juego
• Diseñador: JF Rolet, París (modelo LN6789)
• Dimensiones del sillón (An × Pr × Al): 114 × 104 × 135 cm
• Estructura: bastidor interno de acero con acolchado de espuma
• Base: pie metálico de 5 radios con giro de 360°
• Audio: altavoces HiFi Bluetooth integrados (volumen, graves, agudos, USB)
• Tapizado: malla 3D texturizada 77912 (100 % poliéster) – Mostaza (11)

Por favor, confirme su muestra de tejido antes de pedir. Las fotografías muestran acabados de referencia.
variants.extended_description_it:
La tua musica. Il tuo momento. La tua Moonchair.

Moonchair invita a rallentare e godersi il momento. Appoggia i piedi sul pouf coordinato, avvia la tua playlist preferita e lasciati avvolgere dal design scultoreo con audio HiFi Bluetooth integrato.

Creata a Parigi dal designer JF Rolet
La scocca tondeggiante a fasce imbottite racchiude un generoso cuscino circolare e uno schienale ergonomico. Il telaio interno in acciaio dona solidità, mentre l'imbottitura in schiuma assicura comfort avvolgente.

Audio HiFi Bluetooth integrato nella scocca
Abbina il tuo dispositivo con il tasto Bluetooth e personalizza il suono grazie ai controlli separati di volume, bassi e alti, completi di accensione e porta USB a portata di mano.

Rotazione a 360° e rivestimento 3D mesh
La base metallica a cinque razze ruota liberamente a 360°. Il tessuto 3D mesh 77912 (100% poliestere, 530 g/m²) valorizza ogni curva. Versione: Senape (codice 11).

In sintesi
• Set: poltrona lounge con pouf rotondo coordinato
• Designer: JF Rolet, Parigi (modello LN6789)
• Dimensioni poltrona (L × P × A): 114 × 104 × 135 cm
• Struttura: telaio interno in acciaio con imbottitura in schiuma
• Base: base metallica a 5 razze girevole a 360°
• Audio: sistema HiFi Bluetooth integrato (volume, bassi, alti, USB)
• Rivestimento: rete 3D testurizzata 77912 (100% poliestere) – Senape (11)

Conferma il campione di tessuto scelto prima di ordinare. Le fotografie mostrano finiture di riferimento.

Emparelhe o seu dispositivo através do botão Bluetooth e ajuste separadamente volume, graves e agudos no painel lateral com interruptor e porta USB.

A base metálica de cinco pontas gira suavemente 360°. O tecido 3D mesh 77912 (100% poliéster, 530 g/m²) dá profundidade a cada curva. Acabamento: Mostarda (código 11).

Em resumo

• Designer: JF Rolet, Paris (modelo LN6789)
• Dimensões da poltrona (L × P × A): 114 × 104 × 135 cm
• Estrutura: armação interna em aço com acolchoamento em espuma
• Base: base metálica de 5 braços com rotação de 360°
• Áudio: sistema HiFi Bluetooth integrado (volume, graves, agudos, USB)

Rotation 360° et tissu mesh 3D texturé
Monté sur un piètement métallique cinq branches pivotant à 360°, Moonchair s'adapte à chaque moment. Le tissu 77912 en mesh 3D (100 % polyester, 530 g/m²) sublime chaque courbe. Finition : Vert citron (code 10).

• Dimensions fauteuil (L × P × H) : 114 × 104 × 135 cm
• Structure : cadre interne en acier et mousse haute densité
• Base : piètement métal 5 branches pivotant à 360°

variants.extended_description_es:
Tu música. Tu momento. Tu Moonchair.

Moonchair invita a desconectar y disfrutar sin prisas. Apoya los pies en la otomana a juego, pon tu álbum favorito y descubre un icono de diseño con sonido HiFi Bluetooth integrado.

Diseño parisino de JF Rolet
Su carcasa esférica formada por anillos tapizados envuelve un grueso asiento circular y un respaldo ergonómico. Su estructura interna de acero aporta solidez y el acolchado de espuma garantiza máxima comodidad.

Sonido HiFi Bluetooth integrado
El sistema de altavoces HiFi se integra dentro de la propia carcasa. Empareja tu dispositivo mediante Bluetooth y ajusta por separado volumen, graves y agudos desde el panel integrado con interruptor y puerto USB.

Giro de 360° y malla 3D texturizada
Su base metálica de cinco puntas gira 360° con suavidad. El tejido 77912 en malla 3D (100 % poliéster, 530 g/m²) realza las curvas del diseño. Acabado: Verde lima (código 10).

De un vistazo
• Conjunto: sillón lounge con otomana redonda a juego
• Diseñador: JF Rolet, París (modelo LN6789)
• Dimensiones del sillón (An × Pr × Al): 114 × 104 × 135 cm
• Estructura: bastidor interno de acero con acolchado de espuma
• Base: pie metálico de 5 radios con giro de 360°

variants.extended_description_en:
Your music. Your moment. Your Moonchair.

Moonchair invites you to slow down and stay a little longer. Put your feet up on the matching ottoman, play a favourite album and let an ordinary evening become a moment to look forward to. With its enveloping round silhouette, generous cushioning and built-in Bluetooth HiFi audio, Moonchair brings comfort, music and sculptural design together in one distinctive lounge set.

A shape that draws you in
Created by Paris-based French designer JF Rolet, Moonchair opens towards you in layers of upholstered rings. The rounded shell frames a thick circular seat cushion and a contoured backrest, creating an inviting place to curl up with a book, enjoy a playlist or simply pause. An internal steel frame gives structure to the expressive form, while foam cushioning softens the seat and back.

Put your feet up and settle in
The matching round ottoman completes the experience, giving you somewhere to rest your feet as you unwind. Its upholstered top and ribbed base echo the chair's rounded design, so the two pieces feel like a considered pair. Together, they create a ready-made retreat in a living room, bedroom corner or dedicated listening space.

Your soundtrack, built into your seat
The Bluetooth-connected HiFi speaker system is integrated into the chair's shell, bringing your music into the design itself. Pair your device using the built-in Bluetooth button, then tailor your listening with separate volume, bass and treble controls. The control panel also includes a power control and a USB port, keeping the audio controls close at hand.

Turn towards whatever matters
A full 360° swivel on a five-star metal base lets the chair move with the moment. Turn towards a conversation, face the room or enjoy a different view without shifting the whole chair. The open, rounded form makes Moonchair a striking focal point from different angles.

Texture that brings the curves to life
The 3D mesh upholstery adds a tactile, dimensional finish to the layered silhouette. Fabric 77912 is made from 100% polyester, with a fabric weight of 530 g/m². This version is Petrol Blue, colour code 01: a distinctive finishing touch for your own corner of the room.

At a glance
• Set: lounge chair with matching round ottoman
• Designer: JF Rolet, Paris
• Manufacturer model: LN6789
• Chair dimensions: 114 × 104 × 135 cm (width × depth × height)
• Structure: internal steel frame with foam cushioning
• Base: five-star metal base with 360° swivel
• Audio: built-in Bluetooth HiFi speaker system
• Controls: power, Bluetooth pairing, volume, bass and treble
• Connection: USB port
• Upholstery: textured 3D mesh, 100% polyester
• Fabric: 77912 / Petrol Blue / colour code 01

Make room for your next favourite moment. Moonchair gives your music, your reading time and your evening wind-down a place of their own.

Please confirm your chosen fabric swatch before ordering. Product photographs show reference finishes and may differ from the selected colour.

Ihre Musik. Ihr Moment. Ihr Moonchair.

Moonchair lädt zum Entschleunigen ein. Legen Sie die Füße auf dem passenden runden Hocker hoch, starten Sie Ihre Lieblingsplaylist und genießen Sie skulpturales Design mit integriertem Bluetooth-HiFi-Klang.

Entworfen in Paris von JF Rolet
Die markante, aus gepolsterten Ringen geformte Schale umschließt ein dickes Sitzkissen und eine ergonomische Rückenlehne. Ein innenliegender Stahlrahmen sorgt für Stabilität, während weicher Schaumstoff hohen Sitzkomfort bietet.

Integriertes Bluetooth-HiFi-Soundsystem
Die Lautsprecher sind direkt in die Schale integriert. Koppeln Sie Ihr Gerät per Bluetooth-Taste und passen Sie Lautstärke, Bass und Höhen separat am Bedienfeld an – inklusive Ein-/Ausschalter und USB-Anschluss.

360° drehbar & strukturierter 3D-Mesh-Bezug
Auf dem fünfstrahligen Metallfuß dreht sich der Moonchair mühelos um 360°. Der 3D-Mesh-Stoff 77912 (100 % Polyester, 530 g/m²) verleiht den Rundungen eine markante Tiefe. Ausführung: Petrolblau (Farbcode 01).

Auf einen Blick
• Set: Lounge-Sessel inkl. passendem runden Hocker
• Designer: JF Rolet, Paris (Modell LN6789)
• Maße Sessel (B × T × H): 114 × 104 × 135 cm
• Gestell: Innenliegender Stahlrahmen mit Schaumpolsterung
• Fuß: Fünfstrahliger Metallfuß, 360° drehbar
• Audio: Integriertes Bluetooth-HiFi-System (Lautstärke, Bass, Höhen, USB)
• Bezug: Strukturierter 3D-Mesh-Stoff 77912 (100 % Polyester) – Petrolblau (01)

variants.extended_description_en:
Your music. Your moment. Your Moonchair.

Moonchair invites you to slow down and stay a little longer. Put your feet up on the matching ottoman, play a favourite album and let an ordinary evening become a moment to look forward to. With its enveloping round silhouette, generous cushioning and built-in Bluetooth HiFi audio, Moonchair brings comfort, music and sculptural design together in one distinctive lounge set.

A shape that draws you in
Created by Paris-based French designer JF Rolet, Moonchair opens towards you in layers of upholstered rings. The rounded shell frames a thick circular seat cushion and a contoured backrest, creating an inviting place to curl up with a book, enjoy a playlist or simply pause. An internal steel frame gives structure to the expressive form, while foam cushioning softens the seat and back.

Put your feet up and settle in
The matching round ottoman completes the experience, giving you somewhere to rest your feet as you unwind. Its upholstered top and ribbed base echo the chair's rounded design, so the two pieces feel like a considered pair. Together, they create a ready-made retreat in a living room, bedroom corner or dedicated listening space.

Your soundtrack, built into your seat
The Bluetooth-connected HiFi speaker system is integrated into the chair's shell, bringing your music into the design itself. Pair your device using the built-in Bluetooth button, then tailor your listening with separate volume, bass and treble controls. The control panel also includes a power control and a USB port, keeping the audio controls close at hand.

Turn towards whatever matters
A full 360° swivel on a five-star metal base lets the chair move with the moment. Turn towards a conversation, face the room or enjoy a different view without shifting the whole chair. The open, rounded form makes Moonchair a striking focal point from different angles.

Texture that brings the curves to life
The 3D mesh upholstery adds a tactile, dimensional finish to the layered silhouette. Fabric 77912 is made from 100% polyester, with a fabric weight of 530 g/m². This version is Turquoise, colour code 04: a distinctive finishing touch for your own corner of the room.

At a glance
• Set: lounge chair with matching round ottoman
• Designer: JF Rolet, Paris
• Manufacturer model: LN6789
• Chair dimensions: 114 × 104 × 135 cm (width × depth × height)
• Structure: internal steel frame with foam cushioning
• Base: five-star metal base with 360° swivel
• Audio: built-in Bluetooth HiFi speaker system
• Controls: power, Bluetooth pairing, volume, bass and treble
• Connection: USB port
• Upholstery: textured 3D mesh, 100% polyester
• Fabric: 77912 / Turquoise / colour code 04

Make room for your next favourite moment. Moonchair gives your music, your reading time and your evening wind-down a place of their own.

Please confirm your chosen fabric swatch before ordering. Product photographs show reference finishes and may differ from the selected colour.

Entworfen in Paris von JF Rolet
Die markante, aus gepolsterten Ringen geformte Schale umschließt ein dickes Sitzkissen und eine ergonomische Rückenlehne. Ein innenliegender Stahlrahmen sorgt für Stabilität, während weicher Schaumstoff hohen Sitzkomfort bietet.

360° drehbar & strukturierter 3D-Mesh-Bezug
Auf dem fünfstrahligen Metallfuß dreht sich der Moonchair mühelos um 360°. Der 3D-Mesh-Stoff 77912 (100 % Polyester, 530 g/m²) verleiht den Rundungen eine markante Tiefe. Ausführung: Türkis (Farbcode 04).

variants.extended_description_fr:
Votre musique. Votre moment. Votre Moonchair.

Moonchair vous invite à ralentir et savourer l'instant. Posez vos pieds sur le pouf assorti, lancez votre album préféré et profitez d'un design sculptural intégrant un système audio HiFi Bluetooth.

Une forme signée JF Rolet, Paris
Sa coque arrondie composée d'anneaux rembourrés encadre un coussin d'assise circulaire généreux et un dossier enveloppant. Une structure interne en acier garantit la tenue, tandis que le garnissage mousse offre un confort durable.

Votre bande-son intégrée au fauteuil
Le système HiFi Bluetooth est intégré directement dans la coque. Appairez votre appareil en un geste et réglez séparément le volume, les basses et les aigus depuis le panneau de commande équipé d'un bouton marche/arrêt et d'un port USB.

Rotation 360° et tissu mesh 3D texturé
Monté sur un piètement métallique cinq branches pivotant à 360°, Moonchair s'adapte à chaque moment. Le tissu 77912 en mesh 3D (100 % polyester, 530 g/m²) sublime chaque courbe. Finition : Turquoise (code 04).

En résumé
• Ensemble : fauteuil lounge avec pouf rond assorti
• Designer : JF Rolet, Paris (modèle LN6789)
• Dimensions fauteuil (L × P × H) : 114 × 104 × 135 cm
• Structure : cadre interne en acier et mousse haute densité
• Base : piètement métal 5 branches pivotant à 360°
• Audio : enceintes HiFi Bluetooth intégrées (volume, basses, aigus, USB)
• Revêtement : mesh 3D texturé 77912 (100 % polyester) – Turquoise (04)

variants.extended_description_es:
Tu música. Tu momento. Tu Moonchair.

Moonchair invita a desconectar y disfrutar sin prisas. Apoya los pies en la otomana a juego, pon tu álbum favorito y descubre un icono de diseño con sonido HiFi Bluetooth integrado.

Diseño parisino de JF Rolet
Su carcasa esférica formada por anillos tapizados envuelve un grueso asiento circular y un respaldo ergonómico. Su estructura interna de acero aporta solidez y el acolchado de espuma garantiza máxima comodidad.

Sonido HiFi Bluetooth integrado
El sistema de altavoces HiFi se integra dentro de la propia carcasa. Empareja tu dispositivo mediante Bluetooth y ajusta por separado volumen, graves y agudos desde el panel integrado con interruptor y puerto USB.

Giro de 360° y malla 3D texturizada
Su base metálica de cinco puntas gira 360° con suavidad. El tejido 77912 en malla 3D (100 % poliéster, 530 g/m²) realza las curvas del diseño. Acabado: Turquesa (código 04).

De un vistazo
• Conjunto: sillón lounge con otomana redonda a juego
• Diseñador: JF Rolet, París (modelo LN6789)
• Dimensiones del sillón (An × Pr × Al): 114 × 104 × 135 cm
• Estructura: bastidor interno de acero con acolchado de espuma
• Base: pie metálico de 5 radios con giro de 360°
• Audio: altavoces HiFi Bluetooth integrados (volumen, graves, agudos, USB)
• Tapizado: malla 3D texturizada 77912 (100 % poliéster) – Turquesa (04)

variants.extended_description_en:
Your music. Your moment. Your Moonchair.

Moonchair invites you to slow down and stay a little longer. Put your feet up on the matching ottoman, play a favourite album and let an ordinary evening become a moment to look forward to. With its enveloping round silhouette, generous cushioning and built-in Bluetooth HiFi audio, Moonchair brings comfort, music and sculptural design together in one distinctive lounge set.

A shape that draws you in
Created by Paris-based French designer JF Rolet, Moonchair opens towards you in layers of upholstered rings. The rounded shell frames a thick circular seat cushion and a contoured backrest, creating an inviting place to curl up with a book, enjoy a playlist or simply pause. An internal steel frame gives structure to the expressive form, while foam cushioning softens the seat and back.

Put your feet up and settle in
The matching round ottoman completes the experience, giving you somewhere to rest your feet as you unwind. Its upholstered top and ribbed base echo the chair's rounded design, so the two pieces feel like a considered pair. Together, they create a ready-made retreat in a living room, bedroom corner or dedicated listening space.

Your soundtrack, built into your seat
The Bluetooth-connected HiFi speaker system is integrated into the chair's shell, bringing your music into the design itself. Pair your device using the built-in Bluetooth button, then tailor your listening with separate volume, bass and treble controls. The control panel also includes a power control and a USB port, keeping the audio controls close at hand.

Turn towards whatever matters
A full 360° swivel on a five-star metal base lets the chair move with the moment. Turn towards a conversation, face the room or enjoy a different view without shifting the whole chair. The open, rounded form makes Moonchair a striking focal point from different angles.

Texture that brings the curves to life
The 3D mesh upholstery adds a tactile, dimensional finish to the layered silhouette. Fabric 77912 is made from 100% polyester, with a fabric weight of 530 g/m². This version is Charcoal, colour code 13: a distinctive finishing touch for your own corner of the room.

At a glance
• Set: lounge chair with matching round ottoman
• Designer: JF Rolet, Paris
• Manufacturer model: LN6789
• Chair dimensions: 114 × 104 × 135 cm (width × depth × height)
• Structure: internal steel frame with foam cushioning
• Base: five-star metal base with 360° swivel
• Audio: built-in Bluetooth HiFi speaker system
• Controls: power, Bluetooth pairing, volume, bass and treble
• Connection: USB port
• Upholstery: textured 3D mesh, 100% polyester
• Fabric: 77912 / Charcoal / colour code 13

Make room for your next favourite moment. Moonchair gives your music, your reading time and your evening wind-down a place of their own.

variants.extended_description_de:
Ihre Musik. Ihr Moment. Ihr Moonchair.

Moonchair lädt zum Entschleunigen ein. Legen Sie die Füße auf dem passenden runden Hocker hoch, starten Sie Ihre Lieblingsplaylist und genießen Sie skulpturales Design mit integriertem Bluetooth-HiFi-Klang.

Entworfen in Paris von JF Rolet
Die markante, aus gepolsterten Ringen geformte Schale umschließt ein dickes Sitzkissen und eine ergonomische Rückenlehne. Ein innenliegender Stahlrahmen sorgt für Stabilität, während weicher Schaumstoff hohen Sitzkomfort bietet.

Integriertes Bluetooth-HiFi-Soundsystem
Die Lautsprecher sind direkt in die Schale integriert. Koppeln Sie Ihr Gerät per Bluetooth-Taste und passen Sie Lautstärke, Bass und Höhen separat am Bedienfeld an – inklusive Ein-/Ausschalter und USB-Anschluss.

360° drehbar & strukturierter 3D-Mesh-Bezug
Auf dem fünfstrahligen Metallfuß dreht sich der Moonchair mühelos um 360°. Der 3D-Mesh-Stoff 77912 (100 % Polyester, 530 g/m²) verleiht den Rundungen eine markante Tiefe. Ausführung: Anthrazit (Farbcode 13).

Auf einen Blick
• Set: Lounge-Sessel inkl. passendem runden Hocker
• Designer: JF Rolet, Paris (Modell LN6789)
• Maße Sessel (B × T × H): 114 × 104 × 135 cm
• Gestell: Innenliegender Stahlrahmen mit Schaumpolsterung
• Fuß: Fünfstrahliger Metallfuß, 360° drehbar
• Audio: Integriertes Bluetooth-HiFi-System (Lautstärke, Bass, Höhen, USB)
• Bezug: Strukturierter 3D-Mesh-Stoff 77912 (100 % Polyester) – Anthrazit (13)

Bitte bestätigen Sie Ihr gewähltes Stoffmuster vor der Bestellung. Produktfotos zeigen Referenzfarben.
variants.extended_description_fr:
Votre musique. Votre moment. Votre Moonchair.

Moonchair vous invite à ralentir et savourer l'instant. Posez vos pieds sur le pouf assorti, lancez votre album préféré et profitez d'un design sculptural intégrant un système audio HiFi Bluetooth.

Une forme signée JF Rolet, Paris
Sa coque arrondie composée d'anneaux rembourrés encadre un coussin d'assise circulaire généreux et un dossier enveloppant. Une structure interne en acier garantit la tenue, tandis que le garnissage mousse offre un confort durable.

Votre bande-son intégrée au fauteuil
Le système HiFi Bluetooth est intégré directement dans la coque. Appairez votre appareil en un geste et réglez séparément le volume, les basses et les aigus depuis le panneau de commande équipé d'un bouton marche/arrêt et d'un port USB.

Rotation 360° et tissu mesh 3D texturé
Monté sur un piètement métallique cinq branches pivotant à 360°, Moonchair s'adapte à chaque moment. Le tissu 77912 en mesh 3D (100 % polyester, 530 g/m²) sublime chaque courbe. Finition : Anthracite (code 13).

En résumé
• Ensemble : fauteuil lounge avec pouf rond assorti
• Designer : JF Rolet, Paris (modèle LN6789)
• Dimensions fauteuil (L × P × H) : 114 × 104 × 135 cm
• Structure : cadre interne en acier et mousse haute densité
• Base : piètement métal 5 branches pivotant à 360°
• Audio : enceintes HiFi Bluetooth intégrées (volume, basses, aigus, USB)
• Revêtement : mesh 3D texturé 77912 (100 % polyester) – Anthracite (13)

Veuillez confirmer votre échantillon de tissu avant commande. Les photos présentent des finitions de référence.
variants.extended_description_es:
Tu música. Tu momento. Tu Moonchair.

Moonchair invita a desconectar y disfrutar sin prisas. Apoya los pies en la otomana a juego, pon tu álbum favorito y descubre un icono de diseño con sonido HiFi Bluetooth integrado.

Diseño parisino de JF Rolet
Su carcasa esférica formada por anillos tapizados envuelve un grueso asiento circular y un respaldo ergonómico. Su estructura interna de acero aporta solidez y el acolchado de espuma garantiza máxima comodidad.

Sonido HiFi Bluetooth integrado
El sistema de altavoces HiFi se integra dentro de la propia carcasa. Empareja tu dispositivo mediante Bluetooth y ajusta por separado volumen, graves y agudos desde el panel integrado con interruptor y puerto USB.

Giro de 360° y malla 3D texturizada
Su base metálica de cinco puntas gira 360° con suavidad. El tejido 77912 en malla 3D (100 % poliéster, 530 g/m²) realza las curvas del diseño. Acabado: Antracita (código 13).

De un vistazo
• Conjunto: sillón lounge con otomana redonda a juego
• Diseñador: JF Rolet, París (modelo LN6789)
• Dimensiones del sillón (An × Pr × Al): 114 × 104 × 135 cm
• Estructura: bastidor interno de acero con acolchado de espuma
• Base: pie metálico de 5 radios con giro de 360°
• Audio: altavoces HiFi Bluetooth integrados (volumen, graves, agudos, USB)
• Tapizado: malla 3D texturizada 77912 (100 % poliéster) – Antracita (13)

Por favor, confirme su muestra de tejido antes de pedir. Las fotografías muestran acabados de referencia.
variants.extended_description_it:
La tua musica. Il tuo momento. La tua Moonchair.

Moonchair invita a rallentare e godersi il momento. Appoggia i piedi sul pouf coordinato, avvia la tua playlist preferita e lasciati avvolgere dal design scultoreo con audio HiFi Bluetooth integrato.

Creata a Parigi dal designer JF Rolet
La scocca tondeggiante a fasce imbottite racchiude un generoso cuscino circolare e uno schienale ergonomico. Il telaio interno in acciaio dona solidità, mentre l'imbottitura in schiuma assicura comfort avvolgente.

Audio HiFi Bluetooth integrato nella scocca
Abbina il tuo dispositivo con il tasto Bluetooth e personalizza il suono grazie ai controlli separati di volume, bassi e alti, completi di accensione e porta USB a portata di mano.

Rotazione a 360° e rivestimento 3D mesh
La base metallica a cinque razze ruota liberamente a 360°. Il tessuto 3D mesh 77912 (100% poliestere, 530 g/m²) valorizza ogni curva. Versione: Antracite (codice 13).

In sintesi
• Set: poltrona lounge con pouf rotondo coordinato
• Designer: JF Rolet, Parigi (modello LN6789)
• Dimensioni poltrona (L × P × A): 114 × 104 × 135 cm
• Struttura: telaio interno in acciaio con imbottitura in schiuma
• Base: base metallica a 5 razze girevole a 360°
• Audio: sistema HiFi Bluetooth integrato (volume, bassi, alti, USB)
• Rivestimento: rete 3D testurizzata 77912 (100% poliestere) – Antracite (13)

Conferma il campione di tessuto scelto prima di ordinare. Le fotografie mostrano finiture di riferimento.

variants.extended_description_en:
Your music. Your moment. Your Moonchair.

Moonchair invites you to slow down and stay a little longer. Put your feet up on the matching ottoman, play a favourite album and let an ordinary evening become a moment to look forward to. With its enveloping round silhouette, generous cushioning and built-in Bluetooth HiFi audio, Moonchair brings comfort, music and sculptural design together in one distinctive lounge set.

A shape that draws you in
Created by Paris-based French designer JF Rolet, Moonchair opens towards you in layers of upholstered rings. The rounded shell frames a thick circular seat cushion and a contoured backrest, creating an inviting place to curl up with a book, enjoy a playlist or simply pause. An internal steel frame gives structure to the expressive form, while foam cushioning softens the seat and back.

Put your feet up and settle in
The matching round ottoman completes the experience, giving you somewhere to rest your feet as you unwind. Its upholstered top and ribbed base echo the chair's rounded design, so the two pieces feel like a considered pair. Together, they create a ready-made retreat in a living room, bedroom corner or dedicated listening space.

Your soundtrack, built into your seat
The Bluetooth-connected HiFi speaker system is integrated into the chair's shell, bringing your music into the design itself. Pair your device using the built-in Bluetooth button, then tailor your listening with separate volume, bass and treble controls. The control panel also includes a power control and a USB port, keeping the audio controls close at hand.

Turn towards whatever matters
A full 360° swivel on a five-star metal base lets the chair move with the moment. Turn towards a conversation, face the room or enjoy a different view without shifting the whole chair. The open, rounded form makes Moonchair a striking focal point from different angles.

Texture that brings the curves to life
The 3D mesh upholstery adds a tactile, dimensional finish to the layered silhouette. Fabric 77912 is made from 100% polyester, with a fabric weight of 530 g/m². This version is Black, colour code 06: a distinctive finishing touch for your own corner of the room.

At a glance
• Set: lounge chair with matching round ottoman
• Designer: JF Rolet, Paris
• Manufacturer model: LN6789
• Chair dimensions: 114 × 104 × 135 cm (width × depth × height)
• Structure: internal steel frame with foam cushioning
• Base: five-star metal base with 360° swivel
• Audio: built-in Bluetooth HiFi speaker system
• Controls: power, Bluetooth pairing, volume, bass and treble
• Connection: USB port
• Upholstery: textured 3D mesh, 100% polyester
• Fabric: 77912 / Black / colour code 06

Make room for your next favourite moment. Moonchair gives your music, your reading time and your evening wind-down a place of their own.

Please confirm your chosen fabric swatch before ordering. Product photographs show reference finishes and may differ from the selected colour.

variants.extended_description_en:
Your music. Your moment. Your Moonchair.

Moonchair invites you to slow down and stay a little longer. Put your feet up on the matching ottoman, play a favourite album and let an ordinary evening become a moment to look forward to. With its enveloping round silhouette, generous cushioning and built-in Bluetooth HiFi audio, Moonchair brings comfort, music and sculptural design together in one distinctive lounge set.

A shape that draws you in
Created by Paris-based French designer JF Rolet, Moonchair opens towards you in layers of upholstered rings. The rounded shell frames a thick circular seat cushion and a contoured backrest, creating an inviting place to curl up with a book, enjoy a playlist or simply pause. An internal steel frame gives structure to the expressive form, while foam cushioning softens the seat and back.

Put your feet up and settle in
The matching round ottoman completes the experience, giving you somewhere to rest your feet as you unwind. Its upholstered top and ribbed base echo the chair's rounded design, so the two pieces feel like a considered pair. Together, they create a ready-made retreat in a living room, bedroom corner or dedicated listening space.

Your soundtrack, built into your seat
The Bluetooth-connected HiFi speaker system is integrated into the chair's shell, bringing your music into the design itself. Pair your device using the built-in Bluetooth button, then tailor your listening with separate volume, bass and treble controls. The control panel also includes a power control and a USB port, keeping the audio controls close at hand.

Turn towards whatever matters
A full 360° swivel on a five-star metal base lets the chair move with the moment. Turn towards a conversation, face the room or enjoy a different view without shifting the whole chair. The open, rounded form makes Moonchair a striking focal point from different angles.

Texture that brings the curves to life
The 3D mesh upholstery adds a tactile, dimensional finish to the layered silhouette. Fabric 77912 is made from 100% polyester, with a fabric weight of 530 g/m². This version is Royal Blue, colour code 07: a distinctive finishing touch for your own corner of the room.

At a glance
• Set: lounge chair with matching round ottoman
• Designer: JF Rolet, Paris
• Manufacturer model: LN6789
• Chair dimensions: 114 × 104 × 135 cm (width × depth × height)
• Structure: internal steel frame with foam cushioning
• Base: five-star metal base with 360° swivel
• Audio: built-in Bluetooth HiFi speaker system
• Controls: power, Bluetooth pairing, volume, bass and treble
• Connection: USB port
• Upholstery: textured 3D mesh, 100% polyester
• Fabric: 77912 / Royal Blue / colour code 07

Make room for your next favourite moment. Moonchair gives your music, your reading time and your evening wind-down a place of their own.

Please confirm your chosen fabric swatch before ordering. Product photographs show reference finishes and may differ from the selected colour.

variants.extended_description_en:
Your music. Your moment. Your Moonchair.

Moonchair invites you to slow down and stay a little longer. Put your feet up on the matching ottoman, play a favourite album and let an ordinary evening become a moment to look forward to. With its enveloping round silhouette, generous cushioning and built-in Bluetooth HiFi audio, Moonchair brings comfort, music and sculptural design together in one distinctive lounge set.

A shape that draws you in
Created by Paris-based French designer JF Rolet, Moonchair opens towards you in layers of upholstered rings. The rounded shell frames a thick circular seat cushion and a contoured backrest, creating an inviting place to curl up with a book, enjoy a playlist or simply pause. An internal steel frame gives structure to the expressive form, while foam cushioning softens the seat and back.

Put your feet up and settle in
The matching round ottoman completes the experience, giving you somewhere to rest your feet as you unwind. Its upholstered top and ribbed base echo the chair's rounded design, so the two pieces feel like a considered pair. Together, they create a ready-made retreat in a living room, bedroom corner or dedicated listening space.

Your soundtrack, built into your seat
The Bluetooth-connected HiFi speaker system is integrated into the chair's shell, bringing your music into the design itself. Pair your device using the built-in Bluetooth button, then tailor your listening with separate volume, bass and treble controls. The control panel also includes a power control and a USB port, keeping the audio controls close at hand.

Turn towards whatever matters
A full 360° swivel on a five-star metal base lets the chair move with the moment. Turn towards a conversation, face the room or enjoy a different view without shifting the whole chair. The open, rounded form makes Moonchair a striking focal point from different angles.

Texture that brings the curves to life
The 3D mesh upholstery adds a tactile, dimensional finish to the layered silhouette. Fabric 77912 is made from 100% polyester, with a fabric weight of 530 g/m². This version is Denim Blue, colour code 35: a distinctive finishing touch for your own corner of the room.

At a glance
• Set: lounge chair with matching round ottoman
• Designer: JF Rolet, Paris
• Manufacturer model: LN6789
• Chair dimensions: 114 × 104 × 135 cm (width × depth × height)
• Structure: internal steel frame with foam cushioning
• Base: five-star metal base with 360° swivel
• Audio: built-in Bluetooth HiFi speaker system
• Controls: power, Bluetooth pairing, volume, bass and treble
• Connection: USB port
• Upholstery: textured 3D mesh, 100% polyester
• Fabric: 77912 / Denim Blue / colour code 35

Make room for your next favourite moment. Moonchair gives your music, your reading time and your evening wind-down a place of their own.

Please confirm your chosen fabric swatch before ordering. Product photographs show reference finishes and may differ from the selected colour.
